Provision.Text: [Note: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: These Regulations may be cited as the Income Tax Regulations.
In these Regulations, Act means the Income Tax Act.

Subsection.Text: In this Part and in Schedule I,

Definition.Text: employee means any person receiving remuneration; (employé)
employer means any person paying remuneration; (employeur)

estimated deductions means, in respect of a taxation year, the total of the amounts estimated to be deductible by an employee for the year under any of paragraphs 8(1)(f), (h), (h.1), (i) and (j) of the Act and determined by the employee for the purpose of completing the form referred to in subsection 107(2); (déductions estimatives)
pay period includes

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a day,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a week,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a two week period,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a semi-monthly period,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a month,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a four week period,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: one tenth of a calendar year, or

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: one twenty-second of a calendar year; (période de paie)

Definition.Text: personal credits means, in respect of a particular taxation year, the greater of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount referred to in paragraph 118(1)(c) of the Act, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of the credits which the employee would be entitled to claim for the year under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: subsections 118(1), (2) and (3) of the Act if the description of A in those subsections were read as “is equal to one”,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsections 118.3(1) and (2) of the Act if the description of A in subsection 118.3(1) of the Act were read as “is equal to one” and if subsection 118.3(1) of the Act were read without reference to paragraph (c) thereof,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsections 118.5(1) and 118.6(2) of the Act if subsection 118.5(1) of the Act were read without reference to “the product obtained when the appropriate percentage for the year is multiplied by” and the description of A in subsection 118.6(2) of the Act were read as “is equal to one”, and after deducting from the aggregate of the amounts determined under those subsections the excess over $3,000 of the aggregate of amounts that the employee claims to expect to receive in the year on account of a scholarship, fellowship or bursary,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: section 118.8 of the Act if the formula A + B - C in that section were read as

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the value of A in that section,
is the value of B in that section, and
is the appropriate percentage for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: section 118.9 of the Act if the formula A - B in section 118.81 of the Act were read as

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the value of A set out in that section, and
is the appropriate percentage for the year. (crédits d’impôts personnels)

Definition.Text: remuneration includes any payment that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: salary or wages, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: commissions or other similar amounts fixed by reference to the volume of the sales made or the contracts negotiated (referred to as commissions in this Part)

ContinuedDefinition.Text: paid to an officer or employee or former officer or employee,

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of an employee’s gratuities required under provincial legislation to be declared to the employee’s employer,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a superannuation or pension benefit (including an annuity payment made pursuant to or under a superannuation or pension fund or plan) other than a distribution

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that is made from a pooled registered pension plan and is not required to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income under paragraph 56(1)(z.3) of the Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that subsection 147.5(14) of the Act deems to have been made,

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: an amount of a distribution out of or under a retirement compensation arrangement,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a retiring allowance,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a death benefit,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit under a supplementary unemployment benefit plan,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a payment under a deferred profit sharing plan or a plan referred to in section 147 of the Act as a revoked plan, reduced, if applicable, by amounts determined under subsections 147(10.1), (11) and (12) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit under the Employment Insurance Act,

Paragraph.Label: (g.1)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(a.3) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(r) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income, except the portion of the amount that relates to child care expenses and tuition costs,

Paragraph.Label: (h.1)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(z.2) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in the definition annuitant in subsection 146(1) of the Act out of or under a registered retirement savings plan of that annuitant, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a periodic annuity payment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment made by a person who has reasonable grounds to believe that the payment may be deducted under subsection 146(8.2) of the Act in computing the income of any taxpayer,

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under a plan referred to in subsection 146(12) of the Act as an amended plan other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a periodic annuity payment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where paragraph 146(12)(a) of the Act applied to the plan after May 25, 1976, a payment made in a year subsequent to the year in which that paragraph applied to the plan,

Paragraph.Label: (j.1)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in the definition annuitant in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act under a registered retirement income fund of that annuitant, other than a particular payment to the extent that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular payment is in respect of the minimum amount (in this paragraph having the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1) of the Act) under the fund for a year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the fund governs a trust, the particular payment would be in respect of the minimum amount under the fund for a year if each amount that, at the beginning of the year, is scheduled to be paid after the time of the particular payment and in the year to the trust under an annuity contract that is held by the trust both at the beginning of the year and at the time of the particular payment, is paid to the trust in the year,

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit described in section 5502,

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: an amount as, on account or in lieu of payment of, or in satisfaction of, proceeds of the surrender, cancellation or redemption of an income-averaging annuity contract,

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of an amount that can reasonably be regarded as having been received, in whole or in part, as consideration or partial consideration for entering into a contract of service, where the service is to be performed in Canada, or for an undertaking not to enter into such a contract with another party,

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of a registered education savings plan other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a refund of payments,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an educational assistance payment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount, up to $50,000, of an accumulated income payment that is made to a subscriber, as defined in subsection 204.94(1) of the Act, or if there is no subscriber at that time, that is made to a person that has been a spouse or common-law partner of an individual who was a subscriber, if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: that amount is transferred to an RRSP in which the annuitant is either the recipient of the payment or the recipient’s spouse or common-law partner, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: it is reasonable for the person making the payment to believe that that amount is deductible for the year by the recipient of the payment within the limits provided for in subsection 146(5) or (5.1) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: an amount of a disability assistance payment made under a registered disability savings plan that is required by paragraph 56(1)(q.1) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (p)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(z.5) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (q)
Paragraph.Text: a payment described in paragraph 153(1)(v) of the Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (r)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by subparagraph 56(1)(a)(viii) of the Act to be included in computing the taxpayer’s income; (rémunération)

Definition.Text: total remuneration means, in respect of a taxation year, the total of all amounts each of which is an amount referred to in paragraph (a) or (a.1) of the definition remuneration. (rémunération totale)

Subsection.Text: Where the amount of any credit referred to in paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition personal credits in subsection (1) is subject to an annual adjustment under section 117.1 of the Act, such amount shall, in a particular taxation year, be subject to that annual adjustment.

For the purposes of this Part, where an employer deducts or withholds from a payment of remuneration to an employee one or more of the following amounts, the balance remaining after the deducting or withholding of the amount or amounts shall be deemed to be the amount of that payment of remuneration:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a contribution to or under a pooled registered pension plan, a registered pension plan or a specified pension plan,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: dues described in subparagraph 8(1)(i)(iv), (v) or (vi) of the Act paid on account of the employee,

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: a contribution by the employee under subparagraph 8(1)(m.2) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a premium under a registered retirement savings plan, to the extent that the employer believes on reasonable grounds that the premium is deductible under paragraph 60(j.1) or subsection 146(5) or (5.1) of the Act in computing the employee’s income for the taxation year in which the payment of remuneration is made,

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: a contribution to or under a FHSA, to the extent that the employer believes on reasonable grounds that the contribution is deductible under subsection 146.6(5) of the Act in computing the employee’s income for the taxation year in which the payment of remuneration is made,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is deductible under paragraph 60(b) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is deductible under paragraph 60(e.1) of the Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is deductible under paragraph 60(l) of the Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, where an employee has claimed a deduction for a taxation year under paragraph 110.7(1)(b) of the Act as shown on the return most recently filed by the employee with the employee’s employer pursuant to subsection 227(2) of the Act, the amount of remuneration otherwise determined, including the amount deemed by subsection (3) to be the amount of that payment of remuneration, paid to the employee for a pay period shall be reduced by an amount equal to the amount of the deduction divided by the maximum number of pay periods in the year in respect of the appropriate pay period.
For the purposes of this Part, where an employee is not required to report for work at any establishment of the employer, he shall be deemed to report for work

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of remuneration that is salary, wages or commissions, at the establishment of the employer from which the remuneration is paid; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of remuneration other than salary, wages or commissions, at the establishment of the employer in the province where the employee resides at the time the remuneration is paid but, if the employer does not have an establishment in that province at that time, he shall, for the purposes of this paragraph, be deemed to have an establishment in that province.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, where an employer deducts or withholds from a payment of remuneration to an employee an amount in respect of the acquisition by the employee of an approved share, as defined in subsection 127.4(1) of the Act, there shall be deducted from the amount determined under paragraph 102(1)(e) or (2)(e), as the case may be, in respect of that payment the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 15% of the amount deducted or withheld in respect of the acquisition of an approved share.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Every person who makes a payment described in subsection 153(1) of the Act in a taxation year shall deduct or withhold therefrom, and remit to the Receiver General, such amount, if any, as is determined in accordance with rules prescribed in this Part.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Except as otherwise provided in this Part, the amount to be deducted or withheld by an employer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: from any payment of remuneration (in this subsection referred to as the payment) made to an employee in his taxation year where he reports for work at an establishment of the employer in a province, in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for any pay period in which the payment is made by the employer

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: shall be determined for each payment in accordance with the following rules:

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is a notional remuneration for the year in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment to the employee, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, of gratuities referred to in paragraph (a.1) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: is deemed to be the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount that is deemed for the purpose of this paragraph to be the mid-point of the applicable range of remuneration for the pay period, as provided in Schedule I, in which falls the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the payment referred to in subparagraph (i) made in the pay period, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount of gratuities referred to in subparagraph (ii) declared by the employee for the pay period, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the maximum number of such pay periods in that year;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the employee is not resident in Canada at the time of the payment, no personal credits will be allowed for the purposes of this subsection and, if the employee is resident in Canada at the time of the payment, the employee’s personal credits for the year are deemed to be the mid-point of the range of amounts of personal credits for a taxation year as provided for in section 2 of Schedule I;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount (in this subsection referred to as the notional tax for the year) shall be computed in respect of that employee by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: calculating the amount of tax payable for the year, as if that amount were calculated under subsection 117(2) of the Act and adjusted annually pursuant to section 117.1 of the Act, on the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (c) as if that amount represented the employee’s amount taxable for that year,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: and deducting the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (d) multiplied by the appropriate percentage for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount equal to

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (c) multiplied by the employee’s premium rate for the year under the Employment Insurance Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of the premiums payable by the employee for the year under that Act,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: multiplied by

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the appropriate percentage for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount equal to

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the product obtained when the difference between the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (c) and the amount determined under section 20 of the Canada Pension Plan for the year is multiplied by the employee’s contribution rate for the year under the Canada Pension Plan or under a provincial pension plan as defined in subsection 3(1) of that Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of such contributions payable by the employee for the year under the plan,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: multiplied by

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the appropriate percentage for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (e) shall be increased by, where applicable, the tax as determined under subsection 120(1) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount of notional remuneration for the year is income earned in the Province of Quebec, the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (e) shall be reduced by an amount that is the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that is deemed to be paid under subsection 120(2) of the Act as if there were no other source of income or loss for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount by which the amount referred to in subparagraph (i) is increased by virtue of section 27 of the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements and Federal Post-Secondary Education and Health Contributions Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: [Repealed, SOR/92-667, s. 1]

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: the amount to be deducted or withheld shall be computed by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: dividing the amount of the notional tax for the year by the maximum number of pay periods for the year in respect of the appropriate pay period, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: rounding the amount determined under subparagraph (i) to the nearest multiple of five cents or, if such amount is equidistant from two such multiples, to the higher multiple.

Subsection.Text: Where an employee has elected pursuant to subsection 107(2) and has not revoked such election, the amount to be deducted or withheld by the employer from any payment of remuneration (in this subsection referred to as the payment) that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a payment in respect of commissions or is a combined payment of commissions and salary or wages, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a payment in respect of salary or wages where that employee receives a combined payment of commissions and salary or wages,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: made to that employee in his taxation year where he reports for work at an establishment of the employer in a province, in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, shall be determined for each payment in accordance with the following rules:

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an employee’s estimated annual taxable income shall be determined by using the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of that employee’s total remuneration in respect of the year as recorded by the employee on the form referred to in subsection 107(2), and
is the amount of that employee’s expenses in respect of the year as recorded by that employee on that form;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if the employee is not resident in Canada at the time of the payment, no personal credits will be allowed for the purposes of this subsection and if the employee is resident in Canada at the time of the payment, the employee’s personal credits for the year shall be the total claim amount as recorded by that employee on the return for the year referred to in subsection 107(1);

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount (in this subsection referred to as the notional tax for the year) shall be calculated in respect of that employee by using the formula

Formula.FormulaText: C - [(D + E + F) × G] + H - I

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of tax payable for the year, calculated as if that amount of tax were computed under subsection 117(2) of the Act and adjusted annually pursuant to section 117.1 of the Act, on the amount determined under paragraph (c) as if that amount represented the employee’s amount taxable for that year,
is the amount determined in accordance with paragraph (d),

is the amount determined in the description of A in paragraph (c) multiplied by the employee’s premium rate for the year under the Employment Insurance Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of the premiums payable by the employee for the year under that Act,

is the amount determined in the description of A in paragraph (c) less the amount for the year determined under section 20 of the Canada Pension Plan multiplied by the employee’s contribution rate for the year under that Act or under a provincial pension plan as defined in section 3 of that Act, not exceeding the maximum amount of such contributions payable by the employee for the year under the plan,
is the appropriate percentage for the year,
is, where applicable, the tax as determined under subsection 120(1) of the Act,
is, where the amount of total remuneration for the year is income earned in the Province of Quebec, an amount equal to the aggregate of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount that would be deemed to have been paid under subsection 120(2) of the Act with respect to the employee if the notional tax for the year for the employee were determined without reference to the elements H, I and J in this formula and if that tax were that employee’s tax payable under Part I of the Act for that year, as if there were no other source of income or loss for the year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount by which the amount referred to in subparagraph (i) is increased by virtue of section 27 of the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the employee’s notional rate of tax for a year is calculated by dividing the amount determined under paragraph (e) by the amount referred to in the description of A in paragraph (c) in respect of that employee and expressed as a decimal fraction rounded to the nearest hundredth, or where the third digit is equidistant from two consecutive one-thousandths, to the higher thereof;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the amount to be deducted or withheld in respect of any payment made to that employee shall be determined by multiplying the payment by the appropriate decimal fraction determined pursuant to paragraph (f).

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsections (1) and (2), no amount shall be deducted or withheld in the year by an employer from a payment of remuneration to an employee in respect of commissions earned by the employee in the immediately preceding year where those commissions were previously reported by the employer as remuneration of the employee in respect of that year on an information return.
Despite subsection (1), no amount shall be deducted or withheld in the year by an employer from an amount determined in accordance with subparagraph 110(1)(f)(iii), (iv) or (v) of the Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where a payment in respect of a bonus or retroactive increase in remuneration is made by an employer to an employee whose total remuneration from the employer (including the bonus or retroactive increase) may reasonably be expected not to exceed $5,000 in the taxation year of the employee in which the payment is made, the employer shall deduct or withhold, in the case of an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in any province, 10 per cent, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 15 per cent,

Paragraph.Label: (c) to (n)
Paragraph.Text: [Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s. 3]

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102.

Subsection.Text: Where a payment in respect of a bonus is made by an employer to an employee whose total remuneration from the employer (including the bonus) may reasonably be expected to exceed $5,000 in the taxation year of the employee in which the payment is made, the amount to be deducted or withheld therefrom by the employer is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined under section 102 in respect of an assumed remuneration equal to the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of regular remuneration paid by the employer to the employee in the pay period in which the remuneration is paid, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount equal to the bonus payment divided by the number of pay periods in the taxation year of the employee in which the payment is made

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: minus

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined under section 102 in respect of the amount of regular remuneration paid by the employer to the employee in the pay period

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: multiplied by

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the number of pay periods in the taxation year of the employee in which the payment is made.

Subsection.Text: Where a payment in respect of a retroactive increase in remuneration is made by an employer to an employee whose total remuneration from the employer (including the retroactive increase) may reasonably be expected to exceed $5,000 in the taxation year of the employee in which the payment is made, the amount to be deducted or withheld therefrom by the employer is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined under section 102 in respect of the new rate of remuneration

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: minus

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined under section 102 in respect of the previous rate of remuneration

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: multiplied by

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the number of pay periods in respect of which the increase in remuneration is retroactive.

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsections (4.1) and (5), where a lump sum payment is made by an employer to an employee who is a resident of Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the payment does not exceed $5,000, the employer shall deduct or withhold therefrom, in the case of an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in Quebec, 5 per cent,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other province, 7 per cent, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 10 per cent,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the payment exceeds $5,000 but does not exceed $15,000, the employer shall deduct or withhold therefrom, in the case of an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in Quebec, 10 per cent,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other province, 13 per cent, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 20 per cent,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the payment exceeds $15,000, the employer shall deduct or withhold therefrom, in the case of an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in Quebec, 15 per cent,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other province, 20 per cent, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 30 per cent,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: of such payment in lieu of the amount determined under section 102.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of a lump sum payment described in paragraph (6)(h), subsection (4) is to be read without reference to its paragraphs (b) and (c) and the portion of subsection (4) before subparagraph (a)(i) is to be read as follows:
Where a lump sum payment is made by an employer to an employee,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the employer shall deduct or withhold therefrom, in the case of an employee who reports for work at an establishment of the employer

Subsection.Text: Where the payment referred to in subsection (4) would be pension income or qualified pension income of the employee in respect of which subsection 118(3) of the Act would apply if the definition pension income in subsection 118(7) of the Act were read without reference to subparagraphs (a)(ii) and (iii) thereof, the payment shall be deemed to be the amount of the payment minus

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the payment does not exceed the amount taxable referred to in paragraph 117(2)(a) of the Act, as adjusted annually pursuant to section 117.1 of the Act, the lesser of $1,000 and the amount of the payment;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the payment exceeds the amount referred to in paragraph (a) but does not exceed $61,509, $727;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the payment exceeds $61,509 but does not exceed $100,000, $615; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the payment exceeds $100,000, $552.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (4), a lump sum payment means a payment that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a payment described in subparagraph 40(1)(a)(i) or (iii) or paragraph 40(1)(c) of the Income Tax Application Rules,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a payment under a deferred profit sharing plan or a plan referred to in section 147 of the Act as a revoked plan, except a payment referred to in subparagraph 147(2)(k)(v) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in the definition annuitant in subsection 146(1) of the Act out of or under a registered retirement savings plan of that annuitant, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a periodic annuity payment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a payment made by a person who has reasonable grounds to believe that the payment may be deducted under subsection 146(8.2) of the Act in computing the income of any taxpayer,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of or under a plan referred to in subsection 146(12) of the Act as an amended plan other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a periodic annuity payment, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where paragraph 146(12)(a) of the Act applied to the plan after May 25, 1976, a payment made in a year subsequent to the year in which that paragraph applied to the plan,

Paragraph.Label: (d.1)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in the definition annuitant in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act under a registered retirement income fund of that annuitant, other than a payment to the extent that it is in respect of the minimum amount (within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.3(1) of the Act) under the fund for a year,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a retiring allowance,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a payment of an amount as, on account or in lieu of payment of, or in satisfaction of, proceeds of the surrender, cancellation or redemption of an income-averaging annuity contract,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a payment described in paragraph (n) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1),

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made under the

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: Canada Recovery Benefits Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: Canada Worker Lockdown Benefit Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a payment described in paragraph 153(1)(v) of the Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 153(1) of the Act, the amount to be deducted or withheld by a person shall be 50 per cent

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of the contribution made by the person under a retirement compensation arrangement, other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a contribution made by the person as an employee,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a contribution made to a plan or arrangement that is a prescribed plan or arrangement for the purposes of subsection 207.6(6) of the Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a contribution made by way of a transfer from another retirement compensation arrangement under circumstances in which subsection 207.6(7) of the Act applies, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a contribution that is an excluded contribution (as defined in subsection 207.5(1) of the Act); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of the payment by the person to a resident of Canada of an amount on account of the purchase price of an interest in a retirement compensation arrangement.

Subsection.Text: Every employer making a payment described in paragraph (n) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1) shall withhold — in addition to any other amount required to be withheld under Part I of these Regulations — on account of the tax payable under Part X.5 of the Act, an amount equal to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount is paid in the province of Quebec, 12 per cent of the payment, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, 20 per cent of the payment.

Subsection.Text: The amount to be deducted or withheld by a person from any payment of an amount described in paragraph 56(1)(z.4) of the Act is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a payment to a resident of Quebec, 30% of the payment; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a payment to a resident of Canada who is not a resident of Quebec, 50% of the payment.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of the description of C in subsection (2), plan payment means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a disability assistance payment that is a lifetime disability assistance payment, the total amount of all the lifetime disability assistance payments that have been made or that may reasonably be expected to be made to the employee under the plan in their taxation year and that the employer has reasonable grounds to believe are described in paragraph (o) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a disability assistance payment that is other than a lifetime disability assistance payment, the amount of the payment that is made to the employee under the plan and that is described in paragraph (o) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1).

Subsection.Text: If an employer makes a disability assistance payment under a registered disability savings plan to an employee who is a resident of Canada, the employer shall, in lieu of the amount determined under section 102, deduct or withhold from the payment an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the disability assistance payment that is made to the employee and that is described in paragraph (o) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1);
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the beneficiary of the plan is deceased, nil, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount by which the total of the following amounts exceeds the total amount of all the disability assistance payments previously made to the employee in their taxation year and that are described in paragraph (o) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1):

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount determined for F in subsection 118(1.1) of the Act for the taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount used under the description of B in subsection 118.3(1) of the Act for the taxation year; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the plan payment does not exceed $5,000 and the amount is paid

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in Quebec, 5 per cent,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other province, 7 per cent, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 10 per cent,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the plan payment exceeds $5,000 but does not exceed $15,000 and the amount is paid

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in Quebec, 10 per cent,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other province, 13 per cent, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 20 per cent, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the plan payment exceeds $15,000 and the amount is paid

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in Quebec, 15 per cent,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other province, 20 per cent, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in Canada beyond the limits of any province or outside Canada, 30 per cent.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: No amount shall be deducted or withheld from a payment in accordance with any of sections 102 to 103.1 in respect of an employee who was neither employed nor resident in Canada at the time of payment except in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: remuneration described in subparagraph 115(2)(e)(i) of the Act that is paid to a non-resident person who has in the year, or had in any previous year, ceased to be resident in Canada; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: remuneration reasonably attributable to the duties of any office or employment performed or to be performed in Canada by the non-resident person.

Subsection.Text: No amount shall be deducted or withheld from a payment made by a person during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition annuitant in subsection 146(1) of the Act out of or under a registered retirement savings plan of the annuitant where, at the time of the payment, the annuitant has certified in prescribed form to the person that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a written agreement has been entered into to acquire a home by either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the annuitant, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a disabled person who is related to the annuitant and who is entitled to the credit for mental or physical impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the annuitant intends that the home be used as a principal place of residence in Canada for the annuitant or the disabled person, as the case may be, within one year after its acquisition;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the home has not been previously owned by the annuitant, the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner, the disabled person or the spouse or common-law partner of that person;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the annuitant was resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the total amount of the payment and all other such payments received by the annuitant in respect of the home at or before the time of the payment does not exceed the dollar amount specified in paragraph (h) of the definition regular eligible amount in subsection 146.01(1) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: except where the annuitant certifies that he or she is a disabled person entitled to the credit for mental or physical impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act or certifies that the payment is being withdrawn for the benefit of such a disabled person, the annuitant is a qualifying homebuyer at the time of the certification; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: where the annuitant has withdrawn an eligible amount, within the meaning assigned by subsection 146.01(1) of the Act, before the calendar year of the certification, the total of all eligible amounts received by the annuitant before that calendar year does not exceed the total of all amounts previously designated under subsection 146.01(3) of the Act or included in computing the annuitant’s income under subsection 146.01(4) or (5) of the Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (3), the annuitant is a qualifying homebuyer at a particular time unless

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the annuitant had an owner-occupied home in the period beginning on January 1 of the fourth calendar year preceding the particular time, and ending on the thirty-first day before the particular time; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner, in the period referred to in paragraph (a), had an owner-occupied home that was inhabited by the annuitant at any time during the annuitant’s marriage to the spouse or the annuitant’s common-law partnership with the common-law partner.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (3.01), an individual shall be considered to have had an owner-occupied home at any time where the home was owned, whether jointly with another person or otherwise, by the individual at that time and inhabited by the individual as the individual’s principal place of residence at that time.
For the purposes of subsections (3), (3.01) and (3.1), home means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a housing unit;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of a cooperative housing corporation, where the holder of the share is entitled to possession of a housing unit; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the context so requires, the housing unit to which a share described in paragraph (b) relates.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: No amount shall be deducted or withheld from a payment made by a person during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition annuitant in subsection 146(1) of the Act out of or under a registered retirement savings plan of the annuitant where, at the time of the payment, the annuitant has certified in prescribed form to the person that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at the time of certification, the annuitant or the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is a full-time student in a qualifying educational program,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is a part-time student in a qualifying educational program and is entitled to the credit for mental or physical impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: has received notification in writing of his or her entitlement, either absolutely or conditionally, to enrol before March of the year that follows the year of certification as

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a full-time student in a qualifying educational program, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a part-time student in a qualifying educational program where the annuitant or the annuitant’s spouse or common-law partner is entitled to the credit for mental or physical impairment under subsection 118.3(1) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the annuitant is resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total amount of the payment and all other such payments received by the annuitant for a year at or before that time does not exceed $10,000; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the total payments received by the annuitant do not exceed $20,000 throughout the period in which the annuitant participates in the Lifelong Learning Plan.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1), a qualifying educational program means a qualifying educational program at a designated educational institution (as those expressions are defined in subsection 118.6(1) of the Act), except that a reference to a qualifying educational program shall be read

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: without reference to paragraphs (a) and (b) of that definition; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: as if the reference to “3 consecutive weeks” in that definition were a reference to “3 consecutive months”.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every person paying to a non-resident person a fee, commission or other amount in respect of services rendered in Canada, of any nature whatever, shall deduct or withhold 15 per cent of such payment.
Subsection (1) does not apply to a payment

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: made to a registered non-resident insurer (within the meaning assigned by section 804); or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: made to an authorized foreign bank in respect of its Canadian banking business.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding section 100, in this section,

Definition.Text: amount of remuneration paid to a fisherman means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where a boat crewed by one or more fishermen engaged in making a catch is owned, together with the gear, by a person, other than a member of the crew, to whom the catch is to be delivered for subsequent sale or other disposition, such portion of the proceeds from the disposition of the catch that is payable to the fisherman in accordance with an arrangement under which the proceeds of disposition of the catch are to be distributed (in this section referred to as a “share arrangement”),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the boat or gear used in making a catch is owned or leased by a fisherman who alone or with another individual engaged under a contract of service makes the catch, such portion of the proceeds from the disposition of the catch that remains after deducting therefrom

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount in respect of any portion of the catch not caught by the fisherman or the other individual,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount payable to the other individual under the contract of service, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of such proportionate share of the catch as is attributable to the expenses of the operation of the boat or its gear pursuant to their share arrangement,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where a crew includes the owner of the boat or gear (in this paragraph referred to as the owner) and any other fisherman engaged in making a catch, such portion of the proceeds from the disposition of the catch that remains after deducting therefrom

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of an owner,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the amount in respect of that portion of the catch not caught by the crew or an owner,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is an amount payable to a crew member (other than the owner) pursuant to their share arrangement or to an individual engaged under a contract of service, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the amount of such proportionate share of the catch as is attributable to the expenses of the owner’s operation of the boat or its gear pursuant to their share arrangement, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of any other crew member, such proceeds from the disposition of the catch as is payable to him in accordance with their share arrangement, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the proceeds of disposition of the catch payable to the fisherman; (montant de rémunération)

Definition.Text: catch means a catch of shell fish, crustaceans, aquatic animals or marine plants caught or taken from any body of water; (pêche)
crew means one or more fishermen engaged in making a catch; (équipe)
fisherman means an individual engaged in making a catch other than under a contract of service. (pêcheur)

Subsection.Text: Every person paying at any time in a taxation year an amount of remuneration to a fisherman who, pursuant to paragraph 153(1)(n) of the Act, has elected for the year in prescribed form in respect of all such amounts shall deduct or withhold 20% of each such amount paid to the fisherman while the election is in force.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where an employer makes a payment of remuneration to an employee in his taxation year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for a period for which no provision is made in Schedule I, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for a pay period referred to in Schedule I in an amount that is greater than any amount provided for therein,

Paragraph.Label: (c) and (d)
Paragraph.Text: [Repealed, SOR/2001-221, s. 5]

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the amount to be deducted or withheld by the employer from any such payment is that proportion of the payment that the tax that may reasonably be expected to be payable under the Act by the employee with respect to the aggregate of all remuneration that may reasonably be expected to be paid by the employer to the employee in respect of that taxation year is of such aggregate.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The return required to be filed by an employee under subsection 227(2) of the Act shall be filed by the employee with the employer when the employee commences employment with that employer and a new return shall be filed thereunder within 7 days after the date on which a change occurs that may reasonably be expected to result in a change in the employee’s personal credits for the year.

Notwithstanding subsection (1), where, in a year, an employee receives payments in respect of commissions or in respect of commissions and salary or wages, and the employee elects to file a prescribed form for the year in addition to the return referred to in that subsection, that form shall be filed with the employee’s continuing employer on or before January 31 of that year and, where applicable, within one month after the employee commences employment with a new employer or within one month after the date on which a change occurs that may reasonably be expected to result in a substantial change in the employee’s estimated total remuneration for the year or estimated deductions for the year.

Where, in a taxation year, an employee has elected to file the prescribed form referred to in subsection (2) and has filed such form with his employer, the employee may at any time thereafter in the year revoke that election and such revocation is effective from the date that he notifies his employer in writing of his intention.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsections (1.1) to (1.13), amounts deducted or withheld in a month under subsection 153(1) of the Act shall be remitted to the Receiver General on or before the 15th day of the following month.
Subject to subsection (1.11), where the average monthly withholding amount of an employer for the second calendar year preceding a particular calendar year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: equal to or greater than $25,000 and less than $100,000, all amounts deducted or withheld from payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1) that are made in a month in the particular calendar year by the employer shall be remitted to the Receiver General

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of payments made before the 16th day of the month, on or before the 25th day of the month, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of payments made after the 15th day of the month, on or before the 10th day of the following month; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: equal to or greater than $100,000, all amounts deducted or withheld from payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1) that are made in a month in the particular calendar year by the employer shall be remitted to the Receiver General on or before the third day, not including a Saturday or holiday, after the end of the following periods in which the payments were made,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the period beginning on the first day and ending on the 7th day of the month,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the period beginning on the 8th day and ending on the 14th day of the month,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the period beginning on the 15th day and ending on the 21st day of the month, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the period beginning on the 22nd day and ending on the last day of the month.

Subsection.Text: Where an employer referred to in paragraph (1.1)(a) or (b) would otherwise be required to remit in accordance with that paragraph the amounts withheld or deducted under subsection 153(1) of the Act in respect of a particular calendar year, the employer may elect to remit those amounts

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in accordance with subsection (1), if the average monthly withholding amount of the employer for the calendar year preceding the particular calendar year is less than $25,000 and the employer has advised the Minister that the employer has so elected; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the average monthly withholding amount of the employer for the calendar year preceding the particular calendar year is equal to or greater than $25,000 and less than $100,000 and the employer has advised the Minister that the employer has so elected,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of payments made before the 16th day of a month in the particular calendar year, on or before the 25th day of the month, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of payments made after the 15th day of a month in particular calendar year, on or before the 10th day of the following month.

Subsection.Text: If at any time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the average monthly withholding amount in respect of an employer for either the first or the second calendar year before the particular calendar year that includes that time is less than $3,000,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: throughout the 12-month period before that time, the employer has remitted, on or before the day on or before which the amounts were required to be remitted, all amounts each of which was required to be remitted under subsection 153(1) of the Act, under subsection 21(1) of the Canada Pension Plan, under subsection 82(1) of the Employment Insurance Act or under Part IX of the Excise Tax Act, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: throughout the 12-month period before that time, the employer has filed all returns each of which was required to be filed under this Act or Part IX of the Excise Tax Act on or before the day on or before which those returns were required to be filed under those Acts,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: all amounts deducted or withheld from payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1) that are made by the employer in a month that ends after that time and that is in the particular calendar year may be remitted to the Receiver General

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in January, February and March of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of April of the particular year,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in April, May and June of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of July of the particular year,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in July, August and September of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of October of the particular year, and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in October, November and December of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of January of the year following the particular year.

Subsection.Text: If an employer is a new employer throughout a particular month in a particular calendar year, all amounts deducted or withheld from payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1) that are made by the employer in the month may be remitted to the Receiver General

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in January, February and March of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of April of the particular calendar year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in April, May and June of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of July of the particular calendar year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in July, August and September of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of October of the particular calendar year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of such payments made in October, November and December of the particular calendar year, on or before the 15th day of January of the year following the particular calendar year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, average monthly withholding amount, in respect of an employer for a particular calendar year, is the quotient obtained when

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is an amount required to be remitted with respect to the particular year under

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: subsection 153(1) of the Act and a similar provision of a law of a province which imposes a tax upon the income of individuals, where the province has entered into an agreement with the Minister of Finance for the collection of taxes payable to the province, in respect of payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsection 21(1) of the Canada Pension Plan, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: subsection 82(1) of the Employment Insurance Act,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: by the employer or, where the employer is a corporation, by each corporation associated with the corporation in a taxation year of the employer ending in the second calendar year following the particular year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: is divided by

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the number of months in the particular year, not exceeding twelve, for which such amounts were required to be remitted by the employer and, where the employer is a corporation, by each corporation associated with it in a taxation year of the employer ending in the second calendar year following the particular year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1.4), the monthly withholding amount, in respect of an employer for a month, is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount required to be remitted with respect to the month by the employer or, if the employer is a corporation, by each corporation associated with the corporation, under

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 153(1) of the Act and a similar provision of a law of a province which imposes a tax upon the income of individuals, if the province has entered into an agreement with the Minister of Finance for the collection of taxes payable to the province, in respect of payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 21(1) of the Canada Pension Plan; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 82(1) of the Employment Insurance Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1.2), where a particular employer that is a corporation has acquired in a taxation year of the corporation ending in a particular calendar year all or substantially all of the property of another employer used by the other employer in a business

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in a transaction in respect of which an election was made under subsection 85(1) or (2) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: by virtue of an amalgamation within the meaning assigned to that term by section 87 of the Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: as the result of a winding-up in respect of which subsection 88(1) of the Act is applicable,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the other employer shall be deemed to be a corporation associated with the particular employer in the taxation year and each taxation year ending at any time in the next two following calendar years.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1.13) an employer

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: becomes a new employer at the beginning of any month after 2015 in which the employer first becomes an employer; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: ceases to be a new employer at a specified time in a particular year, if in a particular month the employer does not meet any of the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the monthly withholding amount in respect of the employer for the particular month is less than $1,000,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: throughout the 12-month period before that time, the employer has remitted, on or before the day on or before which the amounts were required to be remitted, all amounts each of which was required to be remitted under subsection 153(1) of the Act, subsection 21(1) of the Canada Pension Plan, subsection 82(1) of the Employment Insurance Act or Part IX of the Excise Tax Act, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: throughout the 12-month period before that time, the employer has filed all returns each of which was required to be filed under the Act or Part IX of the Excise Tax Act on or before the day on or before which those returns were required to be filed under those Acts.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1.4), the specified time is the end of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: March of the particular year, if the particular month is January, February or March of that year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: June of the particular year, if the particular month is April, May or June of that year;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: September of the particular year, if the particular month is July, August or September of that year; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: December of the particular year, if the particular month is October, November or December of that year.

Subsection.Text: Where an employer has ceased to carry on business, any amount deducted or withheld under subsection 153(1) of the Act that has not been remitted to the Receiver General shall be paid within 7 days of the day when the employer ceased to carry on business.
Remittances made to the Receiver General under subsection 153(1) of the Act shall be accompanied by a return in prescribed form.

Amounts deducted or withheld under subsection 153(4) of the Act shall be remitted to the Receiver General within 60 days after the end of the taxation year subsequent to the 12-month period referred to in that subsection.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Any election under subsection 153(1.2) of the Act shall be made by filing with the person making the payment or class of payments referred to therein (in this section referred to as the payer) the form prescribed by the Minister for that purpose.

A taxpayer who has made an election in the manner prescribed by subsection (1) may require that the amount deducted or withheld pursuant to that election be varied by filing with the payer the form prescribed by the Minister for that purpose.

An election made in the manner prescribed by subsection (1) or a variation made pursuant to subsection (2) need not be taken into account by the payer in respect of the first payment to be made to the taxpayer after the election or variation, as the case may be, unless the election or variation, as the case may be, is made within such time, in advance of the payment, as may reasonably be required by the payer.
The following are prescribed persons for the purposes of subsection 153(1) of the Act:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an employer who is required, under subsection 153(1) of the Act and in accordance with paragraph 108(1.1)(b), to remit amounts deducted or withheld; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a person or partnership who, acting on behalf of one or more employers, remits the following amounts in a particular calendar year and whose average monthly remittance, in respect of those amounts, for the second calendar year preceding the particular calendar year, is equal to or greater than $50,000,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: amounts required to be remitted under subsection 153(1) of the Act and a similar provision of a law of a province that imposes a tax on the income of individuals, where the province has entered into an agreement with the Minister of Finance for the collection of taxes payable to the province, in respect of payments described in the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: amounts required to be remitted under subsection 21(1) of the Canada Pension Plan, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: amounts required to be remitted under subsection 82(1) of the Employment Insurance Act or subsection 53(1) of the Unemployment Insurance Act.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), the average monthly remittance made by a person or partnership on behalf of all the employers for whom that person or partnership is acting, for the second calendar year preceding the particular calendar year, is the quotient obtained when the aggregate, for that preceding year, of all amounts referred to in subparagraphs (1)(b)(i) to (iii) remitted by the person or partnership on behalf of those employers is divided by the number of months, in that preceding year, for which the person or partnership remitted those amounts.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purpose of subsection 153(1.02) of the Act

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: $25,000 is the amount prescribed for the purpose of the description of A in paragraph 153(1.02)(a) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 10%, or a lower percentage elected by the eligible employer, as defined in subsection 153(1.03), is the percentage prescribed for the purpose of the description of C in paragraph 153(1.02)(b) of the Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: $1,375 is the amount prescribed for the purpose of the description of E in paragraph 153(1.02)(c) of the Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (1.1), every person who makes a payment described in subsection 153(1) of the Act (including an amount paid that is described in subparagraph 153(1)(a)(ii) of the Act) shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of the payment unless an information return in respect of the payment has been made under sections 202, 214, 237 or 238.
Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an annuity payment in respect of an interest in an annuity contract to which subsection 201(5) applies; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount paid by a qualifying non-resident employer to a qualifying non-resident employee that is exempted under subparagraph 153(1)(a)(ii) of the Act if the employer, after reasonable inquiry, has no reason to believe that the employee’s total amount of taxable income earned in Canada under Part I of the Act during the calendar year that includes the time of this payment (including an amount described in paragraph 110(1)(f) of the Act) is more than $10,000.

Subsection.Text: Every person who makes a payment as or on account of, or who confers a benefit or allocates an amount that is,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a scholarship, fellowship or bursary, or a prize for achievement in a field of endeavour ordinarily carried on by the recipient thereof (other than a prize prescribed by section 7700),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a grant to enable the recipient thereof to carry on research or any similar work,

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(n.1) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by paragraph 56(1)(r) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit under regulations made under an appropriation Act providing for a scheme of transitional assistance benefits to persons employed in the production of products to which the Canada-United States Agreement on Automotive Products, signed on January 16, 1965, applies,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit described in section 5502,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: an amount payable to a taxpayer on a periodic basis in respect of the loss of all or any part of his income from an office or employment, pursuant to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a sickness or accident insurance plan,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a disability insurance plan, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an income maintenance insurance plan,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: to or under which his employer has made a contribution,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: an amount or benefit the value of which is required by paragraph 6(1)(a), (e) or (h) or subsection 6(9) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income from an office or employment, other than a payment referred to in subsection (1),

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit the amount of which is required by virtue of subsection 15(5) of the Act to be included in computing a shareholder’s income,

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a benefit deemed by subsection 15(9) of the Act to be a benefit conferred on a shareholder by a corporation, or

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a payment out of a registered education savings plan, other than a refund of payments,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of such payment or benefit except where subsection (3) or (4) applies with respect to the payment or benefit.

Subsection.Text: Where a benefit is included in computing a taxpayer’s income from an office or employment pursuant to paragraph 6(1)(a) or (e) of the Act in respect of an automobile made available to the taxpayer or to a person related to the taxpayer by a person related to the taxpayer’s employer, the employer shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of the benefit.

Where a benefit is included in computing the income of a shareholder of a corporation by virtue of subsection 15(5) of the Act in respect of an automobile made available to the shareholder or to a person related to the shareholder by a person related to the corporation, the corporation shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of the benefit.

Where a particular qualifying person (within the meaning assigned by subsection 7(7) of the Act) has agreed to sell or issue a security (within the meaning assigned by that subsection) of the particular qualifying person (or of a qualifying person with which it does not deal at arm’s length) to a taxpayer who is an employee of the particular qualifying person (or of a qualifying person with which it does not deal at arm’s length) and the taxpayer has acquired the security under the agreement in circumstances to which subsection 7(8) of the Act applied, each of the particular qualifying person, the qualifying person of which the security is acquired and the qualifying person which is the taxpayer’s employer shall, for the particular taxation year in which the security is acquired, make an information return in the prescribed form in respect of the benefit from employment that the taxpayer would be deemed to have received in the particular taxation year in respect of the acquisition of the security if the Act were read without reference to subsection 7(8) and, for this purpose, an information return made by one of the qualifying persons in respect of the taxpayer’s acquisition of the security is deemed to have been made by each of the qualifying persons.

Every person who makes a payment as or on account of an amount that is required by subsection 56(6) of the Act to be included in computing a taxpayer’s income shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of that payment.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every person who makes a payment to a resident of Canada as or on account of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a dividend or an amount deemed by the Act to be a dividend (other than a dividend deemed to have been paid to a person under any of subsections 84(1) to (4) of the Act where, pursuant to subsection 84(8) of the Act, those subsections do not apply to deem the dividend to have been received by the person),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: interest (other than the portion of the interest to which any of subsections (4) to (4.2) applies)

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: on a fully registered bond or debenture,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: money on loan to an association, corporation, institution, organization, partnership or trust,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: money on deposit with an association, corporation, institution, organization, partnership or trust, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: property deposited or placed with an association, corporation, institution, organization, partnership or trust,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of an account with an investment dealer or broker,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: paid by an insurer in connection with an insurance policy or an annuity contract, or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: on an amount owing in respect of compensation for property expropriated,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a royalty payment in respect of the use of a work or invention or a right to take natural resources,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a payment referred to in subsection 16(1) of the Act that can reasonably be regarded as being in part a payment of interest or other payment of an income nature and in part a payment of a capital nature, where the payment is made by a corporation, association, organization or institution,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an amount paid from a person’s NISA Fund No. 2,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: an amount that is required by subsection 148.1(3) of the Act to be added in computing a person’s income for a taxation year, or

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the portion of the price for which a debt obligation was assigned or otherwise transferred that is deemed by subsection 20(14.2) of the Act to be interest that accrued on the debt obligation to which the transferee has become entitled to for a period commencing before the time of the transfer and ending at that particular time that is not payable until after that particular time if the payment is made by a person that is a financial company (whether acting as principal or as agent for the transferee) for the purposes of section 211

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of the portion of such payment for which an information return has not previously been made under this section.

Subsection.Text: Every person who receives as nominee or agent for a person resident in Canada a payment to which subsection (1) applies shall make an information return in prescribed form in respect of such payment.
