Paragraph.Text: the by-product of a pulp or paper plant’s effluent treatment, or its de-inking processes, if that by-product has a solid content of at least 40 per cent before combustion. (déchets d’usines de pâtes ou papiers)

Definition.Text: separated organics means organic waste (other than waste that is considered to be toxic or hazardous waste under any law of Canada or a province) that could be disposed of in an eligible waste management facility or eligible landfill site. (matières organiques séparées)

solid biofuel means a fuel produced all or substantially all from specified waste material that is a solid at a temperature of 15.6°C (60°F) and a pressure of 101 kPa (14.7 psia) (other than charcoal that is used for cooking or fuels with fossil fuel-derived ignition accelerants) and that has undergone

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a thermo-chemical conversion process to increase its carbon fraction and densification; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: densification into pellets or briquettes. (biocarburants solides)

Definition.Text: solution gas means a fossil fuel that is gas that would otherwise be flared and has been extracted from a solution of gas and produced oil. (gaz dissous)

specified waste material means wood waste, plant residue, municipal waste, sludge from an eligible sewage treatment facility, spent pulping liquor, food and animal waste, manure, pulp and paper by-product and separated organics. (déchets déterminés)
spent pulping liquor means the by-product of a chemical process of transforming wood into pulp, consisting of wood residue and pulping agents. (liqueur résiduaire)
thermal waste means waste heat energy extracted from a distinct point of rejection in an industrial process that would otherwise

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: be vented to the atmosphere or transferred to a liquid; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: not be used for a useful purpose. (déchets thermiques)

Definition.Text: transmission equipment means equipment used to transmit electrical energy. (matériel de transmission)

wood waste includes scrap wood, sawdust, wood chips, bark, limbs, saw-ends and hog fuel, but does not include spent pulping liquor and any waste that no longer has the physical or chemical properties of wood. (déchets de bois)

Subsection.Text: Where property of a taxpayer is not operating in the manner required by paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II solely because of a deficiency, failing or shutdown that is beyond the control of the taxpayer of the system of which it is a part and that previously operated in the manner required by that paragraph, as the case may be, that property is deemed, for the purpose of that paragraph, to be operating in the manner required under that paragraph during the period of the deficiency, failing or shutdown, if the taxpayer makes all reasonable efforts to rectify the circumstances within a reasonable time.

For the purpose of subsection (14), a taxpayer’s system referred to in that subsection that has at any particular time operated in the manner required by paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II includes at any time after the particular time a property of another person or partnership if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the property would reasonably be considered to be part of the taxpayer’s system were the property owned by the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the property utilizes heat obtained from the taxpayer’s system;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the operation of the property is necessary for the taxpayer’s system to operate in the manner required by paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II, as the case may be; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at the time that the taxpayer’s system first became operational, the deficiency, failing or shutdown in the operation of the property could not reasonably have been anticipated by the taxpayer to occur within five years after that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (14), a district energy system is deemed to satisfy the requirements of paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II, as the case may be, if the electrical cogeneration equipment that produces the thermal energy used by the system is deemed by subsection (14) to meet the requirements of paragraph (c) of Class 43.1, or paragraph (a) of Class 43.2, in Schedule II, as the case may be.

A property that would otherwise be eligible for inclusion in Class 43.1 or Class 43.2 in Schedule II by a taxpayer is deemed not to be eligible for inclusion in either of those classes if, at the time the property becomes available for use, there is substantial non-compliance by the taxpayer with the requirements of any environmental law, by-law or regulation of Canada, a province, a municipality, or a municipal or public body performing a function of government in Canada that is applicable in respect of the property.

For the purposes of paragraphs 1100(1)(a.3) and (yb), a taxpayer’s income for a taxation year from eligible liquefaction activities in respect of an eligible liquefaction facility of the taxpayer is determined as if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer carried on a separate business

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the only income of which is any combination of:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: in the case of natural gas that is owned by the taxpayer at the time it enters the taxpayer’s eligible liquefaction facility, income from the sale by the taxpayer of the natural gas that has been liquefied, whether sold as liquefied natural gas or regasified natural gas, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: in any other case, income reasonably attributable to the liquefaction of natural gas at the taxpayer’s eligible liquefaction facility, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which the only permitted deductions in computing the separate business’ income are those deductions that are attributable to income described in subparagraph (i) and, in the case of income described in clause (i)(A), that are reasonably attributable to income derived after the natural gas enters the eligible liquefaction facility; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of income described in clause (a)(i)(A), the taxpayer acquired the natural gas that has been liquefied at a cost equal to the fair market value of the natural gas at the time it entered the eligible liquefaction facility.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: The classes of property provided in this Part and in Schedule II are hereby prescribed for the purposes of the Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: DIVISION VII
Heading.TitleText: Certificates Issued by the Minister of Canadian Heritage

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this Division and in paragraph (x) of Class 10 in Schedule II.

Definition.Text: application for a certificate of completion, in respect of a film or video production, means an application by a prescribed taxable Canadian corporation in respect of the production, filed with the Minister of Canadian Heritage before the day (in this Division referred to as “the production’s application deadline”) that is the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 24 months after the end of the corporation’s taxation year in which the production’s principal photography began, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 18 months after the day referred to in paragraph (a), if the corporation has filed, with the Canada Revenue Agency, and provided to the Minister of Canadian Heritage a copy of, a waiver described in subparagraph 152(4)(a)(ii) of the Act, within the normal reassessment period for the corporation in respect of the first and second taxation years ending after the production’s principal photography began. (demande de certificat d’achèvement)

Definition.Text: Canadian means a person that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual who is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a citizen, as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Citizenship Act, of Canada, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a permanent resident, as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that is a Canadian-controlled entity, as determined under sections 26 to 28 of the Investment Canada Act. (Canadien)

Definition.Text: Canadian government film agency means a federal or provincial government agency whose mandate is related to the provision of assistance to film productions in Canada. (agence cinématographique d’État)

certificate of completion, in respect of a film or video production of a corporation, means a certificate certifying that the production has been completed, issued by the Minister of Canadian Heritage before the day (in this Division referred to as “the production’s certification deadline”) that is six months after the production’s application deadline. (certificat d’achèvement)
copyright owner, of a film or video production, at any time means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the maker, as defined in section 2 of the Copyright Act, who at that time owns copyright, in relation to the production, within the meaning of section 3 of that Act; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a person to whom that copyright has been assigned, under an assignment described in section 13 of the Copyright Act, either wholly or partially, by the maker or by another owner to whom this paragraph applied before the assignment. (titulaire du droit d’auteur)

Definition.Text: excluded production means a film or video production, of a particular corporation that is a prescribed taxable Canadian corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular corporation has not filed an application for a certificate of completion before the production’s application deadline,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a certificate of completion has not been issued before the production’s certification deadline,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the production is not a treaty co-production, a person (other than the particular corporation or a prescribed person)

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is a copyright owner of the production for any commercial exploitation purposes at any time during the 25-year period that begins at the earliest time after the production was completed that it is commercially exploitable, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: controls the initial licensing of commercial exploitation,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: there is not an agreement in writing, for consideration at fair market value, to have the production shown in Canada within the 2-year period that begins at the earliest time after the production was completed that it is commercially exploitable,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: with a corporation that is a Canadian and is a distributor of film or video productions, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: with a corporation that holds a broadcasting license issued by the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission for television markets, or

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: distribution is made in Canada within the 2-year period that begins at the earliest time after the production was completed that it is commercially exploitable by a person that is not a Canadian, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: news, current events or public affairs programming, or a programme that includes weather or market reports,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a production in respect of a game, questionnaire or contest (other than a production directed primarily at minors),

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a sports event or activity,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: a gala presentation or an awards show,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: a production that solicits funds,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: reality television,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: pornography,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: advertising,

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: a production produced primarily for industrial, corporate or institutional purposes, or

Subparagraph.Label: (xi)
Subparagraph.Text: a production, other than a documentary, all or substantially all of which consists of stock footage. (production exclue)

Definition.Text: producer means a producer of a film or video production, except that it does not include a person unless the person is the individual who

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: controls and is the central decision maker in respect of the production;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: is directly responsible for the acquisition of the production story or screenplay and the development, creative and financial control and exploitation of the production; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is identified in the production as being the producer of the production. (producteur)

Definition.Text: remuneration means remuneration other than an amount determined by reference to profits or revenues. (rémunération)

twinning arrangement means the pairing of two distinct film or video productions, one of which is a Canadian film or video production and the other of which is a foreign film or video production. (convention de jumelage)

Heading.TitleText: COVID-19 — Application for a Certificate of Completion

Subsection.Text: In respect of applications filed with the Minister of Canadian Heritage in respect of film or video productions for which the labour expenditure of the corporation in respect of the production for the taxation years ending in 2020 or 2021 was greater than nil, the definition application for a certificate of completion in subsection (1) is to be read as follows:

Definition.Text: application for a certificate of completion, in respect of a film or video production, means an application by a prescribed taxable Canadian corporation in respect of the production, filed with the Minister of Canadian Heritage before the day (in this Division referred to as “the production’s application deadline”) that is the later of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 24 months after the end of the corporation’s taxation year in which the production’s principal photography began,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 18 months after the day referred to in paragraph (a), if the corporation has filed, with the Canada Revenue Agency, and provided to the Minister of Canadian Heritage a copy of, a waiver described in subparagraph 152(4)(a)(ii) of the Act, within the normal reassessment period for the corporation in respect of the first and second taxation years ending after the production’s principal photography began, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the day that is 12 months after the day referred to in paragraph (b), if the corporation has filed, with the Canada Revenue Agency, and provided to the Minister of Canadian Heritage a copy of, a waiver described in subparagraph 152(4)(a)(ii) of the Act, within the normal reassessment period for the corporation in respect of the first, second and third taxation years ending after the production’s principal photography began. (demande de certificat d’achèvement)

Subsection.Text: The reference to “2-year period” in subparagraph (a)(iv) of the definition excluded production in subsection (1) is to be read as a reference to “three-year period” in respect of film or video productions for which the labour expenditure of the corporation in respect of the production for the taxation years ending in 2020 or 2021 was greater than nil.
For the purposes of section 125.4 of the Act and this Division, prescribed taxable Canadian corporation means a taxable Canadian corporation that is a Canadian, other than a corporation that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: controlled directly or indirectly in any manner whatever by one or more persons all or part of whose taxable income is exempt from tax under Part I of the Act; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed labour-sponsored venture capital corporation, as defined in section 6701.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Division, treaty co-production means a film or video production whose production is contemplated under any of the following instruments, and to which the instrument applies:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a co-production treaty entered into between Canada and another State;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China on Film and Television Co-Production;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the Common Statement of Policy on Film, Television and Video Co-Productions between Japan and Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Republic of Korea on Television Co-Production;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Republic of Malta on Audio-Visual Relations; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Canada and the Respective Governments of the Flemish, French and German-Speaking Communities of the Kingdom of Belgium concerning Audiovisual Coproduction.

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsections (6) to (9), for the purposes of section 125.4 of the Act, this Part and Schedule II, Canadian film or video production means a film or video production, other than an excluded production, of a prescribed taxable Canadian corporation in respect of which the Minister of Canadian Heritage has issued a certificate (other than a certificate that has been revoked under subsection 125.4(6) of the Act) and that is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a treaty co-production; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a film or video production

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: whose producer is a Canadian at all times during its production,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which the Minister of Canadian Heritage has allotted not less than six points in accordance with subsection (5),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which not less than 75% of the total of all costs for services provided in respect of producing the production (other than excluded costs) was payable in respect of services provided to or by individuals who are Canadians, and for the purpose of this subparagraph, excluded costs are

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: costs determined by reference to the amount of income from the production,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: remuneration payable to, or in respect of, the producer or individuals described in any of subparagraphs (5)(a)(i) to (viii) and (b)(i) to (vi) and paragraph (5)(c) (including any individuals that would be described in paragraph (5)(c) if they were Canadians),

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: amounts payable in respect of insurance, financing, brokerage, legal and accounting fees, and similar amounts, and

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: costs described in subparagraph (iv), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: in respect of which not less than 75% of the total of all costs incurred for the post-production of the production, including laboratory work, sound re-recording, sound editing and picture editing, (other than costs that are determined by reference to the amount of income from the production and remuneration that is payable to, or in respect of, the producer or individuals described in any of subparagraphs (5)(a)(i) to (viii) and (b)(i) to (vi) and paragraph (5)(c), including any individuals that would be described in paragraph (5)(c) if they were Canadians) was incurred in respect of services provided in Canada.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Division, the Minister of Canadian Heritage shall allot, in respect of a film or video production

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is not an animation production, in respect of each of the following persons if that person is an individual who is a Canadian,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the director, two points,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the screenwriter, two points,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the lead performer for whose services the highest remuneration was payable, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: for the lead performer for whose services the second highest remuneration was payable, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: for the art director, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: for the director of photography, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the music composer, one point, and

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the picture editor, one point;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is an animation production, in respect of each of the following persons if that person is an individual who is a Canadian,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the director, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the lead voice for which the highest or second highest remuneration was payable, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the design supervisor, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: for the camera operator where the camera operation is done in Canada, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: for the music composer, one point, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: for the picture editor, one point;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that is an animation production, one point if both the principal screenwriter and the storyboard supervisor are individuals who are Canadians; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that is an animation production, in respect of each of the following places if that place is in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the place where the layout and background work is done, one point,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the place where the key animation is done, one point, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the place where the assistant animation and in-betweening is done, one point.

Subsection.Text: A production (other than a production that is an animation production or a treaty co-production) is a Canadian film or video production only if there is allotted in respect of the production two points under subparagraph (5)(a)(i) or (ii) and one point under subparagraph (5)(a)(iii) or (iv).
An animation production (other than a production that is a treaty co-production) is a Canadian film or video production only if there is allotted, in respect of the production,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: one point under subparagraph (5)(b)(i) or paragraph (5)(c);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: one point under subparagraph (5)(b)(ii); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: one point under subparagraph (5)(d)(ii).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Division,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a lead performer in respect of a production is an actor or actress who has a leading role in the production having regard to the performer’s remuneration, billing and time on screen;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a lead voice in respect of an animation production is the voice of the individual who has a leading role in the production having regard to the length of time that the individual’s voice is heard in the production and the individual’s remuneration; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where a person who is not a Canadian participates in the writing and preparation of the screenplay for a production, the screenwriter is not a Canadian unless the principal screenwriter is an individual who is otherwise a Canadian, the screenplay for the production is based upon a work authored by a Canadian, and the work is published in Canada.

Subsection.Text: A documentary production that is not an excluded production, and that is allotted less than six points because one or more of the positions referred to in paragraph (5)(a) is unoccupied, is a Canadian film or video production if all of the positions described in that paragraph that are occupied in respect of the production are occupied by individuals who are Canadians.
For the purpose of section 125.4 of the Act and this Division, prescribed person means any of the following:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that holds a television, specialty or pay-television broadcasting licence issued by the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that holds a broadcast undertaking licence and that provides production funding as a result of a “significant benefits” commitment given to the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a person to which paragraph 149(1)(l) of the Act applies and that has a fund that is used to finance Canadian film or video productions;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a Canadian government film agency;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a film or video production, a non-resident person that does not carry on a business in Canada through a permanent establishment in Canada and whose interest (or, for civil law, right) in the production is acquired to comply with the certification requirements of a treaty co-production twinning arrangement;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a person

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to which paragraph 149(1)(f) of the Act applies,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that has a fund that is used to finance Canadian film or video productions, all or substantially all of which financing is provided by way of a direct ownership interest (or, for civil law, right) in those productions, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: that, after 1996, has received donations only from persons described in any of paragraphs (a) to (e);

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a prescribed taxable Canadian corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: an individual who is a Canadian; and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership, each member of which is described in any of paragraphs (a) to (h).

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of the definition assistance in subsection 125.4(1) of the Act, prescribed amount means an amount paid or payable to a taxpayer under the License Fee Program of the Canadian Television Fund or as a licence-fee top-up contribution from the Canada Media Fund.
For the purpose of the definition copyright owner in subsection (1),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the right of a person to share in the revenues from or proceeds of disposition of an interest or, for civil law, a right, in a film or video production is not, in and by itself, an interest or right as a copyright owner of the production; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for greater certainty, a grant of an exclusive licence, within the meaning assigned by the Copyright Act, is not an assignment of a copyright.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purpose of the definition bituminous sands in subsection 248(1) of the Act, viscosity or density of hydrocarbons shall be determined using a number of individual samples (constituting a representative sampling of that deposit or those deposits, as the case may be, from which the taxpayer is committed to produce by means of one mine) tested

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at atmospheric pressure;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: at a temperature of 15.6 degrees Celsius; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: free of solution gas.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of section 65 of the Act, there may be deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year such of the amounts determined in accordance with sections 1201 to 1209 and 1212 as are applicable.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: In computing a taxpayer’s income for a taxation year there may be deducted such amount as he may claim not exceeding the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: 25 per cent of the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s resource profits for the year exceed four times the total of amounts, if any, deducted under subsection 1202(2) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of amounts included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year under paragraphs 59(3.3)(a) and (b) of the Act exceeds the aggregate of amounts, if any, that may reasonably be considered to have been deducted under subsection 1202(2) by reason of subparagraph (b)(ii) thereof in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s earned depletion base as of the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the aggregate determined under paragraph 1202(4)(a) in respect of the taxpayer for the year

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: exceeds

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: the aggregate of all amounts that would be determined under paragraphs 1205(1)(e) to (k)

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: 33 1/3 per cent of the aggregate of all amounts that would be determined under paragraphs 1205(1)(a) to (d.2)

ContinuedClause.Text: in computing the taxpayer’s earned depletion base as of the end of the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of computing the earned depletion base of a corporation, control of which has been acquired under circumstances described in subsection 66(11) of the Act, the amount by which the earned depletion base of the corporation at the time referred to in that subsection exceeds the aggregate of amounts otherwise deducted under section 1201 in computing its income for taxation years ending after that time and before control was so acquired shall be deemed to have been deducted under section 1201 by the corporation in computing its income for taxation years ending before such acquisition of control.

Subject to subsections (5) and (6), where after November 7, 1969 a corporation (in this subsection referred to as the “successor”) acquired a particular property (whether by way of a purchase, amalgamation, merger, winding-up or otherwise), there may be deducted by the successor in computing its income for a taxation year an amount not exceeding the aggregate of all amounts each of which is an amount determined in respect of an original owner of the particular property that is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the earned depletion base of the original owner immediately after the original owner disposed of the particular property (determined as if, in the case of a disposition after April 28, 1978 as a result of an amalgamation described in section 87 of the Act, the original owner existed after the time of disposition and no property was acquired or disposed of in the course of the amalgamation) to the extent of the amount thereof that was not

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: deducted by the original owner or any predecessor owner of the particular property in computing income for any taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: deducted by the successor in computing income for a preceding taxation year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: otherwise deducted by the successor in computing income for the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 25 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the part of the successor’s income for the year that can reasonably be regarded as attributable to

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the part of any amount included under paragraph 59(3.2)(c) of the Act in computing its income for the year that can reasonably be regarded as attributable to the disposition by it in the year or a preceding taxation year of any interest in or right to the particular property, to the extent that the proceeds of the disposition have not been included in determining an amount under this clause, paragraph (7)(g), clause 29(25)(d)(i)(A) of the Income Tax Application Rules or clause 66.7(1)(b)(i)(A) or (3)(b)(i)(A) or paragraph 66.7(10)(g) of the Act for a preceding taxation year,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: its reserve amount for the year in respect of the original owner and each predecessor owner, if any, of the particular property,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: production from the particular property, or

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: processing described in subparagraph 1204(1)(b)(iii), (iv) or (v) with the particular property

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: computed as if no deduction were allowed under section 29 of the Income Tax Application Rules or under any of sections 65 to 66.7 of the Act and as if that income did not include any amount designated under clause 66.7(2)(b)(ii)(A) of the Act,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: four times the total of all other amounts deducted under this subsection for the year that can reasonably be regarded as attributable to the part of the successor’s income for the year described in subparagraph (i), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is an amount deducted under subsection 66.7(1), (3), (4) or (5) of the Act or subsection 29(25) of the Income Tax Application Rules for the year that can reasonably be regarded as attributable to the part of the successor’s income for the year described in subparagraph (i).

Subsection.Text: Where in a taxation year ending after February 17, 1987 an original owner of a property disposes of the property in circumstances in which subsection (2) applies,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of the earned depletion base of the original owner determined immediately after the time of that disposition shall be deducted in determining the earned depletion base of the original owner at any time after the time that is immediately after the disposition;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purposes of paragraph (2)(a), the earned depletion base of the original owner determined immediately after the original owner disposed of the property that was deducted in computing the original owner’s income for the year shall be deemed to be equal to the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount deducted in respect of the disposition under paragraph (a), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the specified amount determined under subsection (4) in respect of the original owner for the year

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: exceeds

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is an amount determined under this paragraph in respect of any disposition made by the original owner before the disposition and in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for greater certainty, any amount (other than the amount determined under paragraph (b)) that was deducted under section 1201 by the original owner for the year or a subsequent taxation year shall, for the purposes of paragraph (2)(a), be deemed not to be in respect of the earned depletion base of the original owner determined immediately after the original owner disposed of the particular property.

Subsection.Text: Where in a taxation year ending after February 17, 1987 an original owner of a property disposes of the property in circumstances in which subsection (2) applies, the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount deducted under paragraph (3)(a) in respect of such a disposition in the year by the original owner

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, designated by the original owner in a prescribed form filed with the Minister within six months after the end of the year in respect of the amount determined under subparagraph (i), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, deducted under section 1201 in computing the income of the original owner for the taxation year

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: is the specified amount in respect of the original owner for the year for the purposes of paragraphs (3)(b) and 1205(1)(d.2).

Subsection.Text: Subsections (2), 1203(3), 1207(7) and 1212(4) do not apply

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a property acquired by way of an amalgamation or winding-up to which section 1214 applies;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: to permit, in respect of the acquisition by a corporation before February 18, 1987 of a property, a deduction by the corporation of an amount that the corporation would not have been entitled to deduct under this Part, if this Part, as it read in its application to taxation years ending before February 18, 1987, applied to taxation years ending after February 17, 1987; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a property acquired by purchase, amalgamation, merger, winding-up or otherwise, from a person who is exempt from tax under Part I of the Act on that person’s taxable income.

Subsection.Text: Subsections (2), 1203(3), 1207(7) and 1212(4) apply only to a corporation that has acquired a particular property

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where it acquired the particular property in a taxation year commencing before 1985 and, at the time it acquired the particular property, the corporation acquired the specified property of the person from whom it acquired the particular property;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where it acquired the particular property from a person in a taxation year commencing after 1984 and, at the time it acquired the particular property, the corporation acquired

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all or substantially all of the Canadian resource properties of that person, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where subparagraph (i) does not apply, the specified property of the person;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where it acquired (other than in circumstances in which subparagraph (b)(ii) applies) the particular property after November 16, 1978 and in a taxation year ending before February 18, 1987 by any means other than by way of an amalgamation or winding-up and it and the person from whom it acquired the particular property have filed with the Minister a joint election under and in accordance with any of subsections 66(6), 66.1(4), 66.1(5), 66.2(3), 66.2(4), 66.4(3), and 66.4(4) of the Act as those subsections read in their application to that year;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where it acquired the particular property after June 5, 1987 by way of an amalgamation or winding-up (other than in circumstances in which subparagraph (b)(ii) applies) and it has filed an election in the form prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 66.7(7)(c) of the Act with the Minister on or before the day on or before which the corporation is required to file a return of income pursuant to section 150 of the Act for its taxation year in which it acquired the particular property;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where it acquired the particular property (other than by means of an amalgamation or winding-up or in circumstances in which subparagraph (b)(ii) applies) in a taxation year ending after February 17, 1987 and it and the person from whom it acquired the particular property have filed a joint election in the form prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 66.7(7)(e) of the Act with the Minister on or before the earlier of the days on or before which either of them is required to file a return of income pursuant to section 150 of the Act in respect of the irrespective taxation years that include the time of acquisition of the particular property; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: where it acquired (other than by way of an amalgamation or winding-up) the particular property in circumstances in which subparagraph (b)(ii) applies and it and the person from whom it acquired the particular property agree to have subsection (2), 1203(3), 1207(7) or 1212(4), as the case may be, apply to them and notify the Minister in writing of the agreement in their returns of income under Part I of the Act for their respective taxation years that include the time of acquisition of the particular property.

Subsection.Text: Where at any time after November 12, 1981

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: control of a corporation is considered for the purposes of subsection 66.7(10) of the Act to have been acquired by a person or group of persons, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation ceases to be exempt from tax under Part I of the Act on its taxable income,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: for the purposes of section 1201, this section and section 1205,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation shall be deemed after that time to be a successor (within the meaning assigned by subsection (2)) that had, at that time, acquired all the properties owned by the corporation immediately before that time from an original owner thereof;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a joint election shall be deemed to have been filed in accordance with subsection (6) in respect of the acquisition;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the earned depletion base of the corporation immediately before that time shall be deemed not to be the earned depletion base of the corporation immediately after that time but to be the earned depletion base of the original owner immediately after that time;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: where the corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “transferee”) was, immediately before and at that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a parent corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1.4) of the Act), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a subsidiary wholly-owned corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1.4) of the Act)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: of a particular corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “transferor”), if both corporations agree to have this paragraph apply to them in respect of a taxation year of the transferor ending after that time and notify the Minister in writing of the agreement in the return of income under Part I of the Act of the transferor for that year, the transferor may, if throughout that year the transferee was such a parent corporation or subsidiary wholly-owned corporation of the transferor, designate in favour of the transferee, in respect of that year, for the purpose of making a deduction under subsection (2) in respect of expenditures incurred by the transferee before that time and when it was such a parent corporation or subsidiary wholly-owned corporation of the transferor, an amount not exceeding such portion of the amount that would be its income for the year, if no deductions were allowed under any of section 29 of the Income Tax Application Rules, and sections 65 to 66.7 of the Act, that may reasonably be regarded as being attributable to

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the production from Canadian resource properties owned by the transferor immediately before that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the disposition in the year of any Canadian resource properties owned by the transferor immediately before that time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: such processing as is described in subparagraph 1204(1)(b)(iii), (iv), or (v) with property owned by the transferor immediately before that time

ContinuedParagraph.Text: to the extent that such portion of the amount so designated is not designated under this paragraph in favour of any other taxpayer or under paragraph 66.7(10)(g) of the Act in favour of any taxpayer, and the amount so designated shall be deemed, for the purposes of determining the amount under subsection (2),

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: to be income from the sources described in subparagraph (iii), (iv) or (v), as the case may be, of the transferee for its taxation year in which that taxation year of the transferor ends, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: not to be income from the sources described in subparagraph (iii), (iv) or (v), as the case may be, of the transferor for that year;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: where, immediately before and at that time, the corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “transferee”) and another corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “transferor”) were both subsidiary wholly-owned corporations (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1.4) of the Act) of a particular parent corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1.4) of the Act), if the transferee and the transferor agree to have this paragraph apply to them in respect of a taxation year of the transferor ending after that time and notify the Minister in writing of the agreement in the return of income under Part I of the Act of the transferor for that year, paragraph (g) shall apply for that year to the transferee and transferor as though one were the parent corporation (within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1.4) of the Act) of the other; and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: where that time is after January 15, 1987 and at that time the corporation was a member of a partnership that owned a property at that time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of paragraph (c), the corporation shall be deemed to have owned immediately before that time that portion of the property owned by the partnership at that time that is equal to its percentage share of the aggregate of amounts that would be paid to all members of the partnership if it were wound up at that time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: for the purposes of clauses (2)(b)(i)(C) and (D) for a taxation year ending after that time, the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: its share of the part of the income of the partnership for the fiscal period of the partnership ending in the year that may reasonably be regarded as being attributable to the production from the property or to such processing as is described in subparagraph 1204(1)(b)(iii), (iv) or (v) with the property, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an amount that would be determined under clause (A) for the year if its share of the income of the partnership for the fiscal year of the partnership were determined on the basis of the percentage share referred to in subparagraph (i)

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: shall be deemed to be income of the corporation for the year that may reasonably be attributable to production from the property or to such processing as is described in subparagraph 1204(1)(b)(iii), (iv) or (v) with the property.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsections (1) and (7), where a corporation acquired control of another corporation after November 12, 1981 and before 1983 by reason of the acquisition of shares of the other corporation pursuant to an agreement in writing concluded on or before November 12, 1981, the corporation shall be deemed to have acquired such control on or before November 12, 1981.
Where, at any time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: control of a taxpayer that is a corporation has been acquired by a person or group of persons,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer has disposed of all or substantially all of the taxpayer’s Canadian resource properties, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer has disposed of the specified property of the taxpayer,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and, before that time, the taxpayer or a partnership of which the taxpayer was a member acquired a property and it may reasonably be considered that one of the main purposes of the acquisition was to avoid any limitation provided in subsection (2) on the deduction in respect of the earned depletion base of the taxpayer or of a corporation referred to as a transferee in paragraph (7)(g) or (h), the taxpayer or the partnership, as the case may be, shall be deemed, for the purposes of applying subsection (2) to or in respect of the taxpayer, not to have acquired the property.

Subsection.Text: Where in a particular taxation year a predecessor owner of a property disposes of it to a corporation in circumstances in which subsection (2) applies, for the purposes of applying subsection (2) to the predecessor owner for a taxation year ending after February 17, 1987 in respect of its acquisition of the property, the predecessor owner shall be deemed, after the disposition, never to have acquired the property except for the purposes of making a deduction under subsection (2) for the particular year.

Where at any time a property is acquired by a person in circumstances in which subsection (2) does not apply, every person who was an original owner or predecessor owner of the property by reason of having disposed of the property before that time shall, for the purposes of applying this Part to or in respect of the person or any other person who after that time acquires the property, be deemed after that time not to be an original owner or predecessor owner of the property by reason of having disposed of the property before that time.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In computing a taxpayer’s income for a taxation year there may be deducted such amount as he may claim not exceeding the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 25 per cent of his income for the year, computed in accordance with Part I of the Act without reference to paragraph 59(3.3)(f) thereof and on the assumption that no deduction were allowed under section 65 thereof, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount, if any, included in computing his income for the year by virtue of paragraph 59(3.3)(f) of the Act

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of amounts deducted under sections 1201, 1202, 1207 and 1212 in computing his income for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: his mining exploration depletion base as of the end of the year (before making any deduction under this subsection for the year).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, mining exploration depletion base of a taxpayer as of a particular time means the amount by which the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 33 1/3 per cent of the amount by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which was the stated percentage of an expenditure that is, or but for paragraph 66(12.61)(b) of the Act would be, incurred by the taxpayer after April 19, 1983 and before the particular time and each of which was a Canadian exploration expense

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: described in subparagraph 66.1(6) (a)(iii) of the Act, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: that would have been described in subparagraph 66.1(6) (a)(iv) or (v) of the Act if the references in those subparagraphs to “any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii.1)” were read as “subparagraph (iii)”,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: other than an expense described in clause (A) or (B) that was

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: an expense renounced by the taxpayer under subsection 66(10.1) or (12.6) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an amount that was a Canadian exploration and development overhead expense of the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: an amount that was in respect of financing, including any cost incurred prior to the commencement of carrying on a business, or

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: an eligible expense within the meaning of the Canadian Exploration Incentive Program Act in respect of which the taxpayer, a partnership of which the taxpayer was a member or a principal-business corporation of which the taxpayer was a shareholder, has received, is deemed to have received, is entitled to receive or may reasonably be expected to receive at any time an incentive under that Act,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the stated percentage of an amount of assistance (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 66(15)(a.1) of the Act) that any person has received, is entitled to receive or, at any time, becomes entitled to receive in respect of an expense that would be described in subparagraph (i) if that subparagraph were read without reference to clause (C) thereof, other than such an amount in respect of an expense renounced under subsection 66(10.1) or (12.6) of the Act

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: by a corporation in favour of the taxpayer, where the amount of that assistance is excluded from the aggregate in respect of which the expense is so renounced, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: by the taxpayer, where the amount of that assistance is not excluded from the aggregate in respect of which the expense is so renounced, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a successor corporation, any amount required by paragraph (3)(a) to be added before the particular time in computing the taxpayer’s mining exploration depletion base

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts each of which is an amount deducted by the taxpayer under subsection (1) in computing his income for a taxation year ending before the particular time; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a predecessor, all amounts required by paragraph (3)(b) to be deducted before the particular time in computing the taxpayer’s mining exploration depletion base.

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsections 1202(5) and (6), where a corporation (in this section referred to as the “successor corporation”) has at any time (in this subsection referred to as the “time of acquisition”) after April 19, 1983 and in a taxation year (in this subsection referred to as the “transaction year”) acquired a property from another person (in this subsection referred to as the “predecessor”), the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the purpose of computing the mining exploration depletion base of the successor corporation as of any time after the time of acquisition, there shall be added an amount equal to the amount required by paragraph (b) to be deducted in computing the mining exploration depletion base of the predecessor; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the purpose of computing the mining exploration depletion base of the predecessor as of any time after the transaction year of the predecessor, there shall be deducted the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the mining exploration depletion base of the predecessor immediately after the time of acquisition (assuming for this purpose that, in the case of an acquisition as a result of an amalgamation described in section 87 of the Act, the predecessor existed after the time of acquisition and no property was acquired or disposed of in the course of the amalgamation)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, deducted under subsection (1) in computing the income of the predecessor for the transaction year of the predecessor.

Subsection.Text: For greater certainty, where an expense incurred before a particular time is included in the aggregate calculated under subparagraph (2)(a)(i) in respect of a taxpayer and subsequent to the particular time any person becomes entitled to receive an amount of assistance (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 66(15)(a.1) of the Act) that is included in the aggregate calculated under subparagraph (2)(a)(ii), the stated percentage of the amount of assistance shall be included in the amounts referred to in subparagraph (2)(a)(ii) in respect of the taxpayer at the time the expense was incurred.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, gross resource profits of a taxpayer for a taxation year means the amount, if any, by which the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of amounts, if any, that would be included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year by virtue of subsection 59(2) and paragraphs 59(3.2)(b) and 59.1(b) of the Act if subsection 59(2) were read without reference to subsection 64(1) therein, and

Subparagraph.Label: (i.1)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the amount included in computing his income for the year by virtue of paragraph 59(3.2)(c) of the Act exceeds the proceeds of disposition of property described in clause 66(15)(c)(ii)(A) of the Act that became receivable in the year or a preceding taxation year and after December 31, 1982 to the extent that such proceeds have not been deducted in determining the amount under this subparagraph for a preceding taxation year

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of amounts, if any, deducted in computing his income for the year by virtue of paragraph 59.1(a) and subsections 64(1.1) and (1.2) of the Act,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, of the aggregate of his incomes for the year from

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the production of petroleum, natural gas, related hydrocarbons or sulphur from

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: oil or gas wells in Canada operated by the taxpayer, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: natural accumulations (other than mineral resources) of petroleum or natural gas in Canada operated by the taxpayer,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the production and processing in Canada of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from mineral resources in Canada operated by him to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: iron ore from mineral resources in Canada operated by him to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: tar sands ore from mineral resources in Canada operated by him to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the processing in Canada of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from mineral resources in Canada not operated by him to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: iron ore from mineral resources in Canada not operated by him to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: tar sands ore from mineral resources in Canada not operated by him to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the processing in Canada of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from mineral resources outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: iron ore from mineral resources outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: tar sands ore from mineral resources outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: the processing in Canada of heavy crude oil recovered from an oil or gas well in Canada to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: Canadian field processing,

Paragraph.Label: (b.1)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts (other than an amount included because of paragraph (b) in computing the taxpayer’s gross resource profits for the year) each of which is an amount included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year as a rental or royalty computed by reference to the amount or value of production from a natural accumulation of petroleum or natural gas in Canada, an oil or gas well in Canada or a mineral resource in Canada, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer owns all the issued and outstanding shares of the capital stock of a railway company throughout the year, the amount that may reasonably be considered to be the railway company’s income for its taxation year ending in the year from the transportation of such of the taxpayer’s ore as is described in clause (b)(ii)(A), (B) or (C),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds the aggregate of the taxpayer’s losses for the year from the sources described in paragraph (b), where the taxpayer’s incomes and losses are computed in accordance with the Act on the assumption that the taxpayer had during the year no incomes or losses except from those sources and was allowed no deductions in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year other than

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: amounts deductible under section 66 of the Act (other than amounts in respect of foreign exploration and development expenses) or subsection 17(2) or (6) or section 29 of the Income Tax Application Rules, for the year;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the amounts deductible or deducted, as the case may be, under section 66.1, 66.2 (other than an amount that is in respect of a property described in clause 66(15)(c)(ii)(A) of the Act), 66.4, 66.5 or 66.7 (other than subsection (2) thereof) of the Act for the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: any other deductions for the year that can reasonably be regarded as applicable to the sources of income described in paragraph (b) or (b.1), other than a deduction under paragraph 20(1)(ss) or (tt) of the Act or section 1201 or subsection 1202(2), 1203(1), 1207(1) or 1212(1).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, resource profits of a taxpayer for a taxation year means the amount, if any, by which the taxpayer’s gross resource profits for the year exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year other than

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount deducted in computing the taxpayer’s gross resource profits for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount deducted under any of section 8, paragraphs 20(1)(ss) and (tt), sections 60 to 64 and subsections 66(4), 66.7(2) and 104(6) and (12) of the Act and section 1201 and subsections 1202(2), 1203(1), 1207(1) and 1212(1) in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount deducted under section 66.2 of the Act in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, to the extent that it is attributable to any right, licence or privilege to store underground petroleum, natural gas or related hydrocarbons in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year from a business, or other source, that does not include any resource activity of the taxpayer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount deducted in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, to the extent that the amount

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: relates to an activity

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that is not a resource activity of the taxpayer, and

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that is

Subsubclause.Text: the production, processing, manufacturing, distribution, marketing, transportation or sale of any property,
carried out for the purpose of earning income from property, or
the rendering of a service by the taxpayer to another person for the purpose of earning income of the taxpayer, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: does not relate to a resource activity of the taxpayer,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts each of which is the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would have been charged to the taxpayer by a person or partnership with whom the taxpayer was not dealing at arm’s length if the taxpayer and that person or partnership had been dealing at arm’s length

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: for the use after March 6, 1996 and in the year of a property (other than money) owned by that person or partnership, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: for the provision after March 6, 1996 and in the year by that person or partnership of a service to the taxpayer

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount charged to the taxpayer for the use of that property or the provision of that service in that period, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the portion of the amount described in subparagraph (i) that, if it had been charged, would not have been deductible in computing the taxpayer’s resource profits, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where the year ends after February 21, 1994, all amounts added under subsection 80(13) of the Act in computing the taxpayer’s gross resource profits for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (1.1)(b) and this subsection,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a taxpayer is considered not to deal at arm’s length with a partnership where the taxpayer does not deal at arm’s length with any member of the partnership;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership is considered not to deal at arm’s length with another partnership where any member of the first partnership does not deal at arm’s length with any member of the second partnership;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where a taxpayer is a member, or is deemed by this paragraph to be a member, of a partnership that is a member of another partnership, the taxpayer is deemed to be a member of the other partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the provision of a service to a taxpayer does not include the provision of a service by an individual in the individual’s capacity as an employee of the taxpayer.

Subsection.Text: For greater certainty, for the purposes of this section, in computing the income or loss of a trust for a taxation year from the sources described in paragraphs (1)(b) and (b.1), no deduction shall be made in respect of amounts deductible by the trust pursuant to subsection 104(6) or (12) of the Act.
A taxpayer’s income or loss from a source described in paragraph (1)(b) does not include

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: any income or loss derived from transporting, transmitting or processing (other than processing described in clause (1)(b)(ii)(C), (iii)(C) or (iv)(C) or subparagraph (1)(b)(v) or (vi)) petroleum, natural gas or related hydrocarbons or sulphur from a natural accumulation of petroleum or natural gas;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: any income or loss arising because of the application of paragraph 12(1)(z.1) or (z.2) or section 107.3 of the Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any income or loss that can reasonably be attributable to a service rendered by the taxpayer (other than processing described in subparagraph (1)(b)(iii), (iv), (v) or (vi) or activities carried out by the taxpayer as a coal mine operator).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part earned depletion base of a taxpayer as of a particular time means the amount by which 33 1/3 per cent of the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts, in respect of expenditures (other than expenditures to acquire property under circumstances that entitled the taxpayer to a deduction under section 1202 or would so entitle the taxpayer if the amounts referred to in paragraphs 1202(2)(a) and (b) were sufficient for the purpose) incurred by the taxpayer after November 7, 1969 and before the particular time, each of which was

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a Canadian exploration and development expense or would have been such an expense if it had been incurred after 1971 and was actually incurred before May 7, 1974, other than

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a cost of borrowing capital, including any cost incurred prior to the commencement of carrying on a business, that was a Canadian exploration expense or an exploration, prospecting and development expense, as the case may be, of the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the cost to the taxpayer of any Canadian resource property acquired by the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a Canadian exploration and development expense that was incurred after a mine had come into production in reasonable commercial quantities and may reasonably be considered to be related to the mine or to a potential or actual extension thereof,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an expense that would have been described in clause (C) if it had been incurred after 1971,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: an expense renounced by the taxpayer under subsection 66(10) of the Act or subsection 29(7) of the Income Tax Application Rules,

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: an amount that, by virtue of subparagraph 66(15)(b)(iv) of the Act, was a Canadian exploration and development expense or would have been such an expense if it had been incurred after 1971, if such amount was a cost or expense referred to in clause (A), (B), (C), (D) or (E) that was incurred by an association, partnership or syndicate referred to in that subparagraph, or

Clause.Label: (G)
Clause.Text: an amount that, by virtue of subparagraph 66(15)(b)(v) of the Act, was a Canadian exploration and development expense or would have been such an expense if it had been incurred after 1971, if such amount was a cost or expense referred to in clause (A), (B), (C), (D) or (E) that the taxpayer incurred pursuant to an agreement referred to in that subparagraph,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the stated percentage of a Canadian exploration expense other than

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a cost of borrowing capital, including any cost incurred prior to the commencement of carrying on a business, that was a Canadian exploration expense of the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an expense renounced by the taxpayer under subsection 66(10.1) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: an amount that, by virtue of subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(iv) of the Act, was a Canadian exploration expense, if such amount was an expense referred to in clause (A), (B), (E), (F), (G) or (H) that was incurred by a partnership referred to in that subparagraph,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an amount that, by virtue of subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(v) of the Act, was a Canadian exploration expense, if such amount was an expense referred to in clause (A), (B), (E), (F), (G), or (H) that the taxpayer incurred pursuant to an agreement referred to in that subparagraph,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: an amount described in clause 66.1(6)(a)(ii)(B) or (ii.1) (B) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: an amount that was a Canadian exploration and development overhead expense of the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (G)
Clause.Text: an amount that was a Canadian oil and gas exploration expense of the taxpayer, or

Clause.Label: (H)
Clause.Text: an expense described in subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(iii) of the Act incurred after April 19, 1983,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a Canadian development expense incurred before 1981 other than

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a cost of borrowing capital, including any cost incurred prior to the commencement of carrying on a business, that was a Canadian development expense of the taxpayer,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an expense renounced by the taxpayer under subsection 66(10.2) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: an amount referred to in subparagraph 66.2(5)(a)(iii) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an amount that, by virtue of subparagraph 66.2(5)(a)(iv) of the Act, was a Canadian development expense, if such amount was an expense referred to in clause (A), (B) or (C) that was incurred by a partnership referred to in that subparagraph, or

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: an amount that, by virtue of subparagraph 66.2(5)(a)(v) of the Act, was a Canadian development expense, if such amount was an expense referred to in clause (A), (B) or (C) that the taxpayer incurred pursuant to an agreement referred to in that subparagraph,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: the stated percentage of the capital cost to the taxpayer of any processing property acquired by the taxpayer principally for the purpose of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: processing in Canada

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from a qualified resource to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: iron ore from a qualified resource to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, or

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: tar sands ore from a qualified resource to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: processing in Canada

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: ore, other than iron ore or tar sands ore, from an exporting resource beyond the furthest stage to which such ore or similar ore from that resource was ordinarily processed in Canada before such acquisition but not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: iron ore from an exporting resource beyond the furthest stage to which such ore or similar ore from that resource was ordinarily processed in Canada before such acquisition but not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent, or

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: tar sands ore from an exporting resource beyond the furthest stage to which such ore or similar ore from that resource was ordinarily processed in Canada before such acquisition but not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a corporation that incurred a Canadian oil and gas exploration expense in respect of conventional lands in a calendar year after 1980 and before 1984, the specified percentage for that year of such expense to the extent that it is not an amount or expense referred to in clause (ii)(A), (B) or (F) or an expense that would be referred to in clause (ii)(C) or (D) if the references in those clauses to “clause (A), (B), (E), (F), (G) or (H)” were read as “clause (A), (B) or (F)”, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: where the taxpayer is a corporation,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the specified percentage in respect of a Canadian oil and gas exploration expense in respect of non-conventional lands incurred in a calendar year after 1980 and before 1985 to the extent that it is not an amount or expense referred to in clause (ii)(A), (B) or (F) or an expense that would be referred to in clause (ii)(C) or (D) if the references in those clauses to “clause (A), (B), (E), (F), (G) or (H)” were read as “clause (A), (B) or (F)”,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the stated percentage of a Canadian development expense incurred after 1980 in respect of a qualified tertiary oil recovery project of the taxpayer to the extent that such expense is not

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: an amount or expense described in any of clauses (iii)(A) to (E),

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: an amount that was a Canadian exploration and development overhead expense of the taxpayer, or

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: an eligible expense within the meaning of the Canadian Exploration and Development Incentive Program Act in respect of which the taxpayer, a partnership of which the taxpayer was a member, a principal-business corporation of which the taxpayer was a shareholder or a joint exploration corporation of which the taxpayer was a shareholder corporation has received, is entitled to receive or may reasonably be expected to receive at any time an incentive under that Act,

Clause.Label: (B.1)
Clause.Text: the stated percentage of a Canadian exploration expense incurred after 1981 in respect of a qualified tertiary oil recovery project of the taxpayer that

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: would be referred to in subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(ii) or (ii.1) of the Act if subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(ii) were read without reference to clause (B) thereof, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: would be referred to in subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(iv) or (v) of the Act if the Act were read without reference to clause 66.1(6)(a)(ii)(B) and subparagraphs 66.1(6)(a)(i), (i.1), (ii.2), (iii) and (iii.1),

ContinuedClause.Text: other than the portion of such expense referred to in subclause (I) or (II) that is

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: described in any of clauses (ii)(A) to (D) and (F),

Subclause.Label: (IV)
Subclause.Text: included in the amount determined under subparagraph (v) or clause (vi)(A),

Subclause.Label: (V)
Subclause.Text: described in subclause (B)(III), or

Subclause.Label: (VI)
