ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the total of all amounts that may be included in computing the total described in subsection (4) in respect of salaries or wages of the individual by the taxpayer in its taxation year ending in the calendar year and by all associated corporations in their taxation years ending in the calendar year shall not exceed the amount that is 2.5 times the Year’s Maximum Pensionable Earnings (as determined under section 18 of the Canada Pension Plan) for the calendar year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsections (4) and (7), an amount incurred in respect of salary or wages of an employee in a taxation year does not include

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount described in section 6 or 7 of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount deemed under subsection 78(4) of the Act to have been incurred;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: bonuses; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: remuneration based on profits.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (8),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an individual related to a particular corporation, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership any member of which is an individual related to a particular corporation or is a corporation associated with a particular corporation,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: shall be deemed to be a corporation associated with the particular corporation.

Subsection.Text: The depreciable property of a taxpayer that is prescribed for the purposes of the definition first term shared-use-equipment in subsection 127(9) of the Act is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a building of the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a leasehold interest of the taxpayer in a building;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a property of the taxpayer if, at the time it was acquired by the taxpayer, the taxpayer or a person related to the taxpayer intended that it would be used in the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development during the assembly, construction or commissioning of a facility, plant or line for commercial manufacturing, commercial processing or other commercial purposes (other than scientific research and experimental development) and intended

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that it would be used during its operating time in its expected useful life primarily for purposes other than scientific research and experimental development, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that its value would be consumed primarily in activities other than scientific research and experimental development; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: part of a property of the taxpayer if, at the time the part was acquired by the taxpayer, the taxpayer or a person related to the taxpayer intended that the part would be used in the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development during the assembly, construction or commissioning of a facility, plant or line for commercial manufacturing, commercial processing or other commercial purposes (other than scientific research and experimental development), and intended

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that it would be used during its operating time in its expected useful life primarily for purposes other than scientific research and experimental development, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that its value would be consumed primarily in activities other than scientific research and experimental development.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 37.1(5)(c) of the Act, a prescribed expenditure is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure of a current nature incurred by a corporation in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the general administration or management of a business, including

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: administrative salary or wages and related benefits in respect of a person whose duties are not all or substantially all directed to the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development, except to the extent that such expenditure is described in subsection 2900(2) or (3),

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a legal or accounting fee,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: an amount described in any of paragraphs 20(1)(c) to (g) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an entertainment expense,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: an advertising or selling expense,

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: a convention expense,

Clause.Label: (G)
Clause.Text: a due or fee in respect of membership in a scientific or technical society or organization, and

Clause.Label: (H)
Clause.Text: a fine or penalty, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the maintenance and upkeep of premises, facilities or equipment to the extent that such expenditure is not attributable to the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: except any such expenditure incurred by a corporation that derives all or substantially all of its revenue from the prosecution of scientific research or the sale of rights in or arising out of scientific research carried on by it;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure of a capital nature incurred by a corporation in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquisition of property, except any such expenditure that was incurred for and was all or substantially all attributable to the prosecution, or to the provision of premises, facilities or equipment for the prosecution, of scientific research and experimental development, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquisition of property that is qualified property within the meaning assigned by subsection 127(9) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure made to acquire rights in, or arising out of, scientific research; or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure on scientific research in respect of which an amount is deductible under section 110 of the Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of the definition qualified expenditure in subsection 127(9) of the Act, a prescribed expenditure is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure of a current nature incurred by a taxpayer in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the general administration or management of a business, including

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: administrative salary or wages and related benefits in respect of a person whose duties are not all or substantially all directed to the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development, except to the extent that such expenditure is described in subsection 2900(2) or (3),

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a legal or accounting fee,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: an amount described in any of paragraphs 20(1)(c) to (g) of the Act,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: an entertainment expense,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: an advertising or selling expense,

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: a conference or convention expense,

Clause.Label: (G)
Clause.Text: a due or fee in respect of membership in a scientific or technical society or organization, and

Clause.Label: (H)
Clause.Text: a fine or penalty, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the maintenance and upkeep of premises, facilities or equipment to the extent that such expenditure is not attributable to the prosecution of scientific research;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure of a capital nature incurred by a taxpayer in respect of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquisition of property, except any such expenditure that at the time it was incurred

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: was for first term shared-use-equipment or second term shared-use-equipment (as those terms are defined in subsection 127(9) of the Act), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: was for the provision of premises, facilities or equipment if, at the time of the acquisition of the premises, facilities or equipment, it was intended

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: that the premises, facilities or equipment would be used during all or substantially all of the operating time of the premises, facilities or equipment in the expected useful life of the premises, facilities or equipment for the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development in Canada, or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: that all or substantially all of the value of the premises, facilities or equipment would be consumed in the prosecution of scientific research and experimental development in Canada,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquisition of property that is qualified property as defined in subsection 127(9) of the Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the acquisition of property that has been used, or acquired for use or lease, for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure made to acquire rights in, or arising out of, scientific research and experimental development;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure on scientific research and experimental development in respect of which an amount is deductible under section 110.1 or section 118.1 of the Act; or

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: an expenditure of a taxpayer, to the extent that the taxpayer has received or is entitled to receive a reimbursement in respect of it from

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a person resident in Canada, other than

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: an agent of Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a corporation, commission or association that is controlled, directly or indirectly in any manner whatever, by Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province or by an agent of her Majesty in right of Canada or a province, or

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: a municipality in Canada or a municipal or public body performing a function of government in Canada, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a person not resident in Canada to the extent that the said reimbursement is deductible by the person in computing his taxable income earned in Canada for any taxation year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of this Part and paragraph 37(8)(e) of the Act, a special-purpose building is a building the working areas of which are designed and constructed to have a displacement in any direction of not more than 0.02 µm (micrometres) and to have, per 0.028 cubic metre of interior airspace,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: not more than 350 airborne particles of a size less than or equal to 0.1 µm (micrometres) in diameter and no airborne particles of a size greater than 0.1 µm (micrometres) in diameter,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: not more than 75 airborne particles of a size less than or equal to 0.2 µm (micrometres) in diameter and no airborne particles of a size greater than 0.2 µm (micrometres) in diameter,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: not more than 30 airborne particles of a size less than or equal to 0.3 µm (micrometres) in diameter and no airborne particles of a size greater than 0.3 µm (micrometres) in diameter, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: not more than 10 airborne particles of a size less than or equal to 0.5 µm (micrometres) in diameter and no airborne particles of a size greater than 0.5 µm (micrometres) in diameter.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition tax shelter in subsection 237.1(1) of the Act, prescribed benefit, in respect of an interest in a property, means any amount that may reasonably be expected, having regard to statements or representations made in respect of the interest, to be received or enjoyed by a person (in this subsection referred to as the purchaser) who acquires the interest, or a person with whom the purchaser does not deal at arm’s length, which receipt or enjoyment would have the effect of reducing the impact of any loss that the purchaser may sustain in respect of the interest, and includes such an amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: that is, either immediately or in the future, owed to any other person by the purchaser or a person with whom the purchaser does not deal at arm’s length, to the extent that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: liability to pay that amount is contingent,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: payment of that amount is or will be guaranteed by, security is or will be provided by, or an agreement to indemnify the other person to whom the amount is owed is or will be entered into by

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a promoter in respect of the interest,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a person with whom the promoter does not deal at arm’s length, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: a person who is to receive a payment (other than a payment made by the purchaser) in respect of the guarantee, security or agreement to indemnify,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the rights of that other person against the purchaser, or against a person with whom the purchaser does not deal at arm’s length, in respect of the collection of all or part of the purchase price are limited to a maximum amount, are enforceable only against certain property, or are otherwise limited by agreement, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: payment of that amount is to be made in a foreign currency or is to be determined by reference to its value in a foreign currency and it may reasonably be considered, having regard to the history of the exchange rate between the foreign currency and Canadian currency, that the total of all such payments, when converted to Canadian currency at the exchange rate expected to prevail at the date on which each such payment would be required to be made, will be substantially less than that total would be if each such payment was converted to Canadian currency at the time that each such payment became owing;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that the purchaser or a person with whom the purchaser does not deal at arm’s length is entitled at any time to, directly or indirectly, receive or have available

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: as a form of assistance from a government, municipality or other public authority, whether as a grant, a subsidy, a forgivable loan, a deduction from tax (other than an amount described in clause (b)(i)(B) of the definition tax shelter in subsection 237.1(1) of the Act) or an investment allowance, or as any other form of assistance, other than an excluded loan as defined in subsection 12(11) of the Act, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: by reason of a revenue guarantee or other agreement in respect of which revenue may be earned by the purchaser or a person with whom the purchaser does not deal at arm’s length, to the extent that the revenue guarantee or other agreement may reasonably be considered to ensure that the purchaser or person will receive a return of all or a portion of the purchaser’s outlays in respect of the interest;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that is the proceeds of disposition to which the purchaser may be entitled by way of an agreement or other arrangement under which the purchaser has a right, either absolutely or contingently, to dispose of the interest (otherwise than as a consequence of the purchaser’s death), including the fair market value of any property that the agreement or arrangement provides for the acquisition of in exchange for all or any part of the interest; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that is owed to a promoter, or a person with whom the promoter does not deal at arm’s length, by the purchaser or a person with whom the purchaser does not deal at arm’s length in respect of the interest.

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding subsection (1), for the purpose of paragraph b) of the definition tax shelter in subsection 237.1(1) of the Act, prescribed benefit, in respect of an interest in a property, does not, except as otherwise provided in subparagraph (1)(b)(ii), include profits earned in respect of the interest.

For the purpose of paragraph (b) of the definition tax shelter in subsection 237.1(1) of the Act, prescribed benefit, in respect of an interest in a property, includes an amount that is a limited-recourse amount because of subsection 143.2(1), (7) or (13) of the Act, but does not include an amount of indebtedness that is a limited-recourse amount

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: solely because it is not required to be repaid within 10 years from the time the indebtedness arose where the debtor would, if the interest were acquired by the debtor immediately after that time, be

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a partnership

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: at least 90% of the fair market value of the property of which is attributable to the partnership’s tangible capital property located in Canada, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: at least 90% of the value of all interests in which are held by limited partners (within the meaning assigned by subsection 96(2.4) of the Act) of the partnership,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: except where it is reasonable to conclude that one of the main reasons for the acquisition of one or more properties by the partnership, or for the acquisition of one or more interests in the partnership by limited partners, is to avoid the application of this subsection, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a member of a partnership having fewer than six members, except where

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the partnership is a member of another partnership,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: there is a limited partner (within the meaning assigned by subsection 96(2.4) of the Act) of the partnership,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: less than 90% of the fair market value of the partnership’s property is attributable to the partnership’s tangible capital property located in Canada, or

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that one of the main reasons for the existence of one of two or more partnerships, one of which is the partnership, or the acquisition of one or more properties by the partnership, is to avoid the application of this section to the member’s indebtedness,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of a partnership

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: where

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the indebtedness is secured by and used to acquire the partnership’s tangible capital property located in Canada (other than rental property, within the meaning assigned by subsection 1100(14), leasing property, within the meaning assigned by subsection 1100(17), or specified energy property, within the meaning assigned by subsection 1100(25)), and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the person to whom the indebtedness is repayable is a member of the Canadian Payments Association, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: throughout the period during which any amount is outstanding in respect of the indebtedness,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: at least 90% of the fair market value of the property of which is attributable to tangible capital property located in Canada of the partnership,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: at least 90% of the value of all interests in which are held by limited partners (within the meaning assigned by subsection 96(2.4) of the Act) that are corporations, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the principal business of each such limited partner is related to the principal business of the partnership,

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: except where it is reasonable to conclude that one of the main reasons for the acquisition of one or more properties by the partnership, or for the acquisition of one or more interests in the partnership by limited partners, is to avoid the application of this subsection,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: of a corporation where the amount is a bona fide business loan made to the corporation for the purpose of financing a business that the corporation operates and the loan is made under a loan program of the Government of Canada or of a province the purpose of which is to extend financing to small- and medium-sized Canadian businesses, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount is an excluded loan as defined in subsection 12(11) of the Act.

Section.Text: In this Part,

Definition.Text: employees’ charity trust means a registered charity that is organized for the purpose of remitting, to other registered charities, donations that are collected from employees by an employer; (fuducie de bienfaisance d’employés)
official receipt means a receipt for the purposes of paragraph 110.1(2)(a) or 118.1(2)(a) of the Act, containing information required by section 3501 or 3502; (reçu officiel)

official receipt form means any printed form that a registered organization or other recipient of a gift has that is capable of being completed, or that originally was intended to be completed, as an official receipt by it; (formule de reçu officiel)

other recipient of a gift means a person, to whom a gift is made by a taxpayer, referred to in any of paragraph 110.1(1)(c), subparagraph 110.1(2.1)(a)(ii) and paragraphs (a) and (d) of the definition qualified donee in subsection 149.1(1) of the Act; (autre bénéficiaire d’un don)

registered organization means a registered charity, a registered Canadian amateur athletic association, registered journalism organization or a registered national arts service organization. (organisation enregistrée)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Every official receipt issued by a registered organization shall contain a statement that it is an official receipt for income tax purposes and shall show clearly in such a manner that it cannot readily be altered,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the name and address in Canada of the organization as recorded with the Minister;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the registration number assigned by the Minister to the organization;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the serial number of the receipt;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the place or locality where the receipt was issued;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where the gift is a cash gift, the date on which or the year during which the gift was received;

Paragraph.Label: (e.1)
Paragraph.Text: where the gift is of property other than cash

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the date on which the gift was received,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a brief description of the property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the name and address of the appraiser of the property if an appraisal is done;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the date on which the receipt was issued;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the name and address of the donor including, in the case of an individual, the individual’s first name and initial;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of a cash gift, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the gift is of property other than cash, the amount that is the fair market value of the property at the time that the gift is made;

Paragraph.Label: (h.1)
Paragraph.Text: a description of the advantage, if any, in respect of the gift and the amount of that advantage;

Paragraph.Label: (h.2)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible amount of the gift;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: the signature, as provided in subsection (2) or (3), of a responsible individual who has been authorized by the organization to acknowledge gifts; and

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: the name and Internet website of the Canada Revenue Agency.

Subsection.Text: Every official receipt issued by another recipient of a gift shall contain a statement that it is an official receipt for income tax purposes and shall show clearly in such a manner that it cannot readily be altered,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the name and address of the other recipient of the gift;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the serial number of the receipt;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the place or locality where the receipt was issued;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the gift is a cash gift, the date on which the gift was received;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where the gift is of property other than cash

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the date on which the gift was received,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a brief description of the property, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the name and address of the appraiser of the property if an appraisal is done;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the date on which the receipt was issued;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the name and address of the donor including, in the case of an individual, the individual’s first name and initial;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of a cash gift, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the gift is of property other than cash, the amount that is the fair market value of the property at the time that the gift was made;

Paragraph.Label: (h.1)
Paragraph.Text: a description of the advantage, if any, in respect of the gift and the amount of that advantage;

Paragraph.Label: (h.2)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible amount of the gift;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: the signature, as provided in subsection (2) or (3.1), of a responsible individual who has been authorized by the other recipient of the gift to acknowledge donations; and

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: the name and Internet website of the Canada Revenue Agency.

Subsection.Text: Except as provided in subsection (3) or (3.1), every official receipt shall be signed personally by an individual referred to in paragraph (1)(i) or (1.1)(i).
Where all official receipt forms of a registered organization are

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: distinctively imprinted with the name, address in Canada and registration number of the organization,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: serially numbered by a printing press or numbering machine, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: kept at the place referred to in subsection 230(2) of the Act until completed as an official receipt,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the official receipts may bear a facsimile signature.

Subsection.Text: Where all official receipt forms of another recipient of the gift are

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: distinctively imprinted with the name and address of the other recipient of the gift,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: serially numbered by a printing press or numbering machine, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if applicable, kept at a place referred to in subsection 230(1) of the Act until completed as an official receipt,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the official receipts may bear a facsimile signature.

Subsection.Text: An official receipt issued to replace an official receipt previously issued shall show clearly that it replaces the original receipt and, in addition to its own serial number, shall show the serial number of the receipt originally issued.

A spoiled official receipt form shall be marked “cancelled” and such form, together with the duplicate thereof, shall be retained by the registered organization or the other recipient of a gift as part of its records.
Every official receipt form on which any of the following is incorrectly or illegibly entered is deemed to be spoiled:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the date on which the gift is received;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of the gift, in the case of a cash gift;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a description of the advantage, if any, in respect of the gift and the amount of that advantage; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the eligible amount of the gift.

Section.Text: Every information return required to be filed under subsection 110.1(16) or 118.1(27) of the Act in respect of a transfer of property must contain

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a description of the transferred property;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the fair market value of the transferred property at the time of the transfer;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the date on which the property was transferred;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the name and address of the transferee of the property including, in the case of an individual, their first name and initial; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: if the transferor of the property, or a person not dealing at arm’s length with the transferor, issued the receipt referred to in subsection 110.1(14) or 118.1(25) of the Act, the information contained in that receipt.

Section.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a registered organization

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is an employees’ charity trust, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: has appointed an employer as agent for the purpose of remitting, to that registered organization, donations that are collected by the employer from the employer’s employees, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each copy of the return required by section 200 to be filed for a year by an employer of employees who donated to the registered organization in that year shows

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount of each employee’s donations to the registered organization for the year collected by the employer, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the registration number assigned by the Minister to the registered organization,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: section 3501 shall not apply and the copy of the portion of the return, relating to each employee who made a donation to the registered organization in that year, that is required by section 209 to be distributed to the employee for filing with the employee’s income tax return shall be an official receipt.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 20(1)(o) of the Act, the amount hereby prescribed is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the third taxation year preceding the taxation year during which a survey is scheduled to occur, the amount that is 1/4 of the estimate of the expenses of the survey;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the second taxation year preceding the taxation year during which a survey is scheduled to occur, the amount that is 1/2 of the estimate of the expenses of the survey;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for the first taxation year preceding the taxation year during which a survey is scheduled to occur, the amount that is 3/4 of the estimate of the expenses of the survey; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for the taxation year during which a survey is scheduled to occur, if the quadrennial or other special surveys have not, at the end of the year, been completed to the extent that the vessel is permitted to proceed on a voyage, the amount remaining after deducting from the estimate of the expenses of the survey the amount of expenses actually incurred in the year in carrying out the survey.

Subsection.Text: In this section,

Definition.Text: classification society means a society or association for the classification and registry of shipping approved by the Minister of Transport under the Canada Shipping Act; (société de classification)

estimate of the expenses of survey means a fair and reasonable estimate, made by a taxpayer at the time of filing his return of income for the third taxation year preceding the taxation year in which a quadrennial survey is scheduled to occur, of the costs, charges and expenses which might be expected to be necessarily incurred by him by reason of that survey and in respect of which he does not have or possess nor is he likely to have or possess any right of reimbursement, recoupment, recovery or indemnification from any other person or source; (évaluation des dépenses d’expertise)
inspector means a steamship inspector appointed under Part VIII of the Canada Shipping Act; (inspecteur)

quadrennial survey means a periodical survey, not being an annual survey nor a survey coinciding as to time with the construction of a vessel, in accordance with the rules of a classification society or, an extended inspection, not being an annual inspection nor an inspection coinciding as to time with the construction of a vessel, pursuant to the provisions of the Canada Shipping Act, and the regulations thereunder; (expertise quadriennale)

survey means the drydocking of a vessel, the examination and inspection of its hull, boilers, machinery, engines and equipment by an inspector or a surveyor and everything done to such vessel, its hull, boilers, machinery, engines and equipment pursuant to an order, requirement or recommendation given or made by the inspector or surveyor as the result of the examination and inspection so that a safety and inspection certificate might be issued in respect of the vessel pursuant to the provisions of the Canada Shipping Act, and the regulations thereunder or, as the case may be, so that the vessel might be entitled to retain the character assigned to it in the registry book of a classification society; (expertise)
surveyor means a surveyor to a classification society. (expert)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of the description of B in the definition disbursement quota in subsection 149.1(1) of the Act, the prescribed amount for a taxation year of a registered charity is determined as follows:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: choose a number, not less than two and not more than eight, of equal and consecutive periods that total twenty-four months and that end immediately before the beginning of the year;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: aggregate for each period chosen under paragraph (a) all amounts, each of which is the value, determined in accordance with section 3702, of a property, or a portion of a property, owned by the registered charity, and not used directly in charitable activities or administration, on the last day of the period;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: aggregate all amounts, each of which is the aggregate of values determined for each period under paragraph (b); and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: divide the aggregate amount determined under paragraph (c) by the number of periods chosen under paragraph (a).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1) and subject to subsection (3),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the number of periods chosen by a registered charity under paragraph (1)(a) shall, unless otherwise authorized by the Minister, be used for the taxation year and for all subsequent taxation years; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a registered charity is deemed to have existed on the last day of each of the periods chosen by it.

Subsection.Text: The number of periods chosen under paragraph (1)(a) may be changed by the registered charity for its first taxation year commencing after 1986 and the new number shall, unless otherwise authorized by the Minister, be used for that taxation year and all subsequent taxation years.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 3701(1), the value of a property, or a portion of a property, owned by a registered charity, and not used directly in charitable activities or administration, on the last day of a period is determined as of that day to be

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of a non-qualified investment of a private foundation, the greater of its fair market value on that day and its cost amount to the private foundation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (c), in the case of property other than a non-qualified investment that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a share of a corporation that is listed on a designated stock exchange, the closing price or the average of the bid and asked prices of that share on that day or, if there is no closing price or bid and asked prices on that day, on the last preceding day for which there was a closing price or bid and asked prices,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a share of a corporation that is not listed on a designated stock exchange, the fair market value of that share on that day,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: an interest in real property or a real right in an immovable, the fair market value on that day of the interest or right less the amount of any debt of the registered charity incurred in respect of the acquisition of the interest or right and secured by the interest or right, where the debt bears a reasonable rate of interest,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a contribution that is the subject of a pledge, nil,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: an interest, or for civil law a right, in property where the registered charity does not have the present use or enjoyment of the interest or right, nil,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: a life insurance policy, other than an annuity contract, that has not matured, nil, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: a property not described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (vi), the fair market value of the property on that day; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of any property described in paragraph (b) that is owned in connection with the charitable activities of the registered charity and is a share of a limited-dividend housing company referred to in paragraph 149(1)(n) of the Act or a loan, that has ceased to be used for charitable purposes and is being held pending disposition or for use in charitable activities, or that has been acquired for use in charitable activities, the lesser of the fair market value of the property on that day and an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the income earned on the property in the period, and
is the number of months in the period.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1), a method that the Minister may accept for the determination of the fair market value of property or a portion thereof on the last day of a period is an independent appraisal made

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of property described in subparagraph (1)(b)(ii) or (iii), not more than three years before that day; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in the case of property described in paragraph (1)(a), subparagraph (1)(b)(vii) or paragraph (1)(c), not more than one year before that day.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purpose of subsection 149.1(14) of the Act, the following is prescribed information for the public information return of a charity in a taxation year:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of each grantee organization that received total qualifying disbursements from the charity in excess of $5,000 in the taxation year, the name of the grantee organization;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the purpose of each qualifying disbursement made to a grantee organization referred to in paragraph (a) in the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total amount disbursed by the charity to each grantee organization referred to in paragraph (a) in the taxation year.
