Heading.Label: PART LI
Heading.TitleText: Deferred Income Plans, Investments in Small Business

Subsection.Text: In this Part,

Definition.Text: designated rate, at any time, means 150 per cent of the highest of the prime rates generally quoted at that time by the banks to which Schedule A to the Bank Act applies; (taux déterminé)
eligible corporation, at any time, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a particular corporation that is a taxable Canadian corporation all or substantially all of the property of which is at that time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: used in a qualifying active business carried on by the particular corporation or by a corporation controlled by it,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: shares of the capital stock of one or more eligible corporations that are related to the particular corporation, or debt obligations issued by those eligible corporations, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of the properties described in subparagraphs (i) and (ii),

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: a specified holding corporation, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a venture capital corporation described in section 6700,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but does not include

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation (other than a mutual fund corporation) that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a trader or dealer in securities,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a bank,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a corporation licensed or otherwise authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on in Canada the business of offering to the public its services as a trustee,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: a credit union,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: an insurance corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: a corporation the principal business of which is the lending of money or the purchasing of debt obligations or a combination of them,

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation controlled by one or more non-resident persons,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a venture capital corporation, other than a venture capital corporation described in section 6700, or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that has made an election in respect of a particular taxation year under subparagraph (iv) of the description of B in paragraph 204.82(2.2)(c.1) of the Act, if that time is in the 12-month period that begins on the day that is six months after the day on which the particular taxation year ends; (société admissible)

Definition.Text: qualifying active business, at any time, means any business carried on primarily in Canada by a corporation, but does not include

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a business (other than a business of leasing property other than real property) the principal purpose of which is to derive income from property (including interest, dividends, rent and royalties), or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a business of deriving gains from the disposition of property (other than property in the inventory of the business),

ContinuedDefinition.Text: and, for the purposes of this definition, a business carried on primarily in Canada by a corporation, at any time, includes a business carried on by the corporation if, at that time,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: at least 50 per cent of the full time employees of the corporation and all corporations related thereto employed in respect of the business are employed in Canada, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at least 50 per cent of the salaries and wages paid to employees of the corporation and all corporations related thereto employed in respect of the business are reasonably attributable to services rendered in Canada; (entreprise admissible exploitée activement)

Definition.Text: qualifying obligation, at any time, means a bond, debenture, mortgage, note or other similar obligation of a corporation described in paragraph 149(1)(o.2) or (o.3) of the Act, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the obligation was issued by the corporation after October 31, 1985,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation used all or substantially all of the proceeds of the issue of the obligation within 90 days after the receipt thereof to acquire

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: small business securities,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: interests of a limited partner in small business investment limited partnerships,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: interests in small business investment trusts, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of the properties described in subparagraphs (i) to (iii)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: and, except as provided in subsection 5104(1), the corporation was the first person (other than a broker or dealer in securities) to have acquired the properties and the corporation has owned the properties continuously since they were so acquired,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation does not hold, and no group of persons who do not deal with each other at arm’s length and of which it is a member holds, more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of any class of voting stock of another corporation, except where all or any part of those shares were acquired in specified circumstances, within the meaning of subsection 5104(2),

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the recourse of the holder of the obligation against the corporation with respect to the obligation is limited to the properties acquired with the proceeds of the issue of the obligation and any properties substituted therefor, and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the properties acquired with the proceeds of the issue of the obligation have not been disposed of, unless the disposition occurred within the 90 day period immediately preceding that time; (titre admissible)

Definition.Text: specified holding corporation, at any time, means a taxable Canadian corporation where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all or substantially all of the collective property of the corporation and of all other corporations controlled by it (each of which other corporations is referred to in this definition as a “controlled corporation”), other than shares in the capital stock of the corporation or of a corporation related to it and debt obligations issued by it or by a corporation related to it, is at that time used in a qualifying active business carried on by the corporation, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all or substantially all of the property of the corporation is at that time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: property used in a qualifying active business carried on by the corporation or a controlled corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: shares of the capital stock of one or more controlled corporations or eligible corporations related to the corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: debt obligations issued by one or more controlled corporations or eligible corporations related to the corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of the properties described in subparagraphs (i), (ii) and (iii),

ContinuedDefinition.Text: and in a determination of whether property is used in a qualifying active business for the purposes of paragraph (a),

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where a business is carried on by a controlled corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the business shall be deemed to be a business carried on only by the corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the controlled corporation shall be deemed to be the corporation in the application of paragraphs (c) and (d) of the definition qualifying active business, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if a business of the corporation is substantially similar to one or more other businesses of the corporation, all those businesses shall be deemed collectively to be one business of the corporation; (société de portefeuille déterminé)

Definition.Text: specified property means property described in any of paragraphs (a), (b), (c), (f) and (g) of the definition qualified investment in section 204 of the Act. (bien déterminé)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part and clause (b)(iii)(A) of the definition eligible investment in subsection 204.8(1) of the Act, a small business security of a person, at any time, is property of that person that is, at that time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a share of the capital stock of an eligible corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a debt obligation of an eligible corporation (other than a venture capital corporation described in section 6700) that does not by its terms or any agreement related to the obligation restrict the corporation from incurring other debts and that is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: secured solely by a floating charge on the assets of the corporation and that by its terms or any agreement related thereto is subordinate to all other debt obligations of the corporation (other than a small business security issued by the corporation, or a debt obligation that is owing by the corporation to a shareholder of the corporation or a person related to a shareholder of the corporation and that is not secured in any manner whatever), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: not secured in any manner whatever,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: other than a debt obligation that

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the debt obligation specifies an invariant rate of interest, has an effective annual rate of return that exceeds the designated rate for the day on which the obligation was issued, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, may have an effective annual rate of return at a particular time that exceeds the designated rate at the particular time,

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an option or right granted by an eligible corporation in conjunction with the issue of a share or debt obligation that qualifies as a small business security to acquire a share of the capital stock of the corporation, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: an option or right granted for no consideration by an eligible corporation to a holder of a share that qualifies as a small business security to acquire a share of the capital stock of the corporation

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: if, immediately after the time of acquisition thereof,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of the cost amounts to the person of all shares, options, rights and debt obligations of the eligible corporation and all corporations associated therewith held by the person does not exceed $10,000,000, and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: the total assets (determined in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, on a consolidated or combined basis, where applicable) of the eligible corporation and all corporations associated with it do not exceed $50,000,000

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: and includes

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: property of the person that is, at that time,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a qualifying obligation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a security (in this subparagraph referred to as the “new security”) described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d), where the new security was issued at a particular time

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: in exchange for, on the conversion of, or in respect of rights pertaining to a security (in this paragraph referred to as the “former security”) that would, if this subsection were read without reference to this subparagraph and paragraph (h), be a small business security of the person immediately before the particular time, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: pursuant to an agreement entered into before the particular time and at or before the time that the former security was last acquired by the person, or

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: where the person is a small business investment corporation, small business investment limited partnership or small business investment trust, property of the person that is, at that time, a security (in this paragraph referred to as the “new security”) described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d), where the new security was issued at a particular time not more than 5 years before that time in exchange for, on the conversion of, or in respect of rights pertaining to a security that would, if this subsection were read without reference to this paragraph, be a small business security of the person immediately before the particular time.

Subsection.Text: Where all or part of the property of a person consists of the shares of the capital stock of a venture capital corporation described in section 6700, options or rights granted by the corporation, or debt obligations of the corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of the cost amounts to the person of all such property shall be deemed for the purposes of paragraph (2)(e) not to exceed $10,000,000; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total assets (determined in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, on a consolidated or combined basis, where applicable) of the corporation and all corporations associated with it shall be deemed for the purposes of paragraph (2)(f) not to exceed $50,000,000.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (2),

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in determining the effective annual rate of return in respect of a debt obligation of an eligible corporation, the value of any right to convert the debt obligation or any part thereof into, or to exchange the debt obligation or any part thereof for, shares of the capital stock of the corporation or an option or right to acquire such shares shall not be considered; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation shall be deemed not to be associated with another at any time where the corporation would not be associated with the other if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the references to “controlled, directly or indirectly, in any manner whatever” in section 256 of the Act (other than subsection (5.1) thereof) were read as references to “controlled”, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: such rights described in subsection 256(1.4) of the Act and shares, as were held at that time by a small business investment corporation, small business investment limited partnership or small business investment trust, were disregarded.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (4), for the purposes of this Part and paragraph 149(1)(o.3) and paragraph (b) of the definition small business property in subsection 206(1) of the Act, a corporation is a small business investment corporation at any time if it is a Canadian corporation incorporated after May 22, 1985 and at all times after it was incorporated and before that time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: all of the shares, and rights to acquire shares, of the capital stock of the corporation were owned by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more registered pension plans,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more trusts all the beneficiaries of which were registered pension plans,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more related segregated fund trusts (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 138.1(1)(a) of the Act) all the beneficiaries of which were registered pension plans, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more persons prescribed by section 4802 for the purposes of clause 149(1)(o.2)(iv)(D) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: its only undertaking was the investing of its funds and its investments consisted solely of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: small business securities,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: interests of a limited partner in small business investment limited partnerships,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: interests in small business investment trusts,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: property (other than a small business security) that is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation (other than a share that is issued to the corporation and that is either a share described in section 66.3 of the Act or a share in respect of which an amount has been designated under subsection 192(4) of the Act), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a put, call, warrant or other right to acquire or sell a share described by clause (A),

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: specified properties, or

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of properties described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (v)

ContinuedParagraph.Text: and, except as provided in subsection 5104(1), with respect to properties referred to in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii), the corporation was the first person (other than a broker or dealer in securities) to have acquired the properties and the corporation has owned the properties continuously since they were so acquired;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: it has complied with subsection (2);

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: it did not hold, and no group of persons who did not deal with each other at arm’s length and of which it was a member held, more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of any class of voting stock of a corporation, except where

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all or any part of those shares were acquired in specified circumstances within the meaning of subsection 5104(2), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: those shares were of any class of voting stock of a venture capital corporation described in section 6700;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: it has not borrowed money except from its shareholders; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: it has not accepted deposits.

Subsection.Text: Every small business investment corporation shall at all times hold properties referred to in subparagraphs (1)(b)(i) to (iii), the aggregate of the cost amounts of which is not less than 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the amount of consideration for the issue of shares of its capital stock or debt to its shareholders or the amount of a contribution of capital by its shareholders received by it more than 90 days before that time

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: all amounts paid by it before that time to its shareholders as a return of capital or a repayment of debt, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of its losses from the disposition of properties disposed of before that time exceeds the aggregate of its gains from the disposition of properties disposed of before that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (2), where a small business investment corporation disposes of a property referred to in subparagraphs (1)(b)(i) to (iii), it shall be deemed to continue to hold the investment for a period of 90 days following the date of the disposition.

For the purposes of paragraph 149(1)(o.3) of the Act, where a small business investment corporation holds an interest in a partnership or trust that qualified as a small business investment limited partnership or small business investment trust, as the case may be, when the interest was acquired and that, but for this subsection, would cease at a subsequent time to so qualify, the interest in the partnership or trust shall be deemed to be an interest in a small business investment limited partnership or small business investment trust, as the case may be, for the 24 months immediately following the subsequent time.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of this Part, a partnership is a small business investment limited partnership at any particular time if at all times after it was formed and before the particular time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: it had only one general partner;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the share of the general partner, as general partner, in any income of the partnership from any source in any place, for any period, was the same as his share, as general partner, in

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the income of the partnership from that source in any other place,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the income of the partnership from any other source,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the loss of the partnership from any source,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: any capital gain of the partnership, and

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: any capital loss of the partnership

ContinuedParagraph.Text: for that period, except that the share of the general partner, as general partner, in the income or loss of the partnership from specified properties may differ from his share, as general partner, in the income or loss of the partnership from other sources;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the share of the general partner, as general partner, in any income or loss of the partnership for any period was not less than his share, as general partner, in the income or loss of the partnership for any preceding period;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the interests of the limited partners were described by reference to units of the partnership that were identical in all respects;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: no limited partner or group of limited partners who did not deal with each other at arm’s length held more than 30 per cent of the units of the partnership and, for the purposes of this paragraph,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a small business investment corporation that has not borrowed money and in which no shareholder or group of shareholders who did not deal with each other at arm’s length held more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of any class of voting stock shall be deemed not to be a limited partner, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the general partner shall be deemed not to hold any unit of the partnership as a limited partner;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: its only undertaking was the investing of its funds and its investments consisted solely of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: small business securities where, except as provided in subsection 5104(1), the partnership was the first person (other than a broker or dealer in securities) to have acquired the securities and it has owned the securities continuously since they were so acquired,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property (other than a small business security) that is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation (other than a share that is issued to the partnership and that is either a share described in section 66.3 of the Act or a share in respect of which an amount has been designated under subsection 192(4) of the Act), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a put, call, warrant or other right to acquire or sell a share described by clause (A),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: specified properties, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of properties described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii);

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: it has complied with subsection (2);

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: it has not borrowed money except for the purpose of earning income from its investments and the amount of any such borrowings at any time did not exceed 20 per cent of the partnership capital at that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: it has not accepted deposits.

Subsection.Text: The aggregate of the cost amounts to a small business investment limited partnership of small business securities held by it at any time shall not be less than the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 25 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts received by it more than 12 months before that time and not more than 24 months before that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in respect of its units

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before that time to its members and designated by the partnership as a return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 50 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts received by it more than 24 months before that time and not more than 36 months before that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in respect of its units

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before that time to its members and designated by the partnership as a return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i), and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts received by it more than 36 months before that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in respect of its units

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before that time to its members and designated by the partnership as a return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i),

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of its losses from the disposition of properties disposed of before that time exceeds the aggregate of its gains from the disposition of properties disposed of before that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (2), where a small business investment limited partnership disposes of a small business security it shall be deemed to continue to hold the investment for a period of 90 days following the date of the disposition.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part and subsection 259(5) of the Act, a trust is a small business investment trust at any particular time if at all times after it was created and before the particular time

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: it was resident in Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the interests of the beneficiaries under the trust were described by reference to units of the trust that were identical in all respects; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: no beneficiary or group of beneficiaries who did not deal with each other at arm’s length held more than 30 per cent of the units of the trust and, for the purposes of this paragraph, a small business investment corporation that has not borrowed money and in which no shareholder or group of shareholders who did not deal with each other at arm’s length held more than 30 per cent of the outstanding shares of any class of voting stock shall be deemed not to be a beneficiary;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: its only undertaking was the investing of its funds and its investments consisted solely of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: small business securities where, except as provided in subsection 5104(1), the trust was the first person (other than a broker or dealer in securities) to have acquired the securities and it has owned the securities continuously since they were so acquired,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property (other than a small business security) that is

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: a share of the capital stock of a corporation (other than a share that is issued to the trust and that is either a share described in section 66.3 of the Act or a share in respect of which an amount has been designated under subsection 192(4) of the Act), or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a put, call, warrant or other right to acquire or sell a share described by clause (A),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: specified properties, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: any combination of properties described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii);

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: it has complied with subsection (2);

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: it has not borrowed money except for the purpose of earning income from its investments and the amount of any such borrowings at any time did not exceed 20 per cent of the trust capital at that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: it has not accepted deposits.

Subsection.Text: The aggregate of the cost amounts to a small business investment trust of small business securities held by it at any time shall not be less than the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 25 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts received by it more than 12 months before that time and not more than 24 months before that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in respect of its units

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before that time to its beneficiaries and designated by the trust as a return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i),

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: 50 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts received by it more than 24 months before that time and not more than 36 months before that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in respect of its units

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before that time to its beneficiaries and designated by the trust as a return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i), and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts received by it more than 36 months before that time as consideration for the issue of its units or in respect of its units

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts paid by it before that time to its beneficiaries and designated by the trust as a return of the consideration referred to in subparagraph (i)

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds 75 per cent of the amount, if any, by which the aggregate of its losses from the disposition of properties disposed of before that time exceeds the aggregate of its gains from the disposition of properties disposed of before that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (2), where a small business investment trust disposes of a small business security it shall be deemed to continue to hold the investment for a period of 90 days following the date of disposition.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Notwithstanding paragraph (b) of the definition qualifying obligation in subsection 5100(1) and paragraphs 5101(1)(b), 5102(1)(f) and 5103(1)(d), the corporation, partnership or trust, as the case may be, may acquire a small business security that another person (other than a broker or dealer in securities) had previously acquired if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the small business security is a share of the capital stock of an eligible corporation having full voting rights under all circumstances; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: except where the share was acquired in specified circumstances within the meaning of subsection (2), the share was acquired from an officer or employee of the eligible corporation or a person related to the officer or employee.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where a person acquires a share of a corporation

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: as part of a proposal to, or an arrangement with, the corporation’s creditors that has been approved by a court under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act or the Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: at a time when all or substantially all of the corporation’s assets were under the control of a receiver, receiver-manager, sequestrator or trustee in bankruptcy, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: at a time when, by reason of financial difficulty, the corporation was in default, or could reasonably be expected to default, on a debt obligation held by a person with whom the corporation was dealing at arm’s length,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the person shall be deemed, at any time within 36 months after he acquired the share, to have acquired it in specified circumstances;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where a person acquires a share of a corporation for the purposes of facilitating the disposition of the entire investment of the person in the corporation, the person shall be deemed, at any time within 12 months after he acquired the share, to have acquired it in specified circumstances; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a qualified trust (within the meaning assigned by subsection 259(3) of the Act) is deemed not to hold any property for any period in respect of which subsection 259(1) of the Act is applicable.

Subsection.Text: Where the purchaser of a property that, but for this subsection, would at the time of its acquisition be a small business security (or, where the purchaser is a partnership, a member thereof) knew at the time of acquisition that the issuer of the security would, within the immediately following 12 months, cease to qualify as an eligible corporation, the property shall be deemed never to have been a small business security of the purchaser.

Where a person who holds a share of or an interest in a corporation, partnership or trust that, but for this subsection, would be a small business investment corporation, small business investment limited partnership or small business investment trust knew at the time of issue of the share or interest, as the case may be, or at the time of making any contribution in respect of the share or interest, that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a substantial portion of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the consideration for the issue of the share or interest, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the contribution in respect of the share or interest

ContinuedParagraph.Text: would not be invested by the corporation, partnership or trust, as the case may be, directly or indirectly in small business securities, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all or substantially all of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the consideration for the issue of the share or interest, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the contribution in respect of the share or interest

ContinuedParagraph.Text: would be returned to the purchaser within the immediately following 24 months,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the corporation, partnership or trust shall be deemed to have ceased at that time to be a small business investment corporation, small business investment limited partnership or small business investment trust.

Subsection.Text: Where, but for this subsection, a property that qualified as a small business security when it was acquired would cease at a subsequent time to so qualify, the property shall be deemed to be a small business security for the 24 months immediately following the subsequent time.
For the purposes of this Part, a partnership shall be deemed to be a person.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: Subject to section 5201, for the purposes of subsection 125.1(3) of the Act, “Canadian manufacturing and processing profits” of a corporation for a taxation year are hereby prescribed to be that proportion of the corporation’s adjusted business income for the year that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of its cost of manufacturing and processing capital for the year and its cost of manufacturing and processing labour for the year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: is of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of its cost of capital for the year and its cost of labour for the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of subsection 125.1(3) of the Act, “Canadian manufacturing and processing profits” of a corporation for a taxation year are hereby prescribed to be equal to the corporation’s adjusted business income for the year where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the activities of the corporation during the year were primarily manufacturing or processing in Canada of goods for sale or lease;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the income of the corporation for the year from an active business minus the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the loss of the corporation for the year from an active business, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if the corporation is associated in the year with a Canadian corporation, the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the income of the latter corporation from an active business for its taxation year coinciding with or ending in the year,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: did not exceed $200,000;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation was not engaged in any of the activities listed in paragraphs (a) to (k) of the definition manufacturing or processing in subsection 125.1(3) of the Act at any time during the year;

Paragraph.Label: (c.1)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation was not engaged in the processing of ore (other than iron ore or tar sands) from a mineral resource located outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the prime metal stage or its equivalent;

Paragraph.Label: (c.2)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation was not engaged in the processing of iron ore from a mineral resource located outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the pellet stage or its equivalent;

Paragraph.Label: (c.3)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation was not engaged in the processing of tar sands located outside Canada to any stage that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation did not carry on any active business outside Canada at any time during the year.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: In this Part, except as otherwise provided in section 5203 or 5204,

Definition.Text: adjusted business income of a corporation for a taxation year means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the income of the corporation for the year from an active business carried on in Canada

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the loss of the corporation for the year from an active business carried on in Canada; (revenu rajusté tiré d’une entreprise)

Definition.Text: Canadian resource profits has the meaning that would be assigned to the expression resource profits by section 1204 if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: section 1204 were read without reference to subparagraph 1204(1)(b)(iv), and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the definition resource activity in subsection 1206(1) were read without reference to paragraph (d) of that definition; (bénéfices relatifs à des ressources au Canada)

Definition.Text: cost of capital of a corporation for a taxation year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 10 per cent of the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the gross cost to the corporation of a property referred to in paragraph 1100(1)(e), (f), (g) or (h), paragraph 1102(1)(d) or (g) or Schedule II that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: was owned by the corporation at the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was used by the corporation at any time during the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the rental cost incurred by the corporation during the year for the use of any property a portion of the gross cost of which would be included by virtue of paragraph (a) if the property were owned by the corporation at the end of the year,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but for the purposes of this definition, the gross cost of a property or rental cost for the use of any property does not include that portion of those costs that reflects the extent to which the property was used by the corporation during the year

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in an active business carried on outside Canada, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: to earn Canadian investment income or foreign investment income as defined in subsection 129(4) of the Act; (coût en capital)

Definition.Text: cost of labour of a corporation for a taxation year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the salaries and wages paid or payable during the year to all employees of the corporation for services performed during the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all other amounts each of which is an amount paid or payable during the year for the performance during the year, by any person other than an employee of the corporation, of functions relating to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the management or administration of the corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: scientific research and experimental development, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a service or function that would normally be performed by an employee of the corporation,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but for the purposes of this definition, the salaries and wages referred to in paragraph (a) or other amounts referred to in paragraph (b) do not include that portion of those amounts that

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: was included in the gross cost to the corporation of a property (other than a property that was manufactured by the corporation and leased during the year by the corporation to another person) that was included in computing the cost of capital of the corporation for the year, or

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: was related to an active business carried on outside Canada by the corporation; (coût en main-d’oeuvre)

Definition.Text: cost of manufacturing and processing capital of a corporation for a taxation year means 100/85 of that portion of the cost of capital of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which each property included in the calculation thereof was used directly in qualified activities of the corporation during the year, but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of capital of the corporation for the year; (coût en capital de fabrication et de transformation)
cost of manufacturing and processing labour of a corporation for a taxation year means 100/75 of that portion of the cost of labour of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the salaries and wages included in the calculation thereof were paid or payable to persons for the portion of their time that they were directly engaged in qualified activities of the corporation during the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the other amounts included in the calculation thereof were paid or payable to persons for the performance of functions that would be directly related to qualified activities of the corporation during the year if those persons were employees of the corporation,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of labour of the corporation for the year; (coût en main-d’oeuvre de fabrication et de transformation)

Definition.Text: gross cost to a particular person of a property at any time means, in respect of property that has become available for use by the particular person for the purposes of subsection 13(26) of the Act, the capital cost to the particular person of the property computed without reference to subsections 13(7.1), (7.4) and (10), sections 21 and 80 and paragraph 111(4)(e) of the Act and, in respect of any other property, nil, and where the particular person acquired the property

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in the course of a reorganization in respect of which, if a dividend were received by the particular person in the course of the reorganization, subsection 55(2) of the Act would not apply to the dividend by reason of the application of paragraph 55(3)(b) of the Act, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: from another person with whom the particular person was not dealing at arm’s length (otherwise than by reason of a right referred to in paragraph 251(5)(b) of the Act) immediately after the property was acquired,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: the capital cost to the particular person of the property for the purposes of this definition shall be computed as if the property had been acquired at a capital cost equal to the gross cost of the property to the person from whom the property was acquired by the particular person; (coût brut)

Definition.Text: qualified activities means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: any of the following activities, when they are performed in Canada in connection with manufacturing or processing (not including the activities listed in paragraphs (a) to (k) of the definition manufacturing or processing in subsection 125.1(3) of the Act) in Canada of goods for sale or lease:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: engineering design of products and production facilities,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: receiving and storing of raw materials,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: producing, assembling and handling of goods in process,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: inspecting and packaging of finished goods,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: line supervision,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: production support activities including security, cleaning, heating and factory maintenance,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: quality and production control,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: repair of production facilities, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: pollution control,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all other activities that are performed in Canada directly in connection with manufacturing or processing (not including the activities listed in paragraphs (a) to (k) of the definition manufacturing or processing in subsection 125.1(3) of the Act) in Canada of goods for sale or lease, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: scientific research and experimental development, as defined in section 2900, carried on in Canada,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but does not include any of

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: storing, shipping, selling and leasing of finished goods,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: purchasing of raw materials,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: administration, including clerical and personnel activities,

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: purchase and resale operations,

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: data processing, and

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: providing facilities for employees, including cafeterias, clinics and recreational facilities; (activités admissibles)

Definition.Text: qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: qualified activities that are

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: performed in connection with the manufacturing or processing of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: solar energy conversion equipment, including solar thermal collectors, photovoltaic solar arrays and custom supporting structures or frames, but excluding passive solar heating equipment,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: wind energy conversion equipment, including wind turbine towers, nacelles and rotor blades,

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: water energy conversion equipment, including hydroelectric, water current, tidal and wave energy conversion equipment,

Clause.Label: (D)
Clause.Text: geothermal energy equipment,

Clause.Label: (E)
Clause.Text: equipment for a ground source heat pump system,

Clause.Label: (E.1)
Clause.Text: air-source heat pump equipment designed for space or water heating,

Clause.Label: (F)
Clause.Text: electrical energy storage equipment used for storage of renewable energy or for providing grid-scale storage or other ancillary services, including battery, compressed air and flywheel storage systems,

Clause.Label: (G)
Clause.Text: equipment used to charge, or to dispense hydrogen to, property included in clause (J),

Clause.Label: (H)
Clause.Text: equipment used for the production of hydrogen by electrolysis of water,

Clause.Label: (I)
Clause.Text: equipment that is a component of property included in clauses (A) to (H) or (L) to (O), if such equipment is purpose-built or designed exclusively to form an integral part of that property,

Clause.Label: (J)
Clause.Text: property that

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: would be a zero-emission vehicle (as defined in subsection 248(1) of the Act if that definition were read without reference to its paragraphs (b) to (d)), or

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: is described in subparagraph (a)(i) of Class 56 of Schedule II,

Clause.Label: (K)
Clause.Text: integral components of the powertrain of property included in clause (J), including batteries or fuel cells,

Clause.Label: (L)
Clause.Text: nuclear energy equipment,

Clause.Label: (M)
Clause.Text: heavy water used for nuclear energy generation,

Clause.Label: (N)
Clause.Text: nuclear fuels used for nuclear energy generation, and

Clause.Label: (O)
Clause.Text: nuclear fuel rods, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: not the manufacturing or processing of general purpose components or equipment which components or equipment are suitable for integration into property other than property described in subparagraph (i);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: qualified activities that are performed in connection with production in Canada of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: hydrogen by electrolysis of water,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: gaseous biofuel (as defined in subsection 1104(13)),

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: liquid biofuel (as defined in subsection 1104(13)), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: solid biofuel (as defined in subsection 1104(13)); and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the conversion of a vehicle, performed in Canada, into a property described in clause (a)(i)(J); (activités admissibles de fabrication de technologies à zéro émission)

Definition.Text: rental cost of a property means the rents incurred for the use of that property; (coût de location)
resource profits has the meaning assigned by section 1204; (bénéfices relatifs à des ressources)

salaries and wages means salaries, wages and commissions, but does not include any other type of remuneration, any superannuation or pension benefits, any retiring allowances or any amount referred to in section 6 or 7 of the Act; (traitements et salaires)
specified percentage for a taxation year means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where the year commences after 1998, 100%, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in any other case, the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 10% that the number of days in the year that are in 1990 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 20% that the number of days in the year that are in 1991 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 30% that the number of days in the year that are in 1992 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 50% that the number of days in the year that are in 1993 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 64.3% that the number of days in the year that are in 1994 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 71.4% that the number of days in the year that are in 1995 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 78.6% that the number of days in the year that are in 1996 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 85.7% that the number of days in the year that are in 1997 is of the number of days in the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 92.9% that the number of days in the year that are in 1998 is of the number of days in the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: that proportion of 100% that the number of days in the year that are in 1999 is of the number of days in the year; (pourcentage désigné)

Definition.Text: ZETM cost of capital, of a corporation for a taxation year, means the portion of the cost of capital of the corporation for the year that reflects the extent to which each property included in the calculation of the cost of capital was used directly in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year; (coût en capital de FTZE)
ZETM cost of labour, of a corporation for a taxation year, means the portion of the cost of labour of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the salaries and wages included in the calculation of the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons for the portion of their time that they were directly engaged in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the other amounts included in the calculation of the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons for the performance of functions that would be directly related to qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year if those persons were employees of the corporation. (coût en main-d’œuvre de FTZE)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: Where a corporation has resource activities for a taxation year the following rules apply, except as otherwise provided in section 5204:

Definition.Text: adjusted business income of the corporation for the year means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount otherwise determined under section 5202 to be the adjusted business income of the corporation for the year

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the corporation’s net resource income for the year exceeds the corporation’s net resource adjustment for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: all amounts each of which is an amount in respect of refund interest included in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, to the extent that the amount is included in the amount determined to be the adjusted business income, within the meaning of section 5202, of the corporation for the year; (revenue rajusté d’une entreprise)

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: [Repealed, SOR/2007-19, s. 7]

Definition.Text: cost of capital of the corporation for the year means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount otherwise determined under section 5202 to be the cost of capital of the corporation for the year

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that portion of the gross cost of property or rental cost for the use of property included in computing the cost of capital of the corporation for the year that reflects the extent to which the property was used by the corporation during the year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in activities engaged in for the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in activities referred to in subparagraph 66(15)(b)(i), (ii) or (v), subparagraph 66(15)(e)(i) or (ii), subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(i), (ii), (iii) or (v) or subparagraph 66.2(5)(a)(i), (ii) or (v) of the Act; (coût en capital)

Definition.Text: cost of labour of the corporation for the year means the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount otherwise determined under section 5202 to be the cost of labour of the corporation for the year

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that portion of the salaries and wages and other amounts included in computing the cost of labour of the corporation for the year that,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: was related to the activities engaged in for the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was included in the Canadian exploration and development expenses, foreign exploration and development expenses, Canadian exploration expense or Canadian development expense, within the meanings assigned by paragraphs 66(15)(b) and (e), 66.1(6)(a) and 66.2(5)(a) of the Act respectively, of the corporation. (coût en main-d’oeuvre)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1), a corporation has “resource activities” for a taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in computing its income for the year, an amount is deductible pursuant to any of sections 65 to 66.2 of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation was at any time during the year engaged in activities for the purpose of earning resource profits of the corporation; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: in computing the corporation’s income for the year, an amount was included pursuant to section 59 of the Act.

Subsection.Text: In subsection (1), net resource income of a corporation for a taxation year means the amount, if any, by which the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the resource profits of the corporation for the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of amounts included in computing the income of the corporation for the year, from an active business carried on in Canada, pursuant to section 59 of the Act (other than amounts that may reasonably be regarded as having been included in computing the resource profits of the corporation for the year),

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of amounts deducted in computing the income of the corporation for the year under section 64 of the Act, as that section applies with respect to dispositions occurring before November 13, 1981 and to dispositions occurring after November 12, 1981 pursuant to the terms in existence on that date of an offer or agreement in writing made or entered into on or before that date, except those amounts that may reasonably be regarded as having been deducted in computing the resource profits of the corporation for the year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds the total of

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the total of amounts deducted in computing the income of the corporation for the year under section 65 of the Act (other than amounts that may reasonably be regarded as having been deducted in computing the resource profits of the corporation for the year), and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the specified percentage for the year of the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s resource profits for the year

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds the total of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s Canadian resource profits for the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the earned depletion base (within the meaning assigned by subsection 1205(1)) of the corporation at the beginning of its immediately following taxation year.

Subsection.Text: In subsection (1), the net resource adjustment of a corporation for a taxation year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of Canadian resource profits of the corporation for the year, and
is the amount that would be the Canadian resource profits of the corporation for the year if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: subsections 1204(1) and (1.1) provided for the computation of negative amounts where the amounts subtracted in computing gross resource profits (as defined by subsection 1204(1)) and resource profits “ exceed the amounts added in computing those amounts, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: paragraph 1206(3)(a) applied so that a negative amount of resource profits of a partnership for a fiscal period that ended in the year were, to the extent of the corporation’s share thereof, deducted in computing the corporation’s resource profits for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1), refund interest means an amount that is received, or that becomes receivable, after March 6, 1996 from an authority (including a government or municipality) situated in Canada as a consequence of the overpayment of a tax that was not deductible under the Act in computing any taxpayer’s income and that was imposed by an Act of Canada or a province or a bylaw of a municipality.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: If a corporation is a member of a partnership at any time in a taxation year of the corporation, the following definitions apply:

Definition.Text: cost of capital of the corporation for the year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 10 per cent of the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the gross cost to the corporation of a property referred to in paragraph 1100(1)(e), (f), (g) or (h), paragraph 1102(1)(d) or (g) or Schedule II that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: was owned by the corporation at the end of the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: was used by the corporation at any time during the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of all amounts each of which is the rental cost incurred by the corporation during the year for the use of any property a portion of the gross cost of which would be included by virtue of paragraph (a) if the property were owned by the corporation at the end of the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of the aggregate of the amounts that would be determined under paragraphs (a) and (b) in respect of the partnership for its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the taxation year of the corporation if the references in those paragraphs to “the corporation” were read as references to “the partnership” and the references in those paragraphs to “the year” were read as references to “the fiscal period of the partnership coinciding with or ending in the year”, that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s share of the income or loss of the partnership for that fiscal period

ContinuedParagraph.Text: is of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the income or loss of the partnership for that fiscal period, as the case may be,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but for the purposes of this definition, the gross cost of a property or rental cost for the use of any property does not include that portion of those costs that reflects the extent to which the property was used by the corporation during the year or by the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: in an active business carried on outside Canada,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: to earn Canadian investment income or foreign investment income as defined in subsection 129(4) of the Act on the assumption that subsection 129(4) of the Act applied to a partnership as well as to a corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: in activities engaged in for the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation or the partnership, as the case may be, or

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: in activities referred to in subparagraph 66(15)(b)(i), (ii) or (v), subparagraph 66(15)(e)(i) or (ii), subparagraph 66.1(6)(a)(i), (ii), (iii) or (v) or subparagraph 66.2(5)(a)(i), (ii) or (v) of the Act; (coût en capital)

Definition.Text: cost of labour of the corporation for the year means an amount equal to the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the salaries and wages paid or payable during the year to all employees of the corporation for services performed during the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all other amounts each of which is an amount paid or payable during the year for the performance during the year, by any person other than an employee of the corporation, of functions relating to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the management or administration of the corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: scientific research as defined in section 2900, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: a service or function that would normally be performed by an employee of the corporation, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that proportion of the aggregate of the amounts that would be determined under paragraphs (a) and (b) in respect of the partnership for its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the taxation year of the corporation if the references in those paragraphs to “the corporation” were read as references to “the partnership” and the references in those paragraphs to “the year” were read as references to the “fiscal period of the partnership coinciding with or ending in the year”, that

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation’s share of the income or loss of the partnership for that fiscal period

ContinuedParagraph.Text: is of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the income or loss of the partnership for that fiscal period, as the case may be,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but for the purposes of this definition, the salaries and wages referred to in paragraph (a) or other amounts referred to in paragraph (b), of the corporation or the partnership, as the case may be, do not include that portion of those amounts that

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: was included in the gross cost to the corporation or partnership of a property (other than a property that was manufactured by the corporation or partnership and leased during the year by the corporation or the partnership to another person) that was included in computing the cost of capital of the corporation for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: was related to an active business carried on outside Canada by the corporation or the partnership,

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: was related to the activities engaged in for the purpose of earning Canadian resource profits of the corporation or the partnership, as the case may be, or

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: was included in the Canadian exploration and development expenses, foreign exploration and development expenses, Canadian exploration expense or Canadian development expense, within the meanings assigned by paragraphs 66(15)(b) and (e), 66.1(6)(a) and 66.2(5)(a) of the Act respectively, of the corporation; (coût en main-d’oeuvre)

Definition.Text: cost of manufacturing and processing capital of the corporation for the year means 100/85 of that portion of the cost of capital of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which each property included in the calculation thereof was used directly in qualified activities

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of the corporation during the year, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year, as the case may be,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of capital of the corporation for the year; (coût en capital de fabrication et de transformation)

Definition.Text: cost of manufacturing and processing labour of the corporation for the year means 100/75 of that portion of the cost of labour of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the salaries and wages included in the calculation thereof were paid or payable to persons for the portion of their time that they were directly engaged in qualified activities

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: of the corporation during the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: of the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the other amounts included in the calculation thereof were paid or payable to persons for the performance of functions that would be directly related to qualified activities

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: of the corporation during the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: of the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: if those persons were employees of the corporation or the partnership, as the case may be,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: but the amount so calculated shall not exceed the cost of labour of the corporation for the year; (coût en main-d’oeuvre de fabrication et de transformation)

Definition.Text: gross cost of a property at any time means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of a property that has become available for use by the partnership for the purposes of subsection 13(26) of the Act, the capital cost to the partnership of the property computed without reference to subsections 13(7.1), (7.4) and (10) and sections 21 and 80 of the Act, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of any other property of the partnership, nil,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: and, for the purposes of paragraph (a), if the partnership acquired the property from a person who was a majority-interest partner of the partnership immediately after the property was acquired, the capital cost to the partnership of the property is to be computed as if the property had been acquired at a capital cost equal to the gross cost to the person of the property, except that if the property was partnership property on December 31, 1971, its gross cost is its capital cost to the partnership as determined under subsection 20(3) or (5) of the Income Tax Application Rules; (coût brut)

Definition.Text: ZETM cost of capital, of the corporation for the year, means the portion of the cost of capital of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which each property included in the calculation of the cost of capital was used directly in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: of the corporation during the year, or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: of the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year, as the case may be; (coût en capital de FTZE)

Definition.Text: ZETM cost of labour, of the corporation for the year, means the portion of the cost of labour of the corporation for that year that reflects the extent to which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the salaries and wages included in the calculation of the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons for the portion of their time that they were directly engaged in qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: of the corporation during the year, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: of the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the other amounts included in the calculation of the cost of labour were paid or payable to persons for the performance of functions that would be directly related to qualified zero-emission technology manufacturing activities of the corporation during the year, or of the partnership during its fiscal period coinciding with or ending in the year, if those persons were employees of the corporation or the partnership, as the case may be. (coût en main-d’œuvre de FTZE)

Section.Text: For the purposes of subsections 155(2), 156(3) and 161(9) of the Act, the instalment base of an individual for a taxation year is the amount by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual’s tax payable under Part I of the Act for the year, determined before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount deemed by subsection 120(2) of the Act to have been paid on account of the individual’s tax under Part I of the Act for the year, determined before taking into consideration the specified future tax consequences for the year.
