Paragraph.Text: a member of a registered pension plan makes a contribution to the plan to fund benefits that have become provided at a particular time under a defined benefit provision of the plan in respect of periods before that time,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution is made at a time when the plan is a designated plan, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution would not be an eligible contribution under subsection 147.2(2) of the Act if it were made by an employer who participates in the plan on behalf of the member,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the plan becomes, for the purposes of paragraph 147.1(11)(c) of the Act, a revocable plan immediately before the time the contribution is made.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 147.2(2) of the Act, a contribution described in subsection (2) or (3) is a prescribed contribution.
A contribution that is made by an employer to a registered pension plan is described in this subsection if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution is made pursuant to a recommendation by an actuary in whose opinion the contribution is required to be made so that, if the plan is terminated immediately after the contribution is made, it will have sufficient assets to pay benefits accrued under the defined benefit provisions of the plan, as registered, to the time the contribution is made;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the recommendation is based on an actuarial valuation that complies with the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the effective date of the valuation is not more than four years before the day on which the contribution is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all assumptions made for the purposes of the valuation are reasonable at the time the valuation is prepared and at the time the contribution is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the valuation is prepared in accordance with generally accepted actuarial principles applicable with respect to a valuation prepared on the basis that a plan will be terminated, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: where more than one employer participates in the plan, assets and actuarial liabilities are apportioned in a reasonable manner among participating employers;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the recommendation is approved by the Minister; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at the time the contribution is made, the plan is not a designated plan.

Heading.TitleText: Contributions Required by Pension Benefits Legislation

Subsection.Text: A contribution that is made by an employer to a registered pension plan is described in this subsection if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the contribution

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is required to be made to comply with the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is made in respect of benefits under the defined benefit provisions of the plan as registered, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: is made pursuant to a recommendation by an actuary;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the recommendation is based on an actuarial valuation that complies with the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the effective date of the valuation is not more than four years before the day on which the contribution is made,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all assumptions made for the purposes of the valuation are reasonable at the time the valuation is prepared and at the time the contribution is made, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: where more than one employer participates in the plan, assets and actuarial liabilities are apportioned in a reasonable manner among participating employers;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the recommendation is approved by the Minister; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: at the time the contribution is made, the plan is not a designated plan.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Transfer — Defined Benefit to Money Purchase

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsections (2) to (3.1), for the purpose of applying paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act to the transfer of an amount on behalf of an individual in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan, the prescribed amount is the amount that is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under the provision commuted in connection with the transfer, as determined under subsection (4), and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the present value factor that corresponds to the age attained by the individual at the time of the transfer, determined pursuant to the table to this subsection, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where the present value factor referred to in paragraph (a) is less than the present value factor that corresponds to the next higher age, the present value factor determined by interpolation between those two factors on the basis of the age (expressed in years, including any fraction of a year) of the individual.

Subsection.Text: Where an amount is transferred in full satisfaction of an individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan, the prescribed amount for the purposes of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act in respect of the transfer is the greater of the amount that would, but for this subsection, be the prescribed amount, and the balance, at the time of the transfer, in the individual’s net contribution account (within the meaning assigned by subsection 8503(1)) in relation to the provision.

Subsection (3.01) applies in respect of a transfer of an amount on behalf of an individual in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is an employee or a former employee of an employer (or a predecessor employer of the employer);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the employer

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: was a participating employer under the provision,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is the subject of proceedings commenced under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act or the Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: has ceased making regular contributions under the provision;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: after the commencement of the proceedings, lifetime retirement benefits paid or payable to the individual under the provision have been reduced because the assets of the plan are insufficient to pay the benefits provided under the provision of the plan as registered;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the plan is not a designated plan; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister has approved the application of subsection (3.01) in respect of the transfer.

Subsection.Text: Subsection (3.01) applies in respect of a transfer of an amount on behalf of an individual in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the individual is an employee or a former employee of an employer (or a predecessor employer of the employer) that was a participating employer under the provision;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: lifetime retirement benefits paid or payable to the individual under the provision have been reduced because the assets of the plan are insufficient to pay the benefits provided under the provision of the plan as registered;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the Minister has approved the application of subsection (3.01) in respect of the transfer; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: either

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the plan is not an individual pension plan and the reduction in the lifetime retirement benefits paid or payable to the individual has been approved under the Pension Benefits Standards Act, 1985 or a similar law of a province, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the plan is an individual pension plan, the amount transferred from the plan on behalf of the individual is the last payment from the plan to the individual and all the property held in connection with the plan is distributed from the plan on behalf of plan members within 90 days of the transfer.

Subsection.Text: If this subsection applies, the description of A in subsection (1) is to be read as follows in respect of the transfer:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under the provision commuted in connection with the transfer, as determined under subsection (4), but without reference to the benefit reduction referred to in paragraph (3)(c) or (3.001)(b), as the case may be; and

Subsection.Text: If a particular amount is transferred in full or partial satisfaction of an individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan and subsection (3.01) had applied in respect of a transfer (in this subsection referred to as the “initial transfer”) of an amount on behalf of the individual under the provision, for the purpose of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act the prescribed amount in respect of the transfer of the particular amount is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular amount, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount, if any, by which the prescribed amount in respect of the initial transfer exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a previous transfer to which this subsection or subsection (3.01) applied in respect of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under the provision.

Heading.TitleText: Benefits Provided With Surplus on Plan Wind-up

Subsection.Text: Where an amount is transferred in full or partial satisfaction of an individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan and the benefits include benefits (in this subsection referred to as “ancillary benefits”) that are permissible solely because of subsection 8501(7), the prescribed amount for the purpose of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act in respect of the transfer is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount that would, but for this subsection, be the prescribed amount, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: an amount approved by the Minister not exceeding the lesser of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the present value (at the time of the transfer) of the ancillary benefits that, as a consequence of the transfer, cease to be provided, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is, in respect of a previous transfer from the provision to a money purchase provision of a registered pension plan, a registered retirement savings plan or a registered retirement income fund in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to other benefits under the defined benefit provision, the amount, if any, by which

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the prescribed amount for the purpose of paragraph 147.3(4)(c) of the Act in respect of the previous transfer

ContinuedSubparagraph.Text: exceeds

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount of the previous transfer.

Heading.TitleText: Amount of Lifetime Retirement Benefits Commuted

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (1), and subject to subsection (7), the amount of an individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan commuted in connection with the transfer of an amount on behalf of the individual in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under the provision is the aggregate of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where retirement benefits have commenced to be paid under the provision to the individual, the amount (expressed on an annualized basis) by which the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under the provision are reduced as a result of the transfer,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where retirement benefits have not commenced to be paid under the provision to the individual, the amount (expressed on an annualized basis) by which the individual’s normalized pension (computed in accordance with subsection (5)) under the provision at the time of the transfer is reduced as a result of the transfer, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where, in conjunction with the transfer, any other payment (other than an amount that is transferred in accordance with subsection 147.3(5) of the Act or that is transferred after 1991 in accordance with subsection 147.3(3) of the Act) is made from the plan in partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under the provision, the amount (expressed on an annualized basis) by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if paragraph (a) is applicable, the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under the provision are reduced, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: if paragraph (b) is applicable, the individual’s normalized pension (computed in accordance with subsection (5)) under the provision at the time of the payment is reduced,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: as a result of the payment, except to the extent that such reduction is included in determining, for the purposes of subsection (1), the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under the provision commuted in connection with the transfer of another amount on behalf of the individual.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection (4), the normalized pension of an individual under a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan at a particular time is the amount (expressed on an annualized basis) of lifetime retirement benefits that would be payable under the provision at the particular time if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: lifetime retirement benefits commenced to be paid to the individual at the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual has not attained 65 years of age before the particular time, the individual attained that age at the particular time;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: all benefits to which the individual is entitled under the provision were fully vested;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits would otherwise be determined with a reduction computed by reference to the individual’s age, duration of service, or both, or with any other similar reduction, no such reduction were applied;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits depends on the amount of benefits provided under another benefit provision of the plan or under another plan or arrangement, a reasonable estimate were made of those other benefits;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: where the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits would otherwise include benefits that the plan is required to provide by reason of a designated provision of the law of Canada or a province, or that the plan would be required to provide if each such provision were applicable to the plan with respect to all its members, such benefits were not included; and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: except as otherwise provided by subsection (6), where the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits depends on

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the form of benefits provided with respect to the individual under the provision (whether or not at the option of the individual), including

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the benefits to be provided after the death of the individual,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount of retirement benefits, other than lifetime retirement benefits, provided to the individual, or

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: the extent to which the lifetime retirement benefits will be adjusted to reflect changes in the cost of living, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: circumstances that are relevant in determining the form of benefits,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the form of benefits and the circumstances were such as to maximize the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits on commencement of payment.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the terms of a defined benefit provision of a registered pension plan permit an individual to elect to receive additional lifetime retirement benefits in lieu of benefits that would, in the absence of the election, be payable after the death of the individual if the individual dies after retirement benefits under the provision commence to be paid to the individual, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the elections available to the individual include an election

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: to receive additional lifetime retirement benefits, not exceeding additional benefits determined on an actuarially equivalent basis, in lieu of all or a portion of a guarantee that retirement benefits will be paid for a minimum period of 10 years or less, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: to receive additional lifetime retirement benefits in lieu of retirement benefits that would otherwise be payable to a person who is a spouse or common-law partner or former spouse or common-law partner of the individual for a period beginning after the death of the individual and ending with the death of the person, where

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the election may be made only if the life expectancy of the person is significantly shorter than normal and has been so certified in writing by a medical doctor or a nurse practitioner licensed to practise under the laws of a province or of the place where the person resides, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the additional benefits do not exceed additional benefits determined on an actuarially equivalent basis and on the assumption that the person has a normal life expectancy,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: paragraph (5)(g) applies as if

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the election described in subparagraph (b)(i) were not available to the individual, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where the particular time the normalized pension of the individual is determined under subsection (5) is after 1991, the election described in subparagraph (b)(ii) were not available to the individual.

Subsection.Text: Where

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount is transferred on behalf of an individual in full or partial satisfaction of the individual’s entitlement to benefits under a defined benefit provision (in this subsection referred to as the “particular provision”) of a registered pension plan,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in conjunction with the transfer, benefits become provided to the individual under another defined benefit provision of the plan or under a defined benefit provision of another registered pension plan, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: an employer who participated under the particular provision for the benefit of the individual also participates under the other provision for the individual’s benefit,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: the amount of the individual’s lifetime retirement benefits under the particular provision commuted in connection with the transfer is the amount that would be determined under subsection (4) if the benefits provided under the other provision were provided under the particular provision.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this section, if subsection 147.4(5) of the Act deems an amount to be transferred under a defined benefit provision (as defined in subsection 147.1(1) of the Act) of a registered pension plan, the benefits payable under the annuity contract are deemed to be benefits payable under the provision.

Heading.TitleText: Association of Benefits with Time Periods

Section.Text: Where, for the purposes of Part LXXXIII or this Part or subsection 147.1(10) of the Act, it is necessary to associate benefits provided under a defined benefit provision of a pension plan with periods of time, the association shall be made in a manner acceptable to the Minister.

Section.Text: For the purposes of this Part, a waiver, extension of time or other modification of the requirements of this Part granted by the Minister or an approval by the Minister in respect of any matter is not effective unless it is in writing and expressly refers to the requirement that is modified or the matter in respect of which the approval is given.

Section.Text: For the purposes of this Part and Part I.3 of the Act,

Definition.Text: attributed surplus of a non-resident insurer for a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection 2400(1); (surplus attribué)

Canadian assets of a corporation that is a financial institution (as defined in subsection 181(1) of the Act) at any time in a taxation year means, in respect of the year, the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount at which an asset of the corporation (which asset is required, or, if the corporation were a bank to which the Bank Act applied, would be required, to be reflected in a return under subsection 223(1) of the Bank Act, as that Act read on May 31, 1992, if that return were prepared on a non-consolidated basis) would be shown on the corporation’s balance sheet at the end of the year if its balance sheet were prepared on a non-consolidated basis

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the investment allowance of the corporation for the year determined under subsection 181.3(4) of the Act; (actif canadien)

Definition.Text: Canadian premiums for a taxation year, in respect of an insurance corporation that was resident in Canada at any time in the year and throughout the year did not carry on a life insurance business, means the total of the insurance corporation’s net premiums for the year

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of insurance on property situated in Canada, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in respect of insurance, other than on property, from contracts with persons resident in Canada,

ContinuedDefinition.Text: and, for the purposes of this definition, net premiums has the same meaning as in subsection 403(2), and subsection 403(3) applies as if the references therein to “province” were read as references to “country”; (primes canadiennes)

Definition.Text: Canadian reserve liabilities of an insurer as at the end of a taxation year has the meaning assigned by subsection 2400(1); ((passif de réserve canadienne))

contractual service margin for a group of insurance contracts of an insurer, or a group of reinsurance contracts held by the insurer, at the end of a taxation year, has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; (marge sur services contractuels)
group of insurance contracts of an insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; (groupe de contrats d’assurance)
group of reinsurance contracts held by an insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; (groupe de contrats de réassurance)
group of segregated fund policies of an insurer has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; (groupe de polices à fonds réservé)
permanent establishment has the same meaning as in subsection 400(2); (établissement stable)
policyholders’ liabilities of an insurer at the end of a taxation year has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; (obligation envers les titulaires de polices)

reinsurance contract held amount for a group of reinsurance contracts held by an insurer at the end of a taxation year has the same meaning as in subsection 138(12) of the Act; (montant au titre des contrats de réassurance détenus)
total assets of a corporation that is a financial institution (as defined in subsection 181(1) of the Act) at any time in a taxation year means, in respect of that year, the amount, if any, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount at which an asset of the corporation would be shown on the corporation’s balance sheet at the end of the year if its balance sheet were prepared on a non-consolidated basis

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the investment allowance of the corporation for the year determined under subsection 181.3(4) of the Act; (actif total)

Definition.Text: total premiums for a taxation year, in respect of an insurance corporation that was resident in Canada at any time in the year and throughout the year did not carry on a life insurance business, means the total of the corporation’s net premiums for the year (as defined in subsection 403(2)) that are included in computing its income under Part I of the Act; (total des primes)
total reserve liabilities of an insurer as at the end of a taxation year means the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of the insurer’s liabilities and reserves including liabilities for segregated fund guarantees (other than policyholders’ liabilities or a liability for an obligation to pay a benefit under a segregated fund policy in respect of which subparagraphs 1406(b)(i) and (ii) apply) as at the end of the year in respect of insurance policies, as determined for the purposes of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, if the insurer is required by law to report to the Superintendent of Financial Institutions, or, in any other case, the superintendent of insurance or other similar officer or authority of the province under the laws of which the insurer is incorporated;
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of an item reported by the insurer as an insurance contract asset as at the end of the year;
is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount of funds withheld as at the end of the year by the insurer in respect of the reinsurance of a risk under an insurance policy;

is the total of all amounts each which is an amount recoverable as at the end of the year by the insurer under a funds withheld arrangement in respect of the reinsurance of a risk by the insurer under an insurance policy;
is the total of all amounts each of which is the contractual service margin for a group of insurance contracts (other than a group of segregated fund policies) of the insurer at the end of the year;
is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount, in respect of a group of reinsurance contracts held by the insurer at the end of the year, that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the reinsurance contract held amount for the group, if there is no reinsurance contract held amount for the group that is in respect of the reinsurance of an obligation to pay a benefit under a segregated fund policy in respect of which subparagraphs 1406(b)(i) and (ii) apply, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount that would be the reinsurance contract held amount for the group if the reinsurance contract held amount were determined excluding any portion that is in respect of the reinsurance of an obligation to pay a benefit under a segregated fund policy in respect of which subparagraphs 1406(b)(i) and (ii) apply; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, in respect of a group of reinsurance contracts held by the insurer at the end of the year, that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if no portion of the contractual service margin for the group is in respect of a risk under a segregated fund policy, the contractual service margin for the group, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount that would be the contractual service margin for the group if the contractual service margin were determined excluding any portion that is in respect of the reinsurance of a risk under a segregated fund policy. (passif total de réserve)

Section.Text: For the purpose of determining the taxable capital employed in Canada of a corporation for a taxation year under subsection 181.2(1) of the Act, the prescribed proportion of the corporation’s taxable capital (as determined under Part I.3 of the Act) for the year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the taxable capital (as determined under Part I.3 of the Act) of the corporation for the year,

is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, determined in accordance with Part IV (or, in the case of an airline corporation, that would be so determined if the corporation had a permanent establishment in every province and if paragraphs 407(1)(a) and (b) were read without reference to the words “in Canada”), of the corporation’s taxable income earned in the year in a particular province or the amount of its taxable income that would, pursuant to that Part, be earned in the year in a province if all permanent establishments of the corporation in Canada were in a province, and
is the corporation’s taxable income for the year,

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: except that, where the corporation’s taxable income for the year is nil, the corporation shall, for the purposes of this section, be deemed to have a taxable income for the year of $1,000.

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition Canadian surtax payable in subsection 125.3(4) of the Act, the prescribed proportion of the amount determined under section 123.2 of the Act in respect of a corporation for a taxation year is the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined under section 123.2 of the Act in respect of the corporation for the year;
is

FormulaParagraph.Text: where the corporation carried on a life insurance business at any time in the year, the corporation’s taxable capital (as determined under Part I.3 of the Act) for the year, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the corporation’s taxable capital (as determined under Part I.3 of the Act) for the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subclause 181.3(1)(c)(ii)(A)(II) and clause 190.11(b)(i)(B) of the Act, the amount prescribed in respect of a particular corporation for a taxation year ending at a particular time is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount determined in respect of a corporation that is, at the particular time, a foreign insurance subsidiary of the particular corporation, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined by the formula

is the amount of the subsidiary’s long-term debt at the end of the subsidiary’s last taxation year ending at or before the particular time (in this subsection referred to as the “last taxation year”),
is the total amount at the end of the subsidiary’s last taxation year of the subsidiary’s

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: capital stock (or, in the case of an insurance corporation incorporated without share capital, the amount of its members’ contributions),

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: retained earnings,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: accumulated other comprehensive income,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (d)
FormulaParagraph.Text: policyholders’ liabilities,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (e)
FormulaParagraph.Text: contributed surplus, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (f)
FormulaParagraph.Text: any other surpluses,

FormulaDefinition.Text: is total of all amounts each of which is the contractual service margin for a group of insurance contracts of the subsidiary at the end of the subsidiary’s last taxation year other than a group of segregated fund policies,
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount, in respect of a group of reinsurance contracts held by the subsidiary at the end of the subsidiary’s last taxation year, that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if no portion of the contractual service margin for the group is in respect of a risk under a segregated fund policy, the contractual service margin for the group, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the amount that would be the contractual service margin for the group if the amount were determined excluding any portion that is in respect of the reinsurance of a risk under a segregated fund policy, and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount of any deficit deducted in computing the subsidiary’s shareholders’ equity at the end of the subsidiary’s last taxation year; and
is the amount determined by the formula

is the total of all amounts each of which is the carrying value to its owner at the particular time for the taxation year that includes the particular time of a share of the subsidiary’s capital stock or its long-term debt that is owned at the particular time by

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the particular corporation,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a subsidiary of the particular corporation,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a corporation

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: that is resident in Canada,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: that carried on a life insurance business in Canada at any time in its taxation year ending at or before the particular time, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (iii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: that is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a corporation of which the particular corporation is a subsidiary, or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a subsidiary of a corporation described in clause (A), or

FormulaParagraph.Label: (d)
FormulaParagraph.Text: a subsidiary of a corporation described in paragraph (c), and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is an amount included under the description of A in respect of any surplus of the subsidiary contributed by a corporation described in paragraphs (a) to (d) of the description of H, other than an amount included under the description of H.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subclause 181.3(1)(c)(ii)(A)(III) and clause 190.11(b)(i)(C) of the Act, the amount prescribed in respect of a particular corporation for a taxation year ending at a particular time is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount determined in respect of a corporation that is, at the particular time, a foreign insurance subsidiary of the particular corporation, determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount determined for B in subsection (1) in respect of the subsidiary, and
is the amount determined for A in subsection (1) in respect of the subsidiary.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subclause 181.3(1)(c)(ii)(A)(V) and clause 190.11(b)(i)(E) of the Act, the amount prescribed in respect of a particular corporation for a taxation year ending at a particular time means the total of all amounts each of which would be the total reserve liabilities of a foreign insurance subsidiary of the particular corporation as at the end of the subsidiary’s last taxation year ending at or before the particular time if the subsidiary were required by law to report to the Superintendent of Financial Institutions for that year.
The definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

Definition.Text: foreign insurance subsidiary of a particular corporation at any time means a non-resident corporation that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: carried on a life insurance business throughout its last taxation year ending at or before that time,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: did not carry on a life insurance business in Canada at any time in its last taxation year ending at or before that time, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: is at that time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: a subsidiary of the particular corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: not a subsidiary of any corporation that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: is resident in Canada,

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: carried on a life insurance business in Canada at any time in its last taxation year ending at or before that time, and

Clause.Label: (C)
Clause.Text: is a subsidiary of the particular corporation. (filiale d’assurance étrangère)

Definition.Text: subsidiary of a corporation (in this definition referred to as the parent corporation) means a corporation controlled by the parent corporation where shares of each class of the capital stock of the corporation having a fair market value of not less than 75% of the fair market value of all of the issued and outstanding shares of that class belong to

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the parent corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that is a subsidiary of the parent corporation, or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: any combination of corporations each of which is a corporation referred to in paragraph (a) or described in paragraph (b). (filiale)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 149.1(6.4)(d) of the Act, the following conditions are prescribed for a national arts service organization:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the organization is an organization

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that is, because of paragraph 149(1)(l) of the Act, exempt from tax under Part I of the Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: that represents, in an official language of Canada, a community of artists from one or more of the following sectors of activity in the arts community, that is, theatre, opera, music, dance, painting, sculpture, drawing, crafts, design, photography, the literary arts, film, sound recording and other audio-visual arts,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: no part of the income of which may be payable to, or otherwise available for the personal benefit of, any proprietor, member, shareholder, trustee, or settlor of the organization, except where the payment is for services rendered or is an amount to which paragraph 56(1)(n) of the Act applies in respect of the recipient,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: all of the resources of which are devoted to the activities and objects described in its application for its last designation by the Minister of Canadian Heritage pursuant to paragraph 149.1(6.4)(a) of the Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: more than 50 per cent of the directors, trustees, officers or other officials of which deal with each other at arm’s length, and

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: no more than 50% of the property of which at any time has been contributed or otherwise paid into the organization by one person or members of a group of persons who do not deal with each other at arm’s length and, for the purpose of this subparagraph, a reference to any person or to members of a group does not include a reference to Her Majesty in Right of Canada or a province, a municipality, a registered charity that is not a private foundation or any club, society or association described in paragraph 149(1)(l) of the Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the activities of the organization (which may include collective bargaining on behalf of its sector of activity under the Status of the Artist Act, provided it is not the organization’s primary activity) are confined to one or more of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: promoting one or more art forms,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: conducting research into one or more art forms,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: sponsoring arts exhibitions or performances,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: representing interests of the arts community or a sector thereof (but not of individuals) before governmental, judicial, quasi-judicial or other public bodies,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: conducting workshops, seminars, training programs and similar development programs relating to the arts for members of the organization, in respect of which the value of benefits received or enjoyed by members of the organization is required by paragraph 56(1)(aa) of the Act to be included in computing the incomes of those members,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: educating the public about the arts community or the sector represented by the organization,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: organizing and sponsoring conventions, conferences, competitions and special events relating to the arts community or the sector represented by the organization,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: conducting arts studies and surveys of interest to members of the organization relating to the arts community or the sector represented by the organization,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: acting as an information centre by maintaining resource libraries and data bases relating to the arts community or the sector represented by the organization,

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: disseminating information relating to the arts community or the sector represented by the organization, and

Subparagraph.Label: (xi)
Subparagraph.Text: paying amounts to which paragraph 56(1)(n) of the Act applies in respect of the recipient and which relate to the arts community or the sector represented by the organization.

Section.Text: The renovations and alterations that are prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 20(1)(qq) of the Act are

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the installation of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an interior or exterior ramp, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a hand-activated electric door opener; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a modification to a bathroom, elevator or doorway to accommodate its use by a person in a wheelchair.

Section.Text: The devices and equipment that are prescribed for the purposes of paragraph 20(1)(rr) of the Act are

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an elevator car position indicator, such as a braille panel or an audio signal, for individuals having a sight impairment;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a visual fire alarm indicator, a listening device for group meetings or a telephone device, for individuals having a hearing impairment; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a disability-specific computer software or hardware attachment.

Heading.Label: PART LXXXIX
Heading.TitleText: Entities Prescribed with Respect to Certain Rules

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subparagraph 110(1)(f)(iii) and paragraph 126(3)(a) of the Act, the following international organizations are prescribed:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the United Nations; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each international organization that is a specialized agency brought into relationship with the United Nations in accordance with Article 63 of the Charter of the United Nations.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subparagraph 110(1)(f)(iv) of the Act, the following international non-governmental organizations are prescribed:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the International Air Transport Association;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the Société internationale de télécommunications aéronautiques; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the World Anti-Doping Agency.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (f) of the definition eligible entity in subsection 125.7(1) of the Act, the following entities are prescribed:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that meets the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: it is described in paragraph 149(1)(d.5) of the Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: not less than 90% of the shares, or the capital, of the corporation are owned by one or more Aboriginal governments (as defined in subsection 241(10) of the Act) — or similar Indigenous governing bodies — described in paragraph 149(1)(c) of the Act, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: it carries on a business;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation that meets the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: it is described in paragraph 149(1)(d.6) of the Act,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: all of the shares (except directors’ qualifying shares), or the capital, of the corporation are owned by one or more of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: an Aboriginal government (as defined in subsection 241(10) of the Act) — or a similar Indigenous governing body — described in paragraph 149(1)(c) of the Act, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: a corporation described in this paragraph or paragraph (a), and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: it carries on a business;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership, each member of which is

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an eligible entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: an Aboriginal government (as defined in subsection 241(10) of the Act) — or a similar Indigenous governing body — described in paragraph 149(1)(c) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a partnership, in respect of a qualifying period, if throughout the qualifying period it is the case that

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts, each of which is the fair market value of an interest in the partnership held — directly or indirectly, through one or more partnerships — by a person or partnership other than an eligible entity, and
is the total fair market value of all interests in the partnership;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a person described in paragraph 149(1)(g) or (h) of the Act; and

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a person or partnership that operates a private school or private college.

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of subsection 125.7(1) of the Act, qualifying tourism or hospitality entity, for a qualifying period, means an eligible entity that meets the following conditions:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the entity has a prior year revenue decline greater than or equal to 40%; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts, each of which is the eligible entity’s qualifying revenue for the prior reference period for any of the first qualifying period to the thirteenth qualifying period (but including only one of the tenth qualifying period or the eleventh qualifying period), was earned primarily from carrying on one or more of the following activities:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing a facility providing short-term lodging, such as a hotel, a motel, a cottage, a bed and breakfast or a youth hostel,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: preparing and serving meals, snacks and beverages made to order for immediate consumption on or off the premises,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: such as a restaurant, a food truck, a cafeteria, a caterer, a coffee shop, a food concession, a bar, a pub or a nightclub, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: for greater certainty, not including the operation of a facility primarily engaged in retailing food or beverage products, such as a supermarket or a convenience store,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: operating a travel agency or as a tour operator, including:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: acting as an agent for tour operators, transportation companies and short-term lodging establishments in selling travel, tour and accommodation services, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: arranging, assembling and marketing tours,

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: organizing, promoting, hosting, supporting or participating in events that meet the artistic or cultural interests of their patrons, including live performances or exhibits intended for public viewing,

Subparagraph.Label: (v)
Subparagraph.Text: preserving and exhibiting objects, sites and natural wonders of historical, cultural or educational value, such as the operation of a museum, a historic and heritage site, a zoo, a botanical garden or a nature park,

Subparagraph.Label: (vi)
Subparagraph.Text: organizing, promoting or supporting scenic and sightseeing tours, such as sightseeing or dinner cruises, steam train excursions, horse-drawn sightseeing rides, air-boat rides, hot-air balloon rides or charter fishing services,

Subparagraph.Label: (vii)
Subparagraph.Text: providing charter bus services, if

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the buses do not operate on fixed routes and schedules, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the entire vehicle is rented, rather than individual seats,

Subparagraph.Label: (viii)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing an amusement or theme park, which includes

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: operating a variety of attractions, such as mechanical rides, water rides, games, shows or theme exhibits, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: leasing space on a concession basis for these operations,

Subparagraph.Label: (ix)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing a facility or providing a service that enables patrons to participate in recreational activities,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: including

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: fitness and recreational sports centres,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: downhill and cross-country ski/snowboard areas, and equipment such as ski lifts and tows (including revenues from equipment rental services and ski/snowboard instruction services provided at the area),

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: the operation of docking and storage facilities for pleasure-craft owners, with or without related activities, such as retailing fuel and marine supplies, boat repair and maintenance and rental services,

Subclause.Label: (IV)
Subclause.Text: the operation of recreation and amusement facilities and services including establishments primarily engaged in maintaining non-gambling coin-operated amusement devices, in businesses operated by others, and

Subclause.Label: (V)
Subclause.Text: other amusement activities, such as amateur sports clubs, teams or leagues, archery or shooting, ballroom dancing, river rafting, curling clubs, mini golf and bowling, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: excluding

Subclause.Label: (I)
Subclause.Text: golf, golf instruction and the ownership or operation of a facility that is a golf course, a golf driving range, or a golf clubhouse,

Subclause.Label: (II)
Subclause.Text: country clubs, and

Subclause.Label: (III)
Subclause.Text: professional sports clubs, teams or leagues or facilities used primarily by such organizations,

Subparagraph.Label: (x)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing serviced or unserviced sites to accommodate campers and their equipment for tents, tent trailers, travel trailers and recreational vehicles, excluding mobile home sites,

Subparagraph.Label: (xi)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing an overnight recreational camp, such as a children’s camp, a family vacation camp or an outdoor adventure retreat,

Subparagraph.Label: (xii)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing a hunting camp or a fishing camp,

Subparagraph.Label: (xiii)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing a duty-free retail store at a land border crossing where the only exit route is to the United States,

Subparagraph.Label: (xiv)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing a facility that is primarily engaged in exhibiting motion pictures, such as a cinema or a drive-in theatre,

Subparagraph.Label: (xv)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing an amusement arcade, such as a family fun centre, an indoor play area, a pinball arcade or a video game arcade,

Subparagraph.Label: (xvi)
Subparagraph.Text: operating a facility allowing passengers to board and leave a cruise ship,

Subparagraph.Label: (xvii)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing an airport, including renting hangar space and providing baggage handling, cargo handling and aircraft parking services,

Subparagraph.Label: (xviii)
Subparagraph.Text: operating or managing a casino,

Subparagraph.Label: (xix)
Subparagraph.Text: promoting a destination or region in Canada for the purpose of attracting tourism,

Subparagraph.Label: (xx)
Subparagraph.Text: organizing, planning, promoting, hosting or supporting:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: conventions, trade shows or festivals, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: weddings, parties or similar events, and

Subparagraph.Label: (xxi)
Subparagraph.Text: promoting the interests of the members of an industry organization or association, if the members are primarily engaged in activities described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (xx).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: partial public health restriction means a public health restriction as defined in subsection 125.7(1) of the Act if paragraphs (f) to (h) of that definition were replaced by the following:

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: as a result of the order or decision, some or all of the activities of the eligible entity — or the specified tenant — at, or in connection with, the qualifying property (that it is reasonable to expect the eligible entity — or the specified tenant — would, absent the order or decision, otherwise have engaged in) are required to be reduced by means of capacity or similar restrictions by not less than 50% (referred to in this subsection as the “limited activities”); and

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: the limited activities are required to be reduced for a period of at least one week. (restrictions sanitaires partielles)

Definition.Text: qualifying partial public health restriction, of an eligible entity for a qualifying period, means that

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: one or more qualifying properties of the eligible entity — or of one or more specified tenants (within the meaning of the definition public health restriction) of the eligible entity — is subject to a partial public health restriction for at least seven days in the qualifying period; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: it is reasonable to conclude that at least approximately 50% of the qualifying revenues of the eligible entity — together with the qualifying revenues of any specified tenants of the eligible entity — for the prior reference period were derived from the limited activities. (restrictions sanitaires partielles admissibles)

Subsection.Text: The amount determined by regulation in respect of a qualifying entity for the purposes of clause (b)(iv)(B) of the description of A in subsection 125.7(2) of the Act for a week in a qualifying period is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: for the seventh qualifying period and the eighth qualifying period, the greater of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined for the week under subparagraph (a)(i) of the description of A in subsection 125.7(2) of the Act, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount determined for the week under subparagraph (a)(ii) of the description of A in subsection 125.7(2) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: for the ninth qualifying period and the tenth qualifying period, the greater of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 55% of baseline remuneration (as defined in subsection 125.7(1) of the Act) in respect of the eligible employee determined for that week, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: for any of the eleventh qualifying period to the nineteenth qualifying period, the greater of

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 55% of baseline remuneration (as defined in subsection 125.7(1) of the Act) in respect of the eligible employee determined for that week, and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: for the twentieth qualifying period and any subsequent qualifying period, nil.

Subsection.Text: The percentage determined for the purposes of the definition base percentage in subsection 125.7(1) of the Act, in respect of an eligible entity, is, for the twenty-fourth qualifying period to the twenty-sixth qualifying period, the greater of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the percentage determined for the eligible entity for the qualifying period under paragraph (l) of the definition base percentage in subsection 125.7(1) of the Act if it were read without the application of this subsection, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the lesser of 75% and the eligible entity’s revenue reduction percentage for the qualifying period, if, for the qualifying period,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the eligible entity’s revenue reduction percentage is greater than or equal to 25%, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: one of the following conditions is met:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the eligible entity is subject to a qualifying public health restriction, or

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the eligible entity is subject to a qualifying partial public health restriction.

Heading.Label: PART XC
Heading.TitleText: Financial Institutions — Prescribed Entities and Properties
Prescribed Person not a Financial Institution

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (e) of the definition financial institution in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, the following are prescribed persons:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the Business Development Bank of Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (a.1)
Paragraph.Text: Farm Credit Canada;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: BDC Capital Inc.; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a trust, at any particular time, if at that particular time

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the trust is a related segregated fund trust (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 138.1(1)(a) of the Act),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the trust is deemed, under paragraph 138.1(1)(a) of the Act, to have been created at a time that is not more than two years before that particular time, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the cost of the trustee’s interest (as determined by paragraph 138.1(1)(c) and (d) of the Act) in the trust does not exceed $5,000,000.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: In this section, qualified small business corporation, at any time, means a corporation in respect of which the following conditions are satisfied at that time:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation is a Canadian-controlled private corporation;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation either is an eligible corporation (as defined in subsection 5100(1)) or would be an eligible corporation if the definition eligible corporation in subsection 5100(1) were read without reference to its paragraph (e);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the carrying value of the total assets of the corporation and all corporations related to it (determined in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles on a consolidated or combined basis, where applicable) does not exceed $50,000,000; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: the number of employees of the corporation and all corporations related to it does not exceed 500.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition excluded property in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a share of the capital stock of a corporation is a prescribed property of a taxpayer if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: immediately after the time at which the taxpayer acquired the share, the corporation was a qualified small business corporation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation continued to be a qualified small business corporation for one year after that time, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer could not reasonably expect at that time that the corporation would cease to be a qualified small business corporation within one year after that time; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the share was issued to the taxpayer in exchange for one or more shares of the capital stock of the corporation that were, at the time of the exchange, prescribed property of the taxpayer under this subsection.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraph (e) of the definition excluded property in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, and of subparagraph 142.6(4)(a)(ii) of the Act, a debt obligation held by a bank is a prescribed property of the bank if the obligation is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an exposure to a designated country (within the meaning assigned by section 8006);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a United Mexican States Collateralized Par Bond due 2019; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a United Mexican States Collateralized Discount Bond due 2019.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition excluded property in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a share is a prescribed property of a taxpayer for a taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the share is a lending asset of the taxpayer in the year; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the share was, immediately after its issuance, a share described in paragraph (e) of the definition term preferred share in subsection 248(1) of the Act, and the share would, at any time in the year, be a term preferred share if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: that definition were read without ref- erence to the portion following paragraph (b), and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: where the share was issued or acquired on or before June 28, 1982, it were issued or acquired after that day.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph (e) of the definition excluded property in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a share of the capital stock of a corporation that is held by a credit union is a prescribed property of the credit union for a taxation year if, throughout the period (referred to in this subsection as the “holding period”) in that taxation year during which the credit union holds the share

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the corporation is a credit union; or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the following conditions are satisfied:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: credit unions hold shares of the corporation that

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: give those credit unions at least 50% of the votes that could be cast under all circumstances at an annual meeting of shareholders of the corporation, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: have a fair market value of at least 50% of the fair market value of all the issued shares of the corporation,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation is not controlled, directly or indirectly in any manner whatever, by any person that is not a credit union, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the corporation would not be controlled by a person that is not a credit union if each share of the corporation that is not owned at any time in the holding period by a credit union were owned, at that time, by the person.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (3), if a partnership, at a particular time, owns or holds shares of a corporation (or is deemed under this subsection to own or hold shares of a corporation) that have a fair market value of at least 50% of all the issued shares of the corporation,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the partnership is deemed not to exist at that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: each member of the partnership is deemed to own or hold at that time that proportion of shares of any class of the capital stock of the corporation that are property of the partnership at that time, that the fair market value of the member’s interest in the partnership is of the fair market value of all interests in the partnership at that time.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph (3)(b), a subsidiary wholly-owned corporation of a credit union is deemed to be a credit union.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Prescribed Payment Card Corporation Share not Mark-to-Market Property

Section.Text: For the purpose of paragraph (b) of the definition excluded property in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a prescribed payment card corporation share of a taxpayer at any time means a share of the capital stock of a particular corporation if, at that time,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular corporation is any one of the following

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: MasterCard International Incorporated,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: MasterCard Incorporated,

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: Visa Inc., or

Subparagraph.Label: (iv)
Subparagraph.Text: Interac Corp.; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the share

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: is of a class of shares that is not listed on a stock exchange,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is not convertible into or exchangeable for a share of the class of the capital stock of a corporation that is listed on a stock exchange, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: was issued by the particular corporation to the taxpayer or to a person related to the taxpayer.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]
[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purpose of paragraph 142.2(3)(c) of the Act, a share described in paragraph 9002(2)(b) is prescribed in respect of all taxpayers.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Financing Arrangement not a Specified Debt Obligation

Section.Text: For the purpose of paragraph (c) of the definition specified debt obligation in subsection 142.2(1) of the Act, a property is a prescribed property throughout a taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the property is a direct financing lease, or any other financing arrangement, of a taxpayer that is reported as a loan in the taxpayer’s financial statements for the year prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: in computing the taxpayer’s income for the year, an amount is deductible under paragraph 20(1)(a) of the Act in respect of the property that is the subject of the arrangement.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of the definition non-reporting financial institution in subsection 270(1) of the Act, the following entities are prescribed:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a labour-sponsored venture capital corporation as prescribed in section 6701;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a registered retirement income fund;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a pooled registered pension plan;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a deferred profit sharing plan;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a registered disability savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a registered education savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a registered pension plan;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: a trust governed by a registered pension plan;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a trust described in paragraph 149(1)(o.4) of the Act, if all of the interests in the trust as a beneficiary are held by one or more registered pension plans;

Paragraph.Label: (k)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation described in clause 149(1)(o.1)(i)(A) or subparagraph 149(1)(o.1)(ii) or (o.2)(i) of the Act;

Paragraph.Label: (l)
Paragraph.Text: a corporation described in any of subparagraphs 149(1)(o.2)(ii) to (iii) of the Act, if all of the shares of the corporation are held by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more registered pension plans or trusts governed by registered pension plans,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more trusts described in paragraph (j), or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: one or more corporations described in this paragraph or paragraph (k);

Paragraph.Label: (m)
Paragraph.Text: a trust, if all of the interests in the trust as a beneficiary are held by one or more plans, trusts or corporations described in paragraph (i), (k) or (l);

Paragraph.Label: (n)
Paragraph.Text: a central cooperative credit society, as defined in section 2 of the Cooperative Credit Associations Act and whose accounts are maintained for member financial institutions;

Paragraph.Label: (o)
Paragraph.Text: a TFSA; and

Paragraph.Label: (p)
Paragraph.Text: a FHSA.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of the definition excluded account in subsection 270(1) of the Act, the following accounts are prescribed:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a registered retirement savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (b)

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a pooled registered pension plans;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a registered pension plan;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a registered disability savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a registered education savings plan;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: a deferred profit sharing plan;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: a net income stabilization account, including a NISA Fund No. 2;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: an eligible funeral arrangement;

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a dormant account if the balance or value of the account does not exceed 1,000 USD;

Paragraph.Label: (k)
