Heading.Label: PART XCI
Heading.TitleText: Financial Institutions — Income from Specified Debt Obligations

Section.Text: The following definitions apply in this Part.

Definition.Text: fixed payment obligation, of a taxpayer, means a specified debt obligation under which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount and timing of each payment (other than a fee or similar payment or an amount payable because of a default by the debtor) to be made by the debtor were fixed when the taxpayer acquired the obligation and have not been changed; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all payments are to be made in the same currency. (titre à paiements fixes)

Definition.Text: primary currency, of a specified debt obligation, means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the currency with which the obligation is primarily connected; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if there is no such currency, Canadian currency. (monnaie principale)

Definition.Text: tax basis, of a specified debt obligation at any time to a taxpayer, has the meaning assigned by subsection 142.4(1) of the Act. (montant de base)
total return, of a taxpayer from a fixed payment obligation, means the amount, measured in the primary currency of the obligation, by which

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the total of all amounts each of which is the amount of a payment (other than a fee or similar payment) required to be made by the debtor under the obligation after its acquisition by the taxpayer

ContinuedDefinition.Text: exceeds

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the cost to the taxpayer of the obligation. (rendement total)

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph 142.3(1)(a) of the Act, where a taxpayer holds a specified debt obligation at any time in a taxation year, the amount prescribed in respect of the obligation for the year is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer’s accrued return from the obligation for the year,

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer’s accrual adjustment determined under section 9102 in respect of the obligation for the year is greater than nil, the amount of the adjustment, and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if a foreign exchange adjustment is determined under section 9104 in respect of the obligation for the year and is greater than nil, the amount of the adjustment.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph 142.3(1)(b) of the Act, where a taxpayer holds a specified debt obligation at any time in a taxation year, the amount prescribed in respect of the obligation is the total of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if the taxpayer’s accrual adjustment determined under section 9102 in respect of the obligation for the year is less than nil, the absolute value of the amount of the adjustment, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if a foreign exchange adjustment is determined under section 9104 in respect of the obligation for the year and is less than nil, the absolute value of the amount of the adjustment.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Fixed payment obligation not in default

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph 9101(1)(a), a taxpayer’s accrued return for a taxation year from a fixed payment obligation, under which each payment required to be made before the end of the year was made by the debtor when it was required to be made, shall be determined in accordance with the following rules:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: determine, in the primary currency of the obligation, the portion of the taxpayer’s total return from the obligation that is allocated to each day in the year using

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the level-yield method described in subsection (2), or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: any other reasonable method that is substantially similar to the level-yield method;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the primary currency of the obligation is not Canadian currency, translate to Canadian currency the amount allocated to each day in the year, using a reasonable method of translation; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: determine the total of all amounts each of which is the Canadian currency amount allocated to a day, in the year, at the beginning of which the taxpayer holds the obligation.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1), the level-yield method for allocating a taxpayer’s total return from a fixed payment obligation is the method that allocates, to each particular day in the period that begins on the day following the day on which the taxpayer acquired the obligation and that ends on the day on which the obligation matures, the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer (expressed in the primary currency of the obligation);
is the total of all amounts each of which is the portion of the taxpayer’s total return from the obligation that is allocated to a day before the particular day;
is the total of all payments required to be made under the obligation after it was acquired by the taxpayer and before the particular day; and

is the rate of interest per day that, if used in computing the present value (as of the end of the day on which the taxpayer acquired the obligation and based on daily compounding) of all payments to be made under the obligation after it was acquired by the taxpayer, produces a present value equal to the cost to the taxpayer of the obligation (expressed in the primary currency of the obligation).

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of paragraph 9101(1)(a), a taxpayer’s accrued return for a taxation year from a specified debt obligation, other than an obligation to which subsection (1) applies, shall be determined

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: using a reasonable method that,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: taking into account the extent to which the obligation differs from fixed payment obligations, is consistent with the principles implicit in the methods that can be used under subsection (1) for fixed payment obligations, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: is in accordance with generally accepted accounting practice for the measurement of profit from debt obligations; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: on the basis of reasonable assumptions with respect to the timing and amount of any payments to be made by the debtor under the obligation that are not fixed in their timing or amount (expressed in the primary currency of the obligation).

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraphs 9101(1)(b) and (2)(a), if subsection 142.3(1) of the Act applies to a taxpayer for a particular taxation year in respect of a specified debt obligation and either the subsection did not apply in respect of the obligation for the taxpayer’s immediately preceding taxation year or the taxpayer did not own the obligation at the end of that immediately preceding taxation year, the taxpayer’s accrual adjustment in respect of the obligation for the particular taxation year is nil.

For the purposes of paragraphs 9101(1)(b) and (2)(a), if subsection (4) does not apply to determine a taxpayer’s accrual adjustment in respect of a specified debt obligation for a particular taxation year, the taxpayer’s accrual adjustment is the positive or negative amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount that would be the taxpayer’s accrued return from the obligation for a taxation year, before the particular taxation year, for which subsection 142.3(1) of the Act applied to the taxpayer in respect of the obligation if the accrued return were redetermined on the basis of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the information available at the end of the particular taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the assumptions, if any, with respect to the timing and amount of payments to be made under the obligation after the particular taxation year that were used for the purpose of determining the taxpayer’s accrued return from the obligation for the particular taxation year; and

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amount included under paragraph 9101(1)(a) as the taxpayer’s accrued return from the obligation for the taxation year immediately preceding the particular taxation year, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the taxpayer’s accrual adjustment in respect of the obligation for that immediately preceding taxation year was determined under this subsection, the value of A for the purpose of determining that accrual adjustment.

Subsection.Text: The rules in this section for determining accrued returns and accrual adjustments are subject to section 9103.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Accrual Rules — Special Cases and Transition

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of section 9102, if the terms of a specified debt obligation of a taxpayer give the taxpayer the right to exchange the obligation for shares of the debtor or of a corporation related to the debtor

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (b), the right shall be disregarded (whether it has been exercised or not); and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if 5% or more of the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer is attributable to the right, the cost is deemed to equal the amount by which the cost exceeds the portion of the cost attributable to the right.

Subsection.Text: If the terms of a specified debt obligation of a taxpayer are amended at any time in a taxation year of the taxpayer to change the timing or amount of any payment to be made, at or after that time, under the obligation, the taxpayer’s accrued returns for the taxation year and for each subsequent taxation year are to be redetermined under section 9102 using a reasonable method that fully gives effect, in those accrued returns, to the alteration to the payments under the obligation.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Obligations acquired before financial institution rules apply
Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer held a specified debt obligation at the beginning of the taxpayer’s first taxation year (in this subsection referred to as the “initial year”) for which subsection 142.3(1) of the Act applied to the taxpayer in respect of the obligation, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer’s accrued return from the obligation for the initial year or a subsequent taxation year shall not include an amount to the extent that the amount was included in computing the taxpayer’s income for a taxation year preceding the initial year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if interest on the obligation in respect of a period before the initial year becomes receivable or is received by the taxpayer in a particular taxation year that is the initial year or a subsequent taxation year, and all or part of the interest would not, but for this paragraph, be included in computing the taxpayer’s income for any taxation year, there shall be included in determining the taxpayer’s accrued return from the obligation for the particular taxation year the amount, if any, by which

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the portion of the interest that would not otherwise be included in computing the taxpayer’s income for any taxation year

ContinuedParagraph.Text: exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the portion of the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer that is reasonably attributable to that portion of the interest.

Subsection.Text: If, before November 1994 and in a taxation year that ended after February 22, 1994, a taxpayer received an amount under a specified debt obligation in satisfaction, in whole or in part, of the debtor’s obligation to pay interest in respect of a period after the taxation year,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount may, at the election of the taxpayer, be included in determining the taxpayer’s accrued return for the taxation year from the obligation; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if the amount is so included, the taxpayer’s accrued returns for subsequent taxation years from the obligation shall not include any amount in respect of interest that, because of the payment of the amount, the debtor is no longer required to pay.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.MarginalNote: Obligations held at end of taxation year

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of paragraphs 9101(1)(c) and (2)(b), if, at the end of a taxation year, a taxpayer holds a specified debt obligation the primary currency of which is not Canadian currency, the taxpayer’s foreign exchange adjustment in respect of the obligation for the taxation year is the positive or negative amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the amount that would be the tax basis of the obligation to the taxpayer at the end of the year if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the tax basis were determined using the primary currency of the obligation as the currency in which all amounts are expressed,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the definition tax basis in subsection 142.4(1) of the Act were read without reference to paragraphs (f), (h), (o) and (q), and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s foreign exchange adjustment in respect of the obligation for each year were nil;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the rate of exchange at the end of the year of the primary currency of the obligation into Canadian currency; and
is the amount that would be the tax basis of the obligation to the taxpayer at the end of the year if

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the definition tax basis in subsection 142.4(1) of the Act were read without reference to paragraphs (h) and (q), and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the taxpayer’s foreign exchange adjustment in respect of the obligation for the year were nil.

Subsection.Text: If a taxpayer disposes of a specified debt obligation the primary currency of which is not Canadian currency, the taxpayer’s foreign exchange adjustment in respect of the obligation for the taxation year in which the disposition occurs is the amount that would be the foreign exchange adjustment if the taxation year had ended immediately before the disposition.
At the election of a taxpayer, subsection (2) does not apply to specified debt obligations disposed of by the taxpayer before 1996.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.Label: PART XCII
Heading.TitleText: Financial Institutions — Disposition of Specified Debt Obligations

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this Part.

Definition.Text: gain, of a taxpayer from the disposition of a specified debt obligation, means the gain from the disposition determined under paragraph 142.4(6)(a) of the Act. (gain)
loss, of a taxpayer from the disposition of a specified debt obligation, means the loss from the disposition determined under paragraph 142.4(6)(b) of the Act. (perte)

residual portion, of a taxpayer’s gain or loss from the disposition of a specified debt obligation, means the amount determined under subsection 142.4(8) of the Act in respect of the disposition. (partie résiduelle)

Subsection.Text: For the purposes of this Part, the amortization date for a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer is the day determined as follows:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraphs (b) to (d), the amortization date is the later of the day of disposition and the day on which the debtor is required to make the final payment under the obligation, determined without regard to any option respecting the timing of payments under the obligation (other than an option that was exercised before the disposition);

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraphs (c) and (d), the amortization date is the day of disposition if the day on which the debtor is required to make the final payment under the obligation is not determinable for the purpose of paragraph (a);

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (d), the amortization date is the first day, if any, after the disposition on which the interest rate could change, if the obligation is one in respect of which the following conditions are satisfied:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the obligation provides for stipulated interest payments,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the rate of interest for one or more periods after the issuance of the obligation was not fixed on the day of issue, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: when the obligation was issued, it was reasonable to expect that the interest rate for each period would equal or approximate a reasonable market rate of interest for that period; and

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: if, for purposes of its financial statements, the taxpayer had a gain or loss from the disposition that is being amortized to profit, the amortization date is the last day of the amortization period.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purpose of subsection 142.4(1) of the Act, transition amount, of a taxpayer in respect of the disposition of a specified debt obligation, means,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if neither paragraph (b) nor (c) applies, nil;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the taxpayer acquired the obligation before its taxation year that includes February 23, 1994,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: neither paragraph 7000(2)(a) nor (b) has applied to the obligation, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: the principal amount of the obligation exceeds the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer (which excess is referred to in this paragraph as the “discount”),

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount included in respect of the discount in computing the taxpayer’s profit for a taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994, and
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount included in respect of the discount in computing the taxpayer’s income for a taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: where

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the conditions in subparagraphs (b)(i) and (ii) are satisfied, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the cost of the obligation to the taxpayer exceeds the principal amount of the obligation (which excess is referred to in this paragraph as the “premium”),

ContinuedParagraph.Text: the negative of the amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount deducted in respect of the premium in computing the taxpayer’s profit for a taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994, and
is the total of all amounts each of which is the amount deducted in respect of the premium in computing the taxpayer’s income for a taxation year that ended before February 23, 1994.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Subsection.Text: The following rules apply with respect to an election made under subsection (3) or (4) by a taxpayer:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the election applies only if

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: it is in writing,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: it specifies the first taxation year (in this subsection referred to as the “initial year”) of the taxpayer to which it is to apply, and

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: either it is received by the Minister within six months after the end of the initial year, or the Minister has expressly accepted the later filing of the election;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: subject to paragraph (c), the election applies to dispositions of specified debt obligations in the initial year and subsequent taxation years; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: if the Minister has approved, on written application by the taxpayer, the revocation of the election, the election does not apply to dispositions of specified debt obligations in the taxation year specified in the application and in subsequent taxation years.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subparagraph 142.4(5)(a)(ii) of the Act, a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer in a taxation year is prescribed in respect of the taxpayer if the amortization date for the obligation is not more than two years after the end of the taxation year.
Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of a taxpayer for a taxation year if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: generally accepted accounting principles require that the taxpayer’s gains and losses arising on the disposition of a class of debt obligations be amortized to profit for the purpose of the taxpayer’s financial statements;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer has elected not to have subsection (2) apply; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the election applies to dispositions in the year.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subparagraph 142.4(5)(a)(ii) of the Act, a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer in a taxation year is prescribed in respect of the taxpayer if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer has elected to have this subsection apply;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the election applies to dispositions in the year; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the absolute value of the positive or negative amount determined by the formula (A - B) does not exceed the lesser of $5,000 and the amount, if any, specified in the election, where

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the residual portion of the taxpayer’s gain from the disposition of the obligation or any other specified debt obligation disposed of in the same transaction, and

is the total of all amounts each of which is the residual portion of the taxpayer’s loss from the disposition of the obligation or any other specified debt obligation disposed of in the same transaction.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subparagraph 142.4(5)(a)(ii) of the Act, a specified debt obligation disposed of by a taxpayer in a taxation year is prescribed in respect of the taxpayer if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the disposition resulted in an extinguishment of the obligation, other than an extinguishment that occurred because of a purchase of the obligation by the debtor in the open market;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer had the right to require the obligation to be settled at any time; or

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the debtor had the right to settle the obligation at any time.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Residual Portion of Gain or Loss

Subsection.Text: Subject to section 9204, if subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies to the disposition of a specified debt obligation by a taxpayer, the amount allocated to each taxation year in respect of the residual portion of the gain or loss from the disposition shall be determined, for the purpose of that subsection,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: by a method that complies with, or is substantially similar to a method that complies with, subsection (2); or

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: if gains and losses from the disposition of debt obligations are amortized to profit for the purpose of the taxpayer’s financial statements, by the method used for the purpose of the taxpayer’s financial statements.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (1), a method for allocating to taxation years the residual portion of a taxpayer’s gain or loss from the disposition of a specified debt obligation complies with this subsection if the amount allocated to each taxation year is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the residual portion of the taxpayer’s gain or loss;
is the number of days in the taxation year that are in the period referred to in the description of C; and
is the number of days in the period that,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: where subsection (3) applies in respect of the obligation, is determined under that subsection, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (i)
FormulaParagraph.Text: begins on the day on which the taxpayer disposed of the obligation, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (ii)
FormulaParagraph.Text: ends on the earlier of

FormulaParagraph.Label: (A)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the amortization date for the obligation, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (B)
FormulaParagraph.Text: the day that is 20 years after the day on which the taxpayer disposed of the obligation.

Subsection.Text: This subsection applies in respect of specified debt obligations disposed of by a taxpayer in a transaction in a taxation year, and the period determined under this subsection in respect of the obligations is the period that begins on the day of disposition and ends on the weighted average amortization date for those obligations so disposed of to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the taxpayer has elected in its return of income for the taxation year to have this subsection apply in respect of the obligations so disposed of;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: all the obligations so disposed of were disposed of at the same time; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the number of the obligations so disposed of to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies is at least 50.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (3), the weighted average amortization date for a group of specified debt obligations disposed of on the same day by a taxpayer is,

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if paragraph (b) does not apply, the day that is the number of days after the day of disposition equal to the total of the number of days determined in respect of each obligation by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the number of days from the day of disposition to the amortization date for the obligation,
is the residual portion of the gain or loss from the disposition of the obligation, and
is the total of all amounts each of which is the residual portion of the gain or loss from the disposition of an obligation in the group; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the day that the taxpayer determines using a reasonable method for estimating the day determined under paragraph (a).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Heading.TitleText: Special Rules for Residual Portion of Gain or Loss

Subsection.Text: This section applies for the purposes of subparagraphs 142.4(4)(c)(ii) and (d)(ii) of the Act.

If subsection 88(1) of the Act has applied to the winding-up of a taxpayer (in this subsection referred to as the “subsidiary”), the following rules apply in respect of the residual portion of a gain or loss of the subsidiary from the disposition of a specified debt obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of that residual portion allocated to the taxation year of the subsidiary in which its assets were distributed to its parent on the winding-up shall be determined on the assumption that the taxation year ended when the assets were distributed to its parent;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no amount shall be allocated in respect of that residual portion to any taxation year of the subsidiary after its taxation year in which its assets were distributed to its parent; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of that residual portion allocated to the taxation year of the parent in which the subsidiary’s assets were distributed to it shall be determined on the assumption that the taxation year began when the assets were distributed to it.

Subsection.Text: No amount in respect of the residual portion of a gain or loss of an insurer from the disposition of a specified debt obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies shall be allocated to any taxation year of the insurer that ends after the insurer ceased to carry on all or substantially all of an insurance business, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: subsection 138(11.5) or (11.94) of the Act has applied to the transfer of that business; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the person to whom that business was transferred is considered, because of paragraph 138(11.5)(k) of the Act, to be the same person as the insurer in respect of that residual portion.

Subsection.Text: If subsection 98(6) of the Act deems a partnership (in this subsection referred to as the “new partnership”) to be a continuation of another partnership (in this subsection referred to as the “predecessor partnership”), the following rules apply in respect of the residual portion of a gain or loss of the predecessor partnership from the disposition of a specified debt obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of that residual portion allocated to the taxation year of the predecessor partnership in which its property was transferred to the new partnership shall be determined on the assumption that the taxation year ended when the property was transferred;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: no amount shall be allocated in respect of that residual portion to any taxation year of the predecessor partnership after its taxation year in which its property was transferred to the new partnership; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the amount of that residual portion allocated to the taxation year of the new partnership in which the predecessor partnership’s property was transferred to it shall be determined on the assumption that the taxation year began when the property was transferred to it.

Subsection.Text: There shall be allocated to a particular taxation year of a taxpayer the part, if any, of the residual portion of the taxpayer’s gain or loss that is from a disposition of a specified debt obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies and that was not allocated to a preceding taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: at any time in the particular taxation year the taxpayer ceases to carry on all or substantially all of a business, otherwise than as a result of a merger to which subsection 87(2) of the Act applies, a winding-up to which subsection 88(1) of the Act applies or a transfer of the business to which subsection 98(6) or 138(11.5) or (11.94) of the Act applies;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the disposition occurred before that time; and

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the specified debt obligation was property used in the business.

Subsection.Text: For the purpose of subsection (5), a non-resident taxpayer is considered to cease to carry on all or substantially all of a business if the taxpayer ceases to carry on, or ceases to carry on in Canada, all or substantially all of the part of the business that was carried on in Canada.

Subsection.MarginalNote: Ceasing to be a financial institution
Subsection.Text: There shall be allocated to a particular taxation year of a taxpayer the part, if any, of the residual portion of the taxpayer’s gain or loss that is from a disposition of a specified debt obligation to which subsection 142.4(4) of the Act applies and that was not allocated to a preceding taxation year, if

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the particular taxation year ends immediately before the time at which the taxpayer ceases to be a financial institution, otherwise than because it has ceased to carry on a business; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the disposition occurred before that time.

Heading.Label: PART XCIII
Heading.TitleText: Film or Video Production Services Tax Credit

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (2), for the purpose of section 125.5 of the Act, accredited production means

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: a film or video production in respect of which the aggregate expenditures, included in the cost of the production, in the period that ends 24 months after the time that the principal filming or taping of the production began, exceeds $1,000,000; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a film or video production that is part of a series of television productions that has two or more episodes, or is a pilot programme for such a series of episodes, in respect of which the aggregate expenditures included in the cost of each episode in the period that ends 24 months after the time that the principal filming or taping of the production began exceeds

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in the case of an episode whose running time is less than 30 minutes, $100,000, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, $200,000.

Subsection.Text: The references to “24 months” in paragraphs 9300(1)(a) and (b) are to be read as references to “36 months” in respect of film or video productions for which the Canadian labour expenditure of the corporation in respect of the production for the taxation years ending in 2020 or 2021 was greater than nil.
An accredited production does not include a production that is any of the following:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: news, current events or public affairs programming, or a programme that includes weather or market reports;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: a talk show;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: a production in respect of a game, questionnaire or contest;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: a sports event or activity;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: a gala presentation or awards show;

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: a production that solicits funds;

Paragraph.Label: (g)
Paragraph.Text: reality television;

Paragraph.Label: (h)
Paragraph.Text: pornography;

Paragraph.Label: (i)
Paragraph.Text: advertising; and

Paragraph.Label: (j)
Paragraph.Text: a production produced primarily for industrial, corporate or institutional purposes.

Heading.Label: PART XCVII
Heading.TitleText: COVID-19 — Air Quality Improvement Tax Credit

Subsection.Text: The following definitions apply in this section.

Definition.Text: HEPA filter means a high-efficiency particulate air filter that has been tested to ensure efficiency equal to or exceeding 99.97% for removal of airborne particles having a mean aerodynamic diameter of 0.3 µm (micrometres) from the air. (filtre HEPA)
HVAC system means a mechanical heating, ventilating and air conditioning system that is installed in a building, and includes all of its equipment and components. (système CVCA)

MERV means the minimum efficiency reporting value parameters specified in ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 52.2-2017, Method of Testing General Ventilation Air-Cleaning Devices for Removal Efficiency by Particle Size, Section 12, Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV) for Air Cleaners, Table 12-1, Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV) Parameters. (MERV)

Subsection.Text: Subject to subsection (3), for the purposes of the definition qualifying expenditure in subsection 127.43(1) of the Act, the following outlays and expenses are prescribed to the extent that they are reasonable and intended primarily to increase outdoor air intake or to improve air cleaning:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: outlays and expenses that are directly attributable to the purchase, installation, conversion or upgrade of a new or retrofitted HVAC system placed in service at a qualifying location that meets either of the following conditions:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the system is designed to filter air at a rate in excess of MERV 8 or an equivalent level of filtration, or

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the system is designed to filter air at a rate equal to MERV 8 or an equivalent level of filtration and the following conditions are met:

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: the system is designed to achieve an outdoor air supply rate in excess of what is required for the space by applicable building codes, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: in the case of an upgrade or conversion of an existing system, prior to the upgrade or conversion, the system was designed to filter air at a rate equal to MERV 8; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: outlays and expenses that are directly attributable to the purchase of a device that is placed in service at a qualifying location and designed to filter air using a HEPA filter.

Subsection.Text: The outlays and expenses in subsection (2) do not include an outlay or expense of an eligible entity

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: made or incurred under the terms of an agreement entered into before the start of the qualifying period;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: that is the cost of recurring or routine repair or maintenance;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: that can reasonably be expected to be paid or returned, directly or indirectly, in any manner whatever, to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the eligible entity,

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: a person or partnership not dealing at arm’s length with the eligible entity, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: another person or partnership at the direction of the eligible entity;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: that is paid to a party with which the eligible entity does not deal at arm’s length;

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: that is salary or wages paid to an employee of the eligible entity; or

Paragraph.Label: (f)
Paragraph.Text: for financing costs.

Provision.Text: its net sales, as they would be determined under paragraphs 71A(2)(d) and (f) of the former Act (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 8(b) of the Income Tax Application Rules), from the sale of goods processed or manufactured in Canada by the business,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: an amount equal to that part of its gross revenue that is rent from goods processed or manufactured in Canada in the course of the business, and

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: its gross revenue from advertisements in a newspaper or magazine produced by the business,

was not less than 2/3 of the amount by which the gross revenue from the business for the period exceeded the aggregate of each amount paid or credited in the period to a customer of the business as a bonus, rebate or discount or for returned or damaged goods, and was not a business that was principally

Provision.Label: (vi)
Provision.Text: operating a gas or oil well,

Provision.Label: (x)
Provision.Text: a combination of two or more of the activities referred to in subparagraphs (vi) to (ix); and

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: the property had not been used for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that would otherwise be included in Class 3 or 6

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: that was acquired after December 5, 1963 and before April 1, 1967 that is

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: an extension to a building, outside the previously existing walls or roof of the building, if the aggregate cost of the extensions added in the aforementioned period exceeded the lesser of

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: 25 per cent of the capital cost to the taxpayer of the building on December 5, 1963, or

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: an addition or alteration to a property described in subparagraph (i) or (ii),
and that has been certified by the Minister of Industry, upon application by the taxpayer in such form as may be prescribed by the Minister of Industry,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: to be situated in an area that was a designated area, as determined for the purposes of section 71A of the former Act (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 8(b) of the Income Tax Application Rules),

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: at the time the property was acquired,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: in a case where the property was built by the taxpayer, at the time construction was commenced, or

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: in a case where the property was built for the taxpayer pursuant to a contract entered into by the taxpayer, at the time the contract was entered into, and

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: to have not been used for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: the capital cost of which was included in the approved capital costs as defined in the Area Development Incentives Act upon which approved capital cost the Minister of Industry has based the amount of a development grant authorized under that Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that would otherwise be included in Class 8 or 19

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: that was acquired after December 5, 1963 and before April 1, 1967 and that

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: was acquired for use in a business carried on by the taxpayer that has been certified by the Minister of Industry, for the purposes of section 71A of the former Act (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 8(b) of the Income Tax Application Rules), to be a new manufacturing or processing business in a designated area for the fiscal period in which the property was acquired or for a subsequent fiscal period, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: had not been used for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: the capital cost of which was included in the approved capital costs as defined in the Area Development Incentives Act upon which approved capital cost the Minister of Industry has based the amount of a development grant authorized under that Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired by the taxpayer after March 16, 1964 and

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987
that is power-operated movable equipment designed for the purpose of excavating, moving, placing or compacting earth, rock, concrete or asphalt, except a property included in Class 7.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: a leasehold interest or a concession in respect of land granted under or pursuant to an agreement in writing with the Canadian Corporation for the 1967 World Exhibition where such leasehold interest or concession is to expire not later than June 15, 1968;

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: a building or other structure, including component parts, erected on land that is the subject matter of a leasehold interest or concession described in paragraph (a) where such building or other structure, including component parts, is of a temporary nature and is required by the agreement to be removed not later than June 15, 1968;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: a leasehold interest or licence in respect of land granted under or pursuant to an agreement in writing with the Expo 86 Corporation where such leasehold interest or licence is to expire not later than January 31, 1987; or

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: a building or other structure, including component parts, erected on land that is the subject matter of a leasehold interest or licence described in paragraph (c) where such building or other structure, including component parts, is of a temporary nature and is required by the agreement to be removed not later than January 31, 1987.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after April 26, 1965 and before 1971

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: that would otherwise be included in Class 2, 3, 6 or 8 and that

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: was acquired primarily for the purpose of preventing, reducing or eliminating pollution of

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: any of the inland, coastal or boundary waters of Canada, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: any lake, river, stream, watercourse, pond, swamp or well in Canada,

by industrial waste, refuse or sewage created by operations in the course of carrying on a business by the taxpayer or that would be created by such operations if the property had not been acquired and used, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: had not been used for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer,

but not including property acquired for use in the production of by-products or the recovery of materials unless the by-products are produced from, or the materials are recovered from, materials that after April 26, 1965,

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: were being discarded as waste by the taxpayer, or

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: were commonly being discarded as waste by other taxpayers who carried on operations of a type similar to the operations carried on by the taxpayer,

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: that would otherwise be included in another class in this Schedule

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: that has not been included by the taxpayer in any other class,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: that had not been used for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer,

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: that was acquired by the taxpayer after 1970 primarily for the purpose of preventing, reducing or eliminating pollution of

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: any of the inland, coastal or boundary waters of Canada, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: any lake, river, stream, watercourse, pond, swamp or well in Canada,
that is caused, or that, if the property had not been acquired and used, would be caused by

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: operations carried on by the taxpayer at a site in Canada at which operations have been carried on by him from a time that is before 1974,

Provision.Label: (D)
Provision.Text: the operation in Canada of a building or plant by the taxpayer, the construction of which was either commenced before 1974 or commenced under an agreement in writing entered into by him before 1974, or

Provision.Label: (E)
Provision.Text: the operation of transportation or other movable equipment that has been operated by the taxpayer in Canada (including any of the inland, coastal or boundary waters of Canada) from a time that is before 1974,
or that was acquired by him after May 8, 1972, that would otherwise have been property referred to in this subparagraph except that

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business by a taxpayer whose business includes the preventing, reducing or eliminating of pollution of a kind referred to in this subparagraph that is caused or that otherwise would be caused primarily by operations referred to in clause (C), (D) or (E) carried on by other taxpayers (not including persons referred to in section 149 of the Act), and

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: to be used in a business referred to in subclause (I) in the preventing, reducing or eliminating of pollution of a kind referred to in this subparagraph, or

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a property by a corporation whose principal business is the purchasing of conditional sales contracts, accounts receivable, bills of sale, chattel mortgages, bills of exchange or other obligations representing part or all of the sale price of merchandise or services, the lending of money, or the leasing of property, or any combination thereof, and

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: to be leased to a taxpayer (other than a person referred to in section 149 of the Act) to be used by him, in an operation referred to in clause (C), (D), (E) or (F), in the preventing, reducing or eliminating of pollution of a kind referred to in this subparagraph, and

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: that has, upon application by the taxpayer to the Minister of the Environment, been accepted by that Minister as property the primary use of which is to be the preventing, reducing or eliminating of pollution of a kind referred to in subparagraph (iii),
and for the purposes of paragraphs (a) and (b)

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: where a corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “predecessor corporation”) has, as a result of an amalgamation within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1) of the Act, merged at any time after 1973 with one or more other corporations to form one corporate entity (in this paragraph referred to as the “new corporation”), the new corporation shall be deemed to be the same corporation as, and a continuation of, the predecessor corporation;

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: where a corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “subsidiary”) has been wound up at any time after 1973 in circumstances to which subsection 88(1) of the Act applies, the parent (within the meaning assigned by that subsection) shall be deemed to be the same corporation as, and a continuation of, the subsidiary; and

Provision.Label: (e)
Provision.Text: this class shall be read without reference to subparagraph (b)(i) where paragraph (c) or (d) applies to the taxpayer and the property was acquired before 1992.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that would otherwise be included in another class in this Schedule that is property acquired by the taxpayer

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: after October 22, 1968 and before 1974, where the acquisition of the property may reasonably be regarded as having been in fulfilment of an obligation undertaken in an agreement made in writing before October 23, 1968 and ratified, confirmed or adopted by the legislature of a province by a statute that came into force before that date,

if the taxpayer was, on October 22, 1968, a corporation, commission or association to which, on the assumption that October 22, 1968 was in its 1969 taxation year, paragraph 62(1)(c) of the former Act (within the meaning assigned by paragraph 8 (b) of the Income Tax Application Rules),

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: would have applied but for subparagraph (i) or (ii) of that paragraph.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: deuterium enriched water (commonly known as “heavy water”) acquired after May 22, 1979.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired before 1999 that would otherwise be included in another Class in this Schedule

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: that has not been included by the taxpayer in any other class;

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: that had not been used for any purpose whatever before it was acquired by the taxpayer;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: that was acquired by the taxpayer after March 12, 1970 primarily for the purpose of preventing, reducing or eliminating air pollution by

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: removing particulate, toxic or injurious materials from smoke or gas, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: preventing the discharge of part or all of the smoke, gas or other air pollutant,
that is discharged or that, if the property had not been acquired and used, would be discharged into the atmosphere as a result of

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: operations carried on by the taxpayer at a site in Canada at which operations have been carried on by him from a time that is before 1974,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: the operation in Canada of a building or plant by the taxpayer, the construction of which was either commenced before 1974 or commenced under an agreement in writing entered into by him before 1974, or

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: the operation of transportation or other movable equipment that has been operated by the taxpayer in Canada (including any of the inland, coastal or boundary waters of Canada) from a time that is before 1974,
or that was acquired by him after May 8, 1972, that would otherwise have been property referred to in this paragraph except that

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business by a taxpayer whose business includes the preventing, reducing or eliminating of air pollution that is caused or that otherwise would be caused primarily by operations referred to in subparagraph (iii), (iv) or (v) carried on by other taxpayers (not including persons referred to in section 149 of the Act), and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: to be used in a business referred to in clause (A) in the preventing, reducing or eliminating of air pollution in a manner referred to in this paragraph, or

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a property by a corporation whose principal business is the purchasing of conditional sales contracts, accounts receivable, bills of sale, chattel mortgages, bills of exchange or other obligations representing part or all of the sale price of merchandise or services, the lending of money, or the leasing of property, or any combination thereof, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: to be leased to a taxpayer (other than a person referred to in section 149 of the Act) to be used by him, in an operation referred to in subparagraph (iii), (iv), (v) or (vi), in the preventing, reducing or eliminating of air pollution in a manner referred to in this paragraph; and

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: that has, upon application by the taxpayer to the Minister of the Environment, been accepted by that Minister as property the primary use of which is to be the preventing, reducing or eliminating of air pollution in a manner referred to in paragraph (c),
and for the purposes of paragraphs (a) to (d),

Provision.Label: (e)
Provision.Text: where a corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “predecessor corporation”) has, as a result of an amalgamation within the meaning assigned by subsection 87(1) of the Act, merged at any time after 1973 with one or more other corporations to form one corporate entity (in this paragraph referred to as the “new corporation”), the new corporation shall be deemed to be the same corporation as, and a continuation of, the predecessor corporation;

Provision.Label: (f)
Provision.Text: where a corporation (in this paragraph referred to as the “subsidiary”) has been wound up at any time after 1973 in circumstances to which subsection 88(1) of the Act applies, the parent (within the meaning assigned by that subsection) shall be deemed to be the same corporation as, and a continuation of, the subsidiary; and

Provision.Label: (g)
Provision.Text: this class shall be read without reference to paragraph (a) where paragraph (e) or (f) applies to the taxpayer and the property was acquired before 1992.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property situated in Canada that would otherwise be included in another class in this Schedule that

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: that is machinery or equipment that is a fixed and integral part of a building, structure, plant facility or other property that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987,

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: was acquired by the taxpayer principally for the purpose of gaining or producing income from one or more mines operated by the taxpayer and situated in Canada and each of which

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: came into production in reasonable commercial quantities after November 7, 1969, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: was the subject of a major expansion after November 7, 1969

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: whereby the greatest designed capacity, measured in weight of input of ore, of the mill that processed the ore from the mine was not less than 25% greater in the year following the expansion than it was in the year preceding the expansion, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: where in the one year period preceding the expansion

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: the Minister, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources, determines that the greatest designed capacity of the mine, measured in weight of output of ore, immediately after the expansion was not less than 25% greater than the greatest designed capacity of the mine immediately before the expansion, and
no mill processed the ore from the mine at any time, or
the mill that processed the ore from the mine processed other ore,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: before the coming into production of the mine or the completion of the expansion of the mine referred to in subparagraph (b)(i) or (ii), as the case may be, and

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: in the case of a mine that was the subject of a major expansion described in subparagraph (b)(ii), in the course of and principally for the purposes of the expansion,

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: had not, before it was acquired by the taxpayer, been used for any purpose whatever by any person with whom the taxpayer was not dealing at arm’s length, and

Provision.Label: (e)
Provision.Text: is any of the following, namely,

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: property that was acquired before the mine came into production and that would, but for this class, be included in Class 10 by virtue of paragraph (g), (k), (l) or (r) of that class or would have been so included in that class if it had been acquired after the 1971 taxation year,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: property that was acquired before the mine came into production and that would, but for this class, be included in Class 10 by virtue of paragraph (m) of that class, or

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: property that was acquired after the mine came into production and that would, but for this class, be included in Class 10 by virtue of paragraph (g), (k), (l) or (r) of that class,

or that would be described in paragraphs (b) to (e) if in those paragraphs each reference to a “mine” were read as a reference to a “mine that is a location in a bituminous sands deposit, oil sands deposit or oil shale deposit from which material is extracted”, and each reference to “after November 7, 1969” were read as “before November 8, 1969”.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property (other than property included in Class 41 solely because of paragraph (c) or (d) of that Class or property included in Class 47 because of paragraph (b) of that Class) that would otherwise be included in another class in this Schedule

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: that is property manufactured by the taxpayer, the manufacture of which was completed by him after May 8, 1972, or other property acquired by the taxpayer after May 8, 1972,

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: to be used directly or indirectly by him in Canada primarily in the manufacturing or processing of goods for sale or lease, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: to be leased, in the ordinary course of carrying on a business in Canada of the taxpayer, to a lessee who can reasonably be expected to use, directly or indirectly, the property in Canada primarily in Canadian field processing carried on by the lessee or in the manufacturing or processing by the lessee of goods for sale or lease, if the taxpayer is a corporation whose principal business is

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: manufacturing property that it sells or leases,

Provision.Label: (D)
Provision.Text: the purchasing of conditional sales contracts, accounts receivable, bills of sale, chattel mortgages, bills of exchange or other obligations representing part or all of the sale price of merchandise or services, or

Provision.Label: (E)
Provision.Text: selling or servicing a type of property that it also leases,
or any combination thereof, unless use of the property by the lessee commenced before May 9, 1972;

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: property that, but for this class, would be included in Class 8, except railway rolling stock or a property described in paragraph (j) of Class 8,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: an oil or water storage tank,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: electrical generating equipment described in Class 9,

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: property that is described in paragraph (b) or (f) of Class 10, or

Provision.Label: (vi)
Provision.Text: property that would be described in paragraph (f) of Class 10 if the portion of that paragraph before subparagraph (i) read as follows:

Provision.Label: “(f)
Provision.Text: general-purpose electronic data processing equipment and systems software for that equipment, including ancillary data processing equipment, acquired after March 18, 2007 and before January 28, 2009, but not including property that is principally or is used principally as”; and

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: that is property acquired by the taxpayer

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: that is machinery or equipment that is a fixed and integral part of a building, structure, plant facility or other property that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: after March 18, 2007 and before 2016 if the property is machinery, or equipment,

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: that would be described in paragraph (a) if subparagraph (a)(ii) were read without reference to “in Canadian field processing carried on by the lessee or,”, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: that is described in any of subparagraphs (b)(i) to (iii) and (vi).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property of a taxpayer that is

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: an unmanned telecommunication spacecraft that was designed to orbit above the earth and that was acquired by the taxpayer

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the purpose of effecting an interface between a cable or satellite distribution system (other than a satellite radio distribution system) and electronic products used by consumers of that system if the equipment

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: to augment the channel capacity of a television receiver, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: to decode pay television or other signals provided on a discretionary basis,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: is acquired by the taxpayer after March 4, 2010, and

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: has not been used or acquired for use for any purpose by any taxpayer before March 5, 2010.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that is a multiple-unit residential building in Canada that would otherwise be included in Class 3 or Class 6 and in respect of which

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: a certificate has been issued by Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation certifying

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: in respect of a building that would otherwise be included in Class 3, that the installation of footings or any other base support of the building was commenced
as the case may be, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: in respect of a building that would otherwise be included in Class 6, that the installation of footings or any other base support of the building was commenced after December 31, 1977 and before 1979,

and that, according to plans and specifications for the building, not less than 80 per cent of the floor space will be used in providing self-contained domestic establishments and related parking, recreation, service and storage areas,

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: not more than 20 per cent of the floor space is used for any purpose other than the purposes referred to in paragraph (a),

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: the certificate referred to in paragraph (a) was issued on or before the later of

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: the day that is 18 months after the day on which the installation of footings or other base support of the building was commenced, and

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: the construction of the building proceeds, after 1982, without undue delay, taking into consideration acts of God, labour disputes, fire, accidents or unusual delay by common carriers or suppliers of materials or equipment,
and that was acquired by the taxpayer

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: an obligation in writing entered into by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: the terms of a prospectus, preliminary prospectus, registration statement, offering memorandum or notice required to be filed with a public authority in Canada and filed before June 18, 1987 with that public authority.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that is a multiple-unit residential building in Canada that would otherwise be included in Class 6 if the reference to “1979” in subparagraph (a)(viii) of that Class were read as a reference to “1980”, and in respect of which

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: a certificate has been issued by Central Mortgage and Housing Corporation certifying

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: that the installation of footings or any other base support of the building was commenced after November 18, 1974 and before 1978, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: that, according to plans and specifications for the building, not less than 80 per cent of the floor space will be used in providing self-contained domestic establishments and related parking, recreation, service and storage areas; and

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: not more than 20 per cent of the floor space is used for any purpose other than the purposes referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii).

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that is a timber resource property.
Property that would otherwise be included in Class 1, 2 or 8

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: production equipment and pipelines of a distributor of heat,

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: steam generating equipment that was acquired by the taxpayer primarily for the purpose of producing steam to operate property described in subparagraph (i), or

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: an addition to a property described in subparagraph (i), (ii) or (iii),
but not including buildings or other structures,

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: that was acquired by the taxpayer after May 25, 1976,

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: was acquired by the taxpayer for use by him in a business carried on in Canada, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: is to be leased by the taxpayer to a lessee for use by the lessee in Canada, and

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: that is property in respect of which a certificate has been issued

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: before December 11, 1979 by the Minister of Industry, Trade and Commerce certifying that the property is part of a plan designed to

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: produce heat derived primarily from the consumption of wood wastes or municipal wastes,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: produce electrical energy by the utilization of fuel that is petroleum, natural gas or related hydrocarbons, coal, coal gas, coke, lignite or peat (in this clause referred to as “fossil fuel”), wood wastes or municipal wastes, or any combination thereof, if the consumption of fossil fuel (expressed as the high heat value of the fossil fuel), if any, chargeable to electrical energy on an annual basis in respect of the property is no greater than 7,000 British Thermal Units per kilowatt-hour of electrical energy produced, or

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: recover heat that is a by-product of an industrial process, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: after December 10, 1979, by the Minister of Energy, Mines and Resources certifying that the property is part of a plan designed to

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: produce heat derived primarily from the consumption of natural gas, coal, coal gas, lignite, peat, wood wastes or municipal wastes, or any combination thereof,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: produce electrical energy by the utilization of fuel that is petroleum, natural gas or related hydrocarbons, coal, coal gas, coke, lignite or peat (in this clause referred to as “fossil fuel”), wood wastes or municipal wastes, or any combination thereof, if the consumption of fossil fuel (expressed as the high heat value of the fossil fuel), if any, chargeable to electrical energy on an annual basis in respect of the property is no greater than 7,000 British Thermal Units per kilowatt-hour of electrical energy produced, or

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: recover heat that is a by-product of an industrial process,
and property that was acquired by the taxpayer after December 10, 1979 (other than property described in paragraph (a)) and would otherwise be included in another Class in this Schedule

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: active solar heating equipment including solar collectors, solar energy conversion equipment, storage equipment, control equipment, equipment designed to interface solar heating equipment with other heating equipment, and solar water heaters, used to

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: heat a liquid or air to be used directly in the course of manufacturing or processing,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: provide space heating when installed in a new building or other new structure at the time of its original construction where that construction commenced after December 10, 1979, or

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: heat water for a use other than a use described in clause (A) or (B),

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: a hydro electric installation of a producer of hydro electric energy with a planned maximum generating capacity not exceeding 15 megawatts upon completion of site development that is the generating equipment and plant (including structures) of that producer including a canal, a dam, a dyke, an overflow spillway, a penstock, a powerhouse complete with generating equipment and other equipment ancillary thereto, control equipment, fishways or fish bypasses and transmission equipment, except distribution equipment and a property included in Class 10 or 17,

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: heat recovery equipment that is designed to conserve energy or reduce the requirement to acquire energy by extracting and reusing heat from thermal waste including condensers, heat exchange equipment, steam compressors used to upgrade low pressure steam, waste heat boilers and ancilliary equipment such as control panels, fans, instruments or pumps,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: an addition or alteration to a hydro electric installation described in subparagraph (ii) that results in a change in generating capacity if the new maximum generating capacity at the hydro electric installation does not exceed 15 megawatts, or

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: a fixed location device acquired after February 25, 1986, that is a wind energy conversion system designed to produce electrical energy, consisting of a wind-driven turbine, generating equipment and related equipment, including control and conditioning equipment, support structures, a powerhouse complete with equipment ancillary thereto, and transmission equipment, but not including distribution equipment, equipment designed to store electrical energy or property included in Class 10 or 17,

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: was acquired by the taxpayer for use by him for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business carried on in Canada or from property situated in Canada, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: is to be leased by the taxpayer to a lessee for use by the lessee in Canada, and

Provision.Label: (g)
Provision.Text: that is property in respect of which a certificate has been issued by the Minister of Energy, Mines and Resources,

Provision.Label: (h)
Provision.Text: property in respect of which a certificate issued under paragraph (d) or (g) has been revoked pursuant to subsection 1104(11);

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: property that had been used before it was acquired by the taxpayer unless the property had previously been included in Class 34 for the purpose of computing the income of the person from whom it was acquired;

Provision.Label: (j)
Provision.Text: property acquired by the taxpayer after February 21, 1994 other than

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an agreement of purchase and sale in writing entered into by the taxpayer before February 22, 1994,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: in order to satisfy a legally binding obligation entered into by the taxpayer in writing before February 22, 1994 to sell electricity to a public power utility in Canada,

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on February 22, 1994, or

Provision.Label: (D)
Provision.Text: that is machinery or equipment that is a fixed and integral part of a building, structure or other property that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on February 22, 1994, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: property acquired by the taxpayer before 1996

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an agreement of purchase and sale in writing entered into before 1995 to acquire the property from a person or partnership in circumstances where

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: the property was part of a project that was under construction by the person or partnership on February 22, 1994, and

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all of the circumstances, that the person or partnership constructed the project with the intention of transferring all or part of the project to another taxpayer after completion, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an agreement in writing entered into before 1995 by the taxpayer with a person or partnership where the taxpayer agrees to assume a legally binding obligation entered into by the person or partnership before February 22, 1994 to sell electricity to a public power utility in Canada, or

Provision.Label: (k)
Provision.Text: property in respect of which a certificate has not been issued under paragraph (d) or (g) before the time that is the later of

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: 2 years after the property is acquired by the taxpayer or, where the property is property acquired in circumstances to which paragraph (j) applies, 2 years after substantial completion of the property.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property not included in any other class that is

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: a railway car acquired after May 25, 1976; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: a rail suspension device designed to carry trailers that are designed to be hauled on both highways and railway tracks.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after December 11, 1979 that is deemed to be depreciable property by virtue of paragraph 13(5.2)(c) of the Act.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that would otherwise be included in another class in this schedule that is property used in connection with an amusement park, including

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: land improvements (other than landscaping) for or in support of park activities, including

Provision.Label: (i)
