Provision.Text: roads, sidewalks, parking areas, storage areas, or similar surface constructions, and

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: buildings (other than warehouses, administration buildings, hotels or motels), structures and equipment (other than automotive equipment), including

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: rides, attractions and appurtenances associated with a ride or attraction, ticket booths and facades,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: equipment, furniture and fixtures, in or attached to a building included in this class,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: fences or similar perimeter structures, and

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: automotive equipment (other than automotive equipment designed for use on highways or streets),
and property not included in another class in this schedule that is a waterway or a land improvement (other than landscaping, clearing or levelling land) used in connection with an amusement park.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property not included in Class 22 but that would otherwise be included in that class if that class were read without reference to paragraphs (a) and (b) thereof.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after 1987 and before February 26, 1992 that is not included in Class 29, but that would otherwise be included in that Class if that Class were read without reference to subparagraphs (b)(iii) and (v) and paragraph (c) thereof.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after 1987 and before 1990 that is a powered industrial lift truck or property described in paragraph (b) or (f) of Class 10 and that is property not included in Class 29 but that would otherwise be included in that class if that class were read without reference to paragraph (c) thereof.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property (other than property included in Class 41.1, 41.2, 57 or 58)

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: not included in Class 28 that would otherwise be included in that Class if that Class were read without reference to paragraph (a) of that Class, and if subparagraphs (e)(i) to (iii) of that Class were read as follows:

Subparagraph.Label: “(i)
Subparagraph.Text: property that was acquired before the mine came into production and that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 10 because of paragraph (g), (k), (l) or (r) of that Class or would have been so included in that Class if it had been acquired after the 1971 taxation year, and property that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 41 because of subsection 1102(8) or (9),

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: property that was acquired before the mine came into production and that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 10 because of paragraph (m) of that Class, or

Subparagraph.Label: (iii)
Subparagraph.Text: property that was acquired after the mine came into production and that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 10 because of paragraph (g), (k), (l) or (r) of that Class, and property that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 41 because of subsection 1102(8) or (9);”

Provision.Label: (a.1)
Provision.Text: that is the portion, expressed as a percentage determined by reference to capital cost, of property that

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: would, but for this Class, be included in Class 10 because of paragraph (g), (k) or (l) of that Class, or that is included in this Class because of subsection 1102(8) or (9),

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: is not described in paragraph (a) or (a.2),

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: was acquired by the taxpayer principally for the purpose of gaining or producing income from one or more mines that are operated by the taxpayer and situated in Canada, and that became available for use for the purpose of subsection 13(26) of the Act in a taxation year, and

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: had not, before it was acquired by the taxpayer, been used for any purpose by any person or partnership with whom the taxpayer was not dealing at arm’s length,
where that percentage is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the total of all amounts each of which is the capital cost of a property of the taxpayer that became available for use for the purpose of subsection 13(26) of the Act in the year and that is described in subparagraphs (i) to (iv) in respect of the mine or mines, as the case may be,
is 5% of the taxpayer’s gross revenue from the mine or mines, as the case may be, for the year, and
is the number of days in the year;

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: is property that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 10 because of paragraph (g), (k) or (l) of that Class or that is included in this Class because of subsection 1102(8) or (9),

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: was acquired by the taxpayer in a taxation year principally for the purpose of gaining or producing income from one or more mines each of which

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is one or more wells operated by the taxpayer for the extraction of material from a deposit of bituminous sands or oil shales, operated by the taxpayer and situated in Canada,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: was the subject of a major expansion after March 6, 1996, and

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: is a mine in respect of which the Minister, in consultation with the Minister of Natural Resources, determines that the greatest designed capacity of the mine, measured in volume of oil that is not beyond the crude oil stage or its equivalent, immediately after the expansion was not less than 25% greater than the greatest designed capacity of the mine immediately before the expansion,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: before the completion of the expansion, and

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: in the course of and principally for the purposes of the expansion, and

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: had not, before it was acquired by the taxpayer, been used for any purpose by any person or partnership with whom the taxpayer was not dealing at arm’s length;

Provision.Label: (a.3)
Provision.Text: that is property included in this Class because of subsection 1102(8) or (9), other than property described in paragraph (a) or (a.2) or the portion of property described in paragraph (a.1);

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: that is property, other than property described in subsection 1101(2c),

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: described in paragraph (f.1), (g), (j), (k), (l), (m), (r), (t) or (u) of Class 10 that would be included in that Class if this Schedule were read without reference to this paragraph, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: that is a vessel, including the furniture, fittings, radio communication equipment and other equipment attached thereto, that is designed principally for the purpose of

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: determining the existence, location, extent or quality of accumulations of petroleum, natural gas or mineral resources, or
and that was acquired by the taxpayer after 1987 other than property that was acquired before 1990

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: pursuant to an obligation in writing entered into by the taxpayer before June 18, 1987,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987, or

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: that is machinery and equipment that is a fixed and integral part of property that was under construction by or on behalf of the taxpayer on June 18, 1987;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: acquired by the taxpayer after May 8, 1972, to be used directly or indirectly by the taxpayer in Canada primarily in Canadian field processing, where the property would be included in Class 29 if

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: Class 29 were read without reference to

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: the words “property included in Class 41 solely because of paragraph (c) or (d) of that Class or”,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: subsection 1104(9) were read without reference to paragraph (k) of that subsection, and

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: this Schedule were read without reference to this Class, Class 39 and Class 43; or

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: acquired by the taxpayer after December 5, 1996 (otherwise than pursuant to an agreement in writing made before December 6, 1996) to be leased, in the ordinary course of carrying on a business in Canada of the taxpayer, to a lessee who can reasonably be expected to use, directly or indirectly, the property in Canada primarily in Canadian field processing carried on by the lessee, where the property would be included in Class 29 if

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: Class 29 were read without reference to

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: the words “property included in Class 41 solely because of paragraph (c) or (d) of that Class or”,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: this Schedule were read without reference to this Class, Class 39 and Class 43.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Oil sands property (other than specified oil sands property or property included in Class 57 or 58) that

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: is acquired by a taxpayer after March 18, 2007 and before 2016 and that if acquired before March 19, 2007, would be included in paragraphs (a), (a.1) or (a.2) of Class 41, or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: is acquired by a taxpayer after 2015 and that if acquired before March 19, 2007 would be included in Class 41.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property, other than specified oil sands property, eligible mine development property or property included in Class 57 or 58,

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: that is acquired by a taxpayer after March 20, 2013 and before 2021 and that, if acquired on March 20, 2013, would be included in paragraph (a) or (a.1) of Class 41; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: that is acquired by a taxpayer after 2020 and that, if acquired on March 20, 2013, would be included in paragraph (a) or (a.1) of Class 41.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: telephone, telegraph or data communication equipment that is a wire or cable (other than a cable included in this class because of paragraph (a)), acquired after February 22, 2005, and that has not been used, or acquired for use, for any purpose before February 23, 2005.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after February 25, 1992 (other than property included in Class 57 or 58) that

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: is not included in Class 29 or 53, but that would otherwise be included in Class 29 if that Class were read without reference to its subparagraphs (b)(iii) and (v) and paragraph (c); or

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: that is described in paragraph (k) of Class 10 and that would be included in that Class if this Schedule were read without reference to this paragraph and paragraph (b) of Class 41, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: that, at the time of its acquisition, can reasonably be expected to be used entirely in Canada and primarily for the purpose of processing ore extracted from a mineral resource located in a country other than Canada.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property, other than reconditioned or remanufactured equipment, that would otherwise be included in Class 1, 2, 8 or 48 or in Class 17 because of paragraph (a.1) of that Class

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: electrical generating equipment, including any heat generating equipment used primarily for the purpose of producing heat energy to operate the electrical generating equipment,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: equipment that generates both electrical and heat energy other than, for greater certainty, fuel cell equipment,

Provision.Label: (ii.1)
Provision.Text: fixed location fuel cell equipment that uses hydrogen generated only from internal, or ancillary, fuel reformation equipment,

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: heat recovery equipment used prima- rily for the purpose of conserving energy, or reducing the requirement to acquire energy, by extracting for reuse thermal waste that is generated by equipment referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii),

Provision.Label: (iii.1)
Provision.Text: district energy equipment that is part of a district energy system that uses thermal energy that is primarily supplied by electrical cogeneration equipment that would be property described in paragraphs (a) to (c) if read without reference to this subparagraph,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: control, feedwater and condensate systems and other equipment, if that property is ancillary to equipment described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iii), or

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: an addition to a property described in any of subparagraphs (i) to (iv),

other than buildings or other structures, heat rejection equipment (such as condensers and cooling water systems), transmission equipment, distribution equipment, fuel handling equipment that is not used to upgrade the combustible portion of the fuel, pollution abatement equipment and fuel storage facilities,

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: acquired by the taxpayer for use by the taxpayer for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business carried on in Canada or from property situated in Canada, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: leased by the taxpayer to a lessee for the use by the lessee for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business carried on in Canada or from property situated in Canada, and

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: has not been used for any purpose before it was acquired by the taxpayer unless

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: the property was depreciable property that

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: was included in Class 34, 43.1 or 43.2 of the person from whom it was acquired, or

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: would have been included in Class 34, 43.1 or 43.2 of the person from whom it was acquired had the person made a valid election to include the property in Class 43.1 or 43.2, as the case may be, under paragraph 1102(8)(d) or 1102(9)(d), and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: the property was acquired by the taxpayer not more than five years after the time it is considered to have become available for use, for the purpose of subsection 13(26) of the Act, by the person from whom it was acquired and remains at the same site in Canada as that at which that person used the property, and

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, to generate electrical energy, or both electrical and heat energy, using only fuel that is eligible waste fuel, fossil fuel, producer gas, spent pulping liquor or any combination of those fuels,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: if the system is rated to generate more than three megawatts of electrical energy, meets the following condition on an annual basis:

FormulaDefinition.Text: is 11,000 BTU per kilowatt-hour,
is the energy content of fossil fuel other than solution gas (expressed as the higher heating value of the fuel) consumed by the system in BTU,
is the energy content of the eligible waste fuel, producer gas and spent pulping liquor (expressed as the higher heating value of the fuel) consumed by the system in BTU,
is the gross electrical energy produced by the system in kilowatt-hours, and
is the net useful energy in the form of heat exported from the system to a thermal host in BTU, and

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: uses fuel of which no more than 25% of the energy content (expressed as the higher heating value of the fuel) is from fossil fuel, as determined on an annual basis, or

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: equipment that is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, to generate electrical energy in a process all or substantially all of the energy input of which is thermal waste, other than

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: equipment that uses heat produced by a gas turbine that is part of the first stage of a combined cycle system, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: equipment that, on the date of its acquisition, uses chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) or hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), within the meaning assigned by the Ozone-Depleting Substances Regulations, 1998,
and property, other than reconditioned or remanufactured equipment, that would otherwise be included in another Class in this Schedule

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: property that meets the following conditions :

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: it is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of heating an actively circulated liquid or gas and is

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: active solar heating equipment, including such equipment that consists of above ground solar collectors, solar energy conversion equipment, solar water heaters, thermal energy storage equipment, control equipment and equipment designed to interface solar heating equipment with other heating equipment,

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: equipment that is part of a ground source heat pump system that transfers heat to or from the ground or groundwater (but not to or from surface water such as a river, a lake or an ocean) and that, at the time of installation, meets the standards set by the Canadian Standards Association for the design and installation of earth energy systems, including such equipment that consists of piping (including above or below ground piping and the cost of drilling a well, or trenching, for the purpose of installing that piping), energy conversion equipment, thermal energy storage equipment, control equipment and equipment designed to enable the system to interface with other heating or cooling equipment, or

Provision.Label: (III)
Provision.Text: equipment that is part of an air-source heat pump system that transfers heat from the outside air, including refrigerant piping, energy conversion equipment, thermal energy storage equipment, control equipment and equipment designed to enable the system to interface with other heating and cooling equipment, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: it is not a building, part of a building (other than a solar collector that is not a window and that is integrated into a building), energy equipment that backs up equipment described in subclause (A)(I), (II) or (III) nor equipment that distributes heated or cooled air or water in a building,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: a hydro-electric installation of a producer of hydro-electric energy, where that installation

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: has, if acquired after February 21, 1994 and before December 11, 2001, an annual average generating capacity not exceeding 15 megawatts upon completion of the site development, or, if acquired after December 10, 2001, a rated capacity at the hydro-electric installation site that does not exceed 50 megawatts, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: is the electrical generating equipment and plant (including structures) of that producer including a canal, a dam, a dyke, an overflow spillway, a penstock, a powerhouse (complete with electrical generating equipment and other ancillary equipment), control equipment, fishways or fish bypasses, and eligible transmission equipment,
other than distribution equipment, property otherwise included in Class 10 and property that would be included in Class 17 if that Class were read without reference to its subparagraph (a.1)(i),

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: an addition or alteration, which is acquired after February 21, 1994 and before December 11, 2001, to a hydro-electric installation that is described in subparagraph (ii) or that would be so described if that installation were acquired by the taxpayer after February 21, 1994, and which results in an increase in generating capacity, if the resulting annual average generating capacity of the hydro-electric installation does not exceed 15 megawatts,

Provision.Label: (iii.1)
Provision.Text: an addition or alteration, which is acquired after December 10, 2001, to a hydro-electric installation that is described in subparagraph (ii) or that would be so described if that installation were acquired by the taxpayer after February 21, 1994, and which results in an increase in generating capacity, if the resulting rated capacity at the hydro-electric installation site does not exceed 50 megawatts,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: heat recovery equipment used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of conserving energy, reducing the requirement to acquire energy or extracting heat for sale, by extracting for reuse thermal waste that is generated directly in an industrial process (other than an industrial process that generates or processes electrical energy), including such equipment that consists of heat exchange equipment, compressors used to upgrade low pressure steam, vapour or gas, waste heat boilers and other ancillary equipment such as control panels, fans, instruments or pumps, but not including property that is employed in re-using the recovered heat (such as property that is part of the internal heating or cooling system of a building or electrical generating equipment), is pollution abatement equipment, or is a building,

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: a fixed location device that is a wind energy conversion system that

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of generating electrical energy, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: consists of a wind-driven turbine, electrical generating equipment and related equipment, including

Provision.Label: (III)
Provision.Text: a powerhouse complete with other ancillary equipment, and

other than distribution equipment, auxiliary electrical generating equipment, property otherwise included in Class 10 and property that would be included in Class 17 if that Class were read without reference to its subparagraph (a.1)(i),

Provision.Label: (vi)
Provision.Text: fixed location photovoltaic equipment that is used by the taxpayer, or a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of generating electrical energy from solar energy if the equipment consists of solar cells or modules and related equipment including inverters, control and conditioning equipment, support structures and eligible transmission equipment, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: a building or a part of a building (other than a solar cell or module that is integrated into a building),

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: auxiliary electrical generating equipment, property otherwise included in Class 10 and property that would be included in Class 17 if that Class were read without reference to its subparagraph (a.1)(i), and

Provision.Label: (vii)
Provision.Text: equipment used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of generating electrical energy or heat energy, or both electrical and heat energy, solely from geothermal energy, including such equipment that consists of piping (including above or below ground piping and the cost of completing a well (including the wellhead and production string), or trenching, for the purpose of installing that piping), pumps, heat exchangers, steam separators, electrical generating equipment, eligible transmission equipment and ancillary equipment used to collect the geothermal heat, but not including buildings, distribution equipment, equipment described in subclause (i)(A)(II), property otherwise included in Class 10 and property that would be included in Class 17 if that Class were read without reference to its paragraph (a.1),

Provision.Label: (viii)
Provision.Text: equipment used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of collecting landfill gas or digester gas, including such equipment that consists of piping (including above or below ground piping and the cost of drilling a well, or trenching, for the purpose of installing that piping), fans, compressors, storage tanks, heat exchangers and related equipment used to collect gas, to remove non-combustibles and contaminants from the gas or to store the gas, but not including pollution abatement equipment and property otherwise included in Class 10 or 17,

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, for the sole purpose of generating heat energy, not using any fuel other than eligible waste fuel, fossil fuel, producer gas or a combination of those fuels,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: uses fuel of which no more than 25% of the energy content (expressed as the higher heating value of the fuel) is from fossil fuel, as determined on an annual basis,

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: fuel handling equipment used to upgrade the combustible portion of the fuel,

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: control, feedwater and condensate systems, and

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the purpose of producing heat energy to operate electrical generating equipment,

Provision.Label: (III)
Provision.Text: heat rejection equipment (such as condensers and cooling water systems),

Provision.Label: (VI)
Provision.Text: property otherwise included in Class 10 or 17, and

Provision.Label: (x)
Provision.Text: an expansion engine with one or more turbines, or cylinders, that convert the compression energy in pressurized natural gas into shaft power that generates electricity, including the related electrical generating equipment and ancillary controls, where the expansion engine

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is part of a system that is installed

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: on a distribution line of a distributor of natural gas, or

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: on a branch distribution line of a taxpayer primarily engaged in the manufacturing or processing of goods for sale or lease if the branch line is used to deliver natural gas directly to the taxpayer’s manufacturing or processing facility, and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: is used instead of a pressure reducing valve,

Provision.Label: (xi)
Provision.Text: equipment all or substantially all of the use of which by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, is to produce liquid biofuel, including storage, materials handling and ash-handling equipment and equipment used to remove non-combustibles and contaminants from the fuels produced, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: equipment used to produce spent pulping liquor,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the collection or transportation of specified waste material or carbon dioxide,

Provision.Label: (C)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the transmission or distribution of liquid biofuel,

Provision.Label: (D)
Provision.Text: property that would otherwise be included in Class 17,

Provision.Label: (xii)
Provision.Text: fixed location fuel cell equipment used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, that uses hydrogen generated only from ancillary electrolysis equipment (or, if the fuel cell is reversible, the fuel cell itself) using electricity all or substantially all of which is generated by using kinetic energy of flowing water or wave or tidal energy or by geothermal, photovoltaic, wind energy conversion, or hydro-electric equipment, of the taxpayer or the lessee, and equipment ancillary to the fuel cell equipment other than buildings or other structures, transmission equipment, distribution equipment, auxiliary electrical generating equipment and property otherwise included in Class 10 or 17,

Provision.Label: (xiii)
Provision.Text: property that is part of a system that is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily to produce and store biogas, including equipment that is an anaerobic digester reactor, a buffer tank, a pre-treatment tank, biogas piping, a fan, a compressor, a heat exchanger, a biogas storage tank and equipment used to remove non-combustibles and contaminants from the gas, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: property (other than a buffer tank) that is used to collect, move or store organic waste,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: equipment used to process the residue after digestion or to treat recovered liquids,

Provision.Label: (D)
Provision.Text: property otherwise included in Class 10 or 17, and

Provision.Label: (xiv)
Provision.Text: fixed location property that is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of generating electricity using kinetic energy of flowing water or wave or tidal energy, including support structures, control and conditioning equipment, submerged cables and eligible transmission equipment, but not including buildings, distribution equipment, auxiliary electricity generating equipment, property otherwise included in Class 10 and property that would be included in Class 17 if that class were read without reference to its subparagraph (a.1)(i),

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is used by the taxpayer or by a lessee of the taxpayer,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: is part of a district energy system that uses thermal energy that is primarily supplied by equipment that is described in subparagraphs (i), (iv), (vii) or (ix) or would be described in those subparagraphs if owned by the taxpayer, and

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of generating producer gas (other than producer gas that is to be converted into liquid fuels or chemicals),

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: uses feedstock of which no more than 25% of the energy content (expressed as the higher heating value of the feedstock) is from fossil fuel, as determined on an annual basis,

Provision.Label: (IV)
Provision.Text: equipment used for drying or shredding feedstock,

Provision.Label: (VI)
Provision.Text: equipment used to upgrade the producer gas into biomethane, and

Provision.Label: (VII)
Provision.Text: equipment used to remove non-combustibles and contaminants from the producer gas, and

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: heat rejection equipment (such as condensers and cooling water systems),

Provision.Label: (III)
Provision.Text: equipment used to convert producer gas into liquid fuels or chemicals,

Provision.Label: (IV)
Provision.Text: property otherwise included in Class 10 or 17, and

Provision.Label: (xvii)
Provision.Text: equipment used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, for the purpose of charging electric vehicles, including charging stations, transformers, distribution and control panels, circuit breakers, conduits and related wiring, if

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: on the load side of an electricity meter used for billing purposes by a power utility, or

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: on the generator side of an electricity meter used to measure electricity generated by the taxpayer or the lessee, as the case may be,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: more than 75 per cent of the electrical equipment capacity is dedicated to charging electric vehicles, and

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: an electric vehicle charging station (other than a building) that supplies more than 10 kilowatts of continuous power, or

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: used primarily in connection with one or more electric vehicle charging stations (other than buildings) each of which supplies more than 10 kilowatts of continuous power,

Provision.Label: (xviii)
Provision.Text: fixed location energy storage property that

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: is used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, primarily for the purpose of storing and discharging electrical energy

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: including batteries, compressed air energy storage, flywheels, ancillary equipment (including control and conditioning equipment) and related structures, and

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: not including buildings, pumped hydroelectric storage, hydro electric dams and reservoirs, property used solely for backup electrical energy, batteries used in vehicles or other automotive equipment, property used to charge vehicles or other automotive equipment, fuel cell systems where the hydrogen is produced via steam reformation of methane and property otherwise included in Class 10 or 17, and

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: the electrical energy to be stored and discharged is generated from other property that is described in paragraph (c) or in any other subparagraph of this paragraph, or

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: meets the condition that the efficiency of the electrical energy storage system that includes the property – computed by reference to the quantity of electrical energy supplied to and discharged from the electrical energy storage system – is greater than 50%, and

Provision.Label: (xix)
Provision.Text: a pumped hydroelectric energy storage installation all or substantially all of the use of which by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, is to store and discharge electrical energy including reversing turbines, eligible transmission equipment, dams, reservoirs and related structures, and that meets the condition in either subclause (d)(xviii)(B)(I) or (II) in this Class, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: property used solely for backup electrical energy, and

Provision.Label: (xx)
Provision.Text: equipment all or substantially all of the use of which by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, is to produce solid biofuel, including storage, materials handling and ash-handling equipment, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: equipment used to make wood chips, hog fuel or black liquor,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: property that would otherwise be included in Class 17,

Provision.Label: (xxi)
Provision.Text: equipment used by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, to dispense hydrogen for use in automotive equipment powered by hydrogen, including vaporization, compression, cooling and storage equipment, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the production or transmission of hydrogen,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the transmission or distribution of electricity,

Provision.Label: (xxii)
Provision.Text: equipment all or substantially all of the use of which by the taxpayer, or by a lessee of the taxpayer, is to produce hydrogen through electrolysis of water, including electrolysers, rectifiers and other ancillary electrical equipment, water treatment and conditioning equipment and equipment used for hydrogen compression and storage, but not including

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the transmission or distribution of hydrogen,

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: equipment used for the transmission or distribution of electricity,

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: is situated in Canada, including property described in subparagraph (d)(v) or (xiv) that is installed in the exclusive economic zone of Canada,

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: acquired by the taxpayer for use by the taxpayer for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business carried on in Canada or from property situated in Canada, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: leased by the taxpayer to a lessee for the use by the lessee for the purpose of gaining or producing income from a business carried on in Canada or from property situated in Canada, and

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: has not been used for any purpose before it was acquired by the taxpayer unless

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: the property was depreciable property that

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: was included in Class 34, 43.1 or 43.2 of the person from whom it was acquired, or

Provision.Label: (II)
Provision.Text: would have been included in Class 34, 43.1 or 43.2 of the person from whom it was acquired had the person made a valid election to include the property in Class 43.1 or 43.2, as the case may be, under paragraph 1102(8)(d) or 1102(9)(d), and

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: the property was acquired by the taxpayer not more than five years after the time it is considered to have become available for use, for the purpose of subsection 13(26) of the Act, by the person from whom it was acquired and remains at the same site in Canada as that at which that person used the property.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property that is acquired after February 22, 2005 and before 2025 (other than property that was included, before it was acquired, in another class in this Schedule by any taxpayer) and that is property that would otherwise be included in Class 43.1

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: otherwise than because of paragraph (d) of that Class; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: because of paragraph (d) of that Class, if

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: subclauses (d)(xvii)(C)(I) and (II) of that Class were read as follows:

Provision.Label: (I)
Provision.Text: an electric vehicle charging station (other than a building) that supplies at least 90 kilowatts of continuous power, or
primarily in connection with one or more electric vehicle charging stations (other than buildings) each of which supplies more than 10 kilowatts of continuous power, and
in connection with one or more electric vehicle charging stations (other than buildings) each of which supplies at least 90 kilowatts of continuous power, or

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: clause (d)(xviii)(B) of that Class were read without reference to its subclause (II).

Provision.Text: Property that is a patent, or a right to use patented information for a limited or unlimited period.

Provision.Label: (d)

Provision.Text: Property acquired after March 22, 2004 that is data network infrastructure equipment, and systems software for that equipment, that would, but for this Class, be included in Class 8 because of paragraph (i) of that Class.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: transmission or distribution equipment (which may include for this purpose a structure) acquired after February 22, 2005 and that is used for the transmission or distribution of electrical energy, other than

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: property that is a building, and

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: property that has been used or acquired for use for any purpose by any taxpayer before February 23, 2005; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: equipment acquired after March 18, 2007 that is part of a liquefied natural gas facility that liquefies or regasifies natural gas, including controls, cooling equipment, compressors, pumps, storage tanks, vaporizers and ancillary equipment, loading and unloading pipelines on the facility site used to transport liquefied natural gas between a ship and the facility, and related structures, other than property that is

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: acquired for the purpose of producing oxygen or nitrogen,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: a breakwater, a dock, a jetty, a wharf, or a similar structure, or

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after February 22, 2005 that is a combustion turbine (including associated burners and compressors) that generates electrical energy, other than

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: electrical generating equipment described in any of paragraphs (f) to (h) of Class 8;

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: property acquired before 2006 in respect of which an election is made under subsection 1101(5t); and

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: property that has been used or acquired for use for any purpose by any taxpayer before February 23, 2005.

Provision.Text: is acquired after February 22, 2005, is used for the transmission (but not the distribution) of petroleum, natural gas or related hydrocarbons, and is not

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: a pipeline described in subparagraph (l)(ii) of Class 1,

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: property that has been used or acquired for use for any purpose by any taxpayer before February 23, 2005,

Provision.Label: (iii)

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: a building or other structure; or

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: is acquired after February 25, 2008, is used for the transmission of carbon dioxide, and is not

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: equipment included in Class 7 because of paragraph (k) of that Class, or

Provision.Text: Property acquired after March 18, 2007 that is general-purpose electronic data processing equipment and systems software for that equipment, including ancillary data processing equipment, but not including property that is included in Class 52 or that is principally or is used principally as

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: electronic process control or monitor equipment;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: systems software for equipment referred to in paragraph (a) or (b); or

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: data handling equipment (other than data handling equipment that is ancillary to general-purpose electronic data processing equipment).

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: a pipeline described in subparagraph (l)(ii) of Class 1 or in Class 49;

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: property that has been used or acquired for use for any purpose by a taxpayer before March 19, 2007; and

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired by a taxpayer after January 27, 2009 and before February 2011 that

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: is general-purpose electronic data processing equipment and systems software for that equipment, including ancillary data processing equipment, but not including property that is principally or is used principally as

Provision.Label: (i)

Provision.Label: (iii)

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: data handling equipment (other than data handling equipment that is ancillary to general-purpose electronic data processing equipment);

Provision.Text: has not been used, or acquired for use, for any purpose whatever before it is acquired by the taxpayer; and

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: for use in a business carried on by the taxpayer in Canada or for the purpose of earning income from property situated in Canada, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: for lease by the taxpayer to a lessee for use by the lessee in a business carried on by the lessee in Canada or for the purpose of earning income from property situated in Canada.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Property acquired after 2015 and before 2026 (other than property included in Class 57 or 58) that is not included in Class 29, but that would otherwise be included in that class if

Provision.Text: subparagraph (a)(ii) of that Class were read without reference to “in Canadian field processing carried on by the lessee or”; and

Provision.Label: (b)

Provision.Text: Property that is a zero-emission vehicle that is not included in Class 16 or 55.

Provision.Text: Property that is acquired, and becomes available for use, by a taxpayer after March 1, 2020 and before 2034, if the property

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: automotive equipment (other than a motor vehicle) that is fully electric or powered by hydrogen, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: an addition or alteration made by the taxpayer to automotive equipment (other than a motor vehicle) to the extent it causes the automotive equipment to become fully electric or powered by hydrogen; and

Provision.Label: (b)

Provision.Text: Property that is part of a CCUS project of a taxpayer and that is

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: equipment, other than excluded CCUS equipment, that

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: is to be used solely for capturing carbon dioxide

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: that would otherwise be released into the atmosphere, or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: prepares or compresses captured carbon for transportation,

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: generates or distributes electrical energy, heat energy or a combination of electrical and heat energy, that directly and solely supports a qualified CCUS project, unless the equipment uses fossil fuels and emits carbon dioxide that is not subject to capture by a qualified CCUS project, and, for greater certainty, not including equipment that

Provision.Label: (A)
Provision.Text: supports the qualified CCUS project indirectly by way of an electrical utility grid, or

Provision.Label: (B)
Provision.Text: expands the capacity of existing equipment that supports the qualified CCUS project and that distributes electrical energy, heat energy or a combination of electrical and heat energy,

Provision.Label: (iv)
Provision.Text: is equipment that solely supports a qualified CCUS project and transmits electrical energy from electrical generation equipment described in subparagraph (iii) to the qualified CCUS project, or

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: delivers, collects, recovers, treats or recirculates water, or a combination of any of those activities, that solely supports a qualified CCUS project;

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: equipment that is to be used solely for transportation of captured carbon, including equipment used for the transportation system safety and integrity;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: equipment that is to be used solely for storage of captured carbon in a geological formation, including equipment used for the storage system safety and integrity, but not including equipment used for enhanced oil recovery;

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: property that is physically and functionally integrated with the equipment described in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) (for greater certainty, excluding construction equipment, furniture, office equipment and vehicles) and that is ancillary equipment used solely to support the functioning of equipment described in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) within a CCUS process as part of

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: a liquid delivery and distribution system,

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: a process material storage and handling and distribution system,

Provision.Label: (vii)
Provision.Text: a process waste management system, or

Provision.Label: (viii)
Provision.Text: a utility air or nitrogen distribution system;

Provision.Label: (e)
Provision.Text: equipment used for system safety and integrity or as part of a control or monitoring system solely to support the equipment described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d); or

Provision.Label: (f)
Provision.Text: a building or other structure all or substantially all of which is used, or to be used, for the installation or operation of equipment described in any of paragraphs (a) to (e); or

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: incorporated into another property that would not otherwise be described in any of paragraphs (a) to (f) if the incorporation causes the other property to satisfy the description in any of paragraphs (a) to (f), or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: used solely to refurbish property described in any of paragraphs (a) to (f) that is part of a CCUS project of the taxpayer.

Provision.Text: equipment to be used solely for using captured carbon in industrial production (including for enhanced oil recovery);

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: property that is physically and functionally integrated with the equipment described in paragraph (a) (for greater certainty, excluding construction equipment, furniture, office equipment and vehicles) and that is ancillary equipment used solely to support the functioning of equipment described in paragraph (a) within a CCUS process as part of

Provision.Label: (iii)

Provision.Label: (v)
Provision.Text: a process material storage and handling and distribution system,

Provision.Label: (vii)
Provision.Text: a process waste management system, or

Provision.Label: (viii)
Provision.Text: a utility air or nitrogen distribution system;

Provision.Label: (c)
Provision.Text: equipment used as part of a control, monitoring or safety system solely to support the equipment described in paragraph (a) or (b);

Provision.Label: (d)
Provision.Text: a building or other structure all or substantially all of which is used, or to be used, for the installation or operation of equipment described in any of paragraphs (a) to (c); or

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: incorporated into another property that would not otherwise be described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d) if the incorporation causes the other property to satisfy the description in any of paragraphs (a) to (d), or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: used solely to refurbish property described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d) that is part of a CCUS project of the taxpayer.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Provision.Text: Intangible property (including property deemed to have been acquired under subsection 13(7.6) of the Act) that is not included in any other class and that is

Provision.Label: (a)
Provision.Text: acquired for the purpose of determining the existence, location, extent or quality of a geological formation to permanently store captured carbon (other than for enhanced oil recovery) in Canada, including property acquired as a result of undertaking environmental studies or community consultations (including studies or consultations that are undertaken to obtain a right, licence or privilege for the purpose of determining the existence, location, extent or quality of a geological formation to permanently store captured carbon (other than for enhanced oil recovery)); and

Provision.Label: (b)
Provision.Text: not acquired for the purpose of drilling or completing an oil or gas well or in building a temporary access road to, or preparing a site in respect of, any such well.

Provision.Text: Intangible property (including property deemed to have been acquired under subsection 13(7.6) of the Act) not included in any other class that is

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: drilling or converting a well in Canada for the permanent storage of captured carbon (other than for enhanced oil recovery),

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: drilling or completing a well for the permanent storage of captured carbon (other than for enhanced oil recovery) in Canada, building a temporary access road to the well or preparing a site in respect of the well, or

Provision.Label: (iii)
Provision.Text: drilling or converting a well in Canada for the purposes of monitoring pressure changes or other phenomena in a geological formation in which captured carbon is permanently stored (other than for enhanced oil recovery); or

Provision.Label: (i)
Provision.Text: for the purposes of determining the existence, location, extent or quality of a geological formation to permanently store captured carbon (other than for enhanced oil recovery), or

Provision.Label: (ii)
Provision.Text: to permanently store captured carbon in dedicated geological storage.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 1100(1)(b), the amount that may be deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of the capital cost of property of Class 13 in Schedule II is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of each amount determined in accordance with section 2 of this Schedule that is a prorated portion of the part of the capital cost to him, incurred in a particular taxation year, of a particular leasehold interest; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer as of the end of the taxation year (before making any deduction under section 1100) of property of the class.

Section.Text: Subject to section 3 of this Schedule, the prorated portion for the year of the part of the capital cost, incurred in a particular taxation year, of a particular leasehold interest is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: 1/5 of that part of the capital cost; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount determined by dividing that part of the capital cost by the number of 12-month periods (not exceeding 40 such periods) falling within the period commencing with the beginning of the particular taxation year in which the capital cost was incurred and ending with the day the lease is to terminate.

Section.Text: For the purpose of determining, under section 2 of this Schedule, the prorated portion for the year of the part of the capital cost, incurred in a particular taxation year, of a particular leasehold interest, the following rules apply:

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: where an item of the capital cost of a leasehold interest was incurred before the taxation year in which the interest was acquired, it shall be deemed to have been incurred in the taxation year in which the interest was acquired;

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where, under a lease, a tenant has a right to renew the lease for an additional term, or for more than one additional term, after the term that includes the end of the particular taxation year in which the capital cost was incurred, the lease shall be deemed to terminate on the day on which the term next succeeding the term in which the capital cost was incurred is to terminate;

Paragraph.Label: (c)
Paragraph.Text: the prorated portion for the year of the part of the capital cost, incurred in a particular taxation year, of a particular leasehold interest shall not exceed the amount, if any, remaining after deducting from that part of the capital cost the aggregate of the amounts claimed and deductible in previous years in respect thereof;

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: where, at the end of a taxation year, the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amounts claimed and deductible in previous taxation years in respect of a particular leasehold interest, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the proceeds of disposition, if any, of part or all of that interest

ContinuedParagraph.Text: equals or exceeds the capital cost as of that time of the interest, the prorated portion of any part of that capital cost shall, for all subsequent years, be deemed to be nil; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: where, at the end of a taxation year, the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer of property of Class 13 in Schedule II is nil, the prorated portion of any part of the capital cost as of that time shall, for all subsequent years, be deemed to be nil.

Section.Text: Where a taxpayer has acquired a property that would, if the property had been acquired by a person with whom the taxpayer was not dealing at arm’s length at the time the property was acquired, be a leasehold interest of that person, a reference in this Schedule to a leasehold interest shall, in respect of the taxpayer, include a reference to that property, and the terms and conditions of the leasehold interest of that property in respect of the taxpayer shall be deemed to be the same as those that would have applied in respect of that person had that person acquired the property.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 1100(1)(f), the amount that may be deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of property described in Class 15 in Schedule II is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount equal to

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if the property is an accelerated investment incentive property acquired in the year,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: if the property is acquired before 2024, 1.5 times an amount computed on the basis of a rate per cord, board foot or cubic metre cut in the taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: if the property is acquired after 2023, 1.25 times an amount computed on the basis of a rate per cord, board foot or cubic metre cut in the taxation year,

Subparagraph.Label: (i.1)
Subparagraph.Text: if the property is a reaccelerated investment incentive property acquired in the year,

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: if the property is acquired before 2030, 1.5 times an amount computed on the basis of a rate per cord, board foot or cubic metre cut in the taxation year, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: if the property is acquired after 2029, 1.25 times an amount computed on the basis of a rate per cord, board foot or cubic metre cut in the taxation year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, an amount computed on the basis of a rate per cord, board foot or cubic metre cut in the taxation year, and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer as of the end of the taxation year (before making any deduction under section 1100 for the taxation year) of property of that class.

Section.Text: Where all the property of the class is used in connection with one timber limit or section thereof, the rate per cord, board foot or cubic metre is the amount determined by dividing

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer as of the end of the taxation year (before making any deduction under section 1100 for the taxation year and computed as if subparagraph 1(a)(i) did not apply) of the property

ContinuedSectionSubsection.Text: by

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the number of cords, board feet or cubic metres of timber in the limit or section thereof as of the commencement of the taxation year, obtained by deducting the quantity cut up to that time from the amount shown by the latest cruise.

Section.Text: Where a part of the property of the class is used in connection with one timber limit or a section thereof and a part is used in connection with another limit or section thereof, a separate rate shall be computed for each part of the property, in the manner provided in section 2 of this Schedule, as though each part of the property were the taxpayer’s only property of that class.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

ScheduleFormHeading.Label: SCHEDULE V
ScheduleFormHeading.TitleText: Capital Cost Allowances, Industrial Mineral Mines

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 1100(1)(g), the amount that may be deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of a property described in that paragraph that is an industrial mineral mine or a right to remove industrial minerals from an industrial mineral mine is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: an amount computed on the basis of a rate (computed under section 2 or 3 of this Schedule, as the case may be) per unit of mineral mined in the taxation year; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer as of the end of the taxation year (before making any deduction under section 1100) of the mine or right.

Section.Text: If the taxpayer has not been granted an allowance in respect of the mine or right for a previous taxation year, the rate for a taxation year is determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1.5, if the property is an accelerated investment incentive property acquired before 2024 or a reaccelerated investment incentive property acquired before 2030,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1.25, if the property is an accelerated investment incentive property acquired after 2023 or a reaccelerated investment incentive property acquired after 2029, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1, in any other case;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the capital cost of the mine or right to the taxpayer;
is the residual value, if any, of the mine or right; and
is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: if the taxpayer has acquired a right to remove only a specified number of units, the specified number of units of material that the taxpayer acquired a right to remove, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: in any other case, the number of units of commercially mineable material estimated as being in the mine when the mine or right was acquired.

Section.Text: Where the taxpayer has been granted an allowance in respect of the mine or right in a previous taxation year, the rate for the taxation year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if paragraph (b) does not apply,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if section 2 applied in the previous year to determine the rate employed to determine the allowance for the year, the rate that would have been determined under section 2 if paragraph (c) of the description of A in that section applied, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the rate employed to determine the allowance for the most recent year for which an allowance was granted; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where it has been established that the number of units of material remaining to be mined in the previous taxation year was in fact different from the quantity that was employed in determining the rate for the previous year referred to in paragraph (a), or where it has been established that the capital cost of the mine or right is substantially different from the amount that was employed in determining the rate for that previous year, a rate determined by dividing the amount that would be the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer of the mine or right as of the commencement of the year if paragraph (c) of the description of A in section 2 had applied in respect of each previous taxation year minus the residual value, if any, by

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: in any case where the taxpayer has acquired a right to remove only a specified number of units, the number of units of commercially mineable material that, at the commencement of the year, he had a right to remove, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the number of units of commercially mineable material estimated as remaining in the mine at the commencement of the year.

Section.Text: In lieu of the aggregate of deductions otherwise allowable under this Schedule, a taxpayer may elect that the deduction for the taxation year be the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount received by him in the taxation year from the sale of mineral.

Section.Text: In this Schedule, residual value means the estimated value of the property if all commercially mineable material were removed.

HistoricalNote.HistoricalNoteSubItem: [NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated text; see relevant amending Acts and regulations.]

ScheduleFormHeading.Label: SCHEDULE VI
ScheduleFormHeading.TitleText: Capital Cost Allowances, Timber Limits and Cutting Rights

Section.Text: For the purposes of paragraph 1100(1)(e), the amount that may be deducted in computing the income of a taxpayer for a taxation year in respect of the capital cost to him of a property, other than a timber resource property, that is a timber limit or a right to cut timber from a limit is the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: the aggregate of

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: an amount computed on the basis of a rate (determined under section 2 or 3 of this Schedule) per cord, board foot or cubic metre cut in the year, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the lesser of

Clause.Label: (A)
Clause.Text: 1/10 of the amount expended by the taxpayer after the commencement of his 1949 taxation year that is included in the capital cost to him of the timber limit or right, for surveys, cruises or preparation of prints, maps or plans for the purpose of obtaining a licence or right to cut timber, and

Clause.Label: (B)
Clause.Text: the amount expended as described in clause (A) minus the aggregate of amounts deducted under this subparagraph in computing the income of the taxpayer in previous years; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer as of the end of the year (before making any deduction under section 1100 for the year) of the timber limit or right.

Section.Text: If the taxpayer has not been granted an allowance in respect of the limit or right for a previous taxation year, the rate for a taxation year is an amount determined by the formula

FormulaDefinition.Text: is

FormulaParagraph.Label: (a)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1.5, if the property is an accelerated investment incentive property acquired before 2024 or a reaccelerated investment incentive property acquired before 2030,

FormulaParagraph.Label: (b)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1.25, if the property is an accelerated investment incentive property acquired after 2023 or a reaccelerated investment incentive property acquired after 2029, and

FormulaParagraph.Label: (c)
FormulaParagraph.Text: 1, in any other case;

FormulaDefinition.Text: is the capital cost of the mine or right to the taxpayer;
is the residual value of the timber limit;

is the total of all amounts expended by the taxpayer after the commencement of the taxpayer’s 1949 taxation year that are included in the capital cost to the taxpayer of the timber limit or right, for surveys, cruises or preparation of prints, maps or plans for the purpose of obtaining a licence or right to cut timber; and
is the quantity of timber in the limit or the quantity of timber the taxpayer has obtained a right to cut, as the case may be, (expressed in cords, board feet or cubic metres) as shown by a cruise.

Section.Text: If the taxpayer has been granted an allowance in respect of the limit or right in a previous taxation year, the rate for a taxation year is

Paragraph.Label: (a)
Paragraph.Text: if paragraph (b) does not apply,

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: if section 2 applied in the previous year to determine the rate employed to determine the allowance for the year, the rate that would have been determined under section 2 if paragraph (c) of the description of A in that section applied, and

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: in any other case, the rate employed to determine the allowance for the most recent year for which an allowance was granted; and

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: where it has been established that the quantity of timber that was in the limit or that the taxpayer had a right to cut was in fact substantially different from the quantity that was employed in determining the rate for the previous year referred to in paragraph (a), or where it has been established that the capital cost of the limit or right is substantially different from the amount that was employed in determining the rate for that previous year, a rate determined by dividing

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the amount that would be the undepreciated capital cost to the taxpayer of the limit or right as of the commencement of the year if paragraph (c) of the description of A in section 2 had applied in respect of each previous taxation year, minus the residual value,

ContinuedParagraph.Text: by

Subparagraph.Label: (ii)
Subparagraph.Text: the estimated remaining quantity of timber that is in the limit or that the taxpayer has a right to cut, as the case may be, (expressed in cords, board feet or cubic metres) at the commencement of the year.

Section.Text: In lieu of the deduction otherwise determined under this Schedule, a taxpayer may elect that the deduction for a taxation year be the lesser of

Paragraph.Label: (b)
Paragraph.Text: the amount received by him in the taxation year from the sale of timber.

Section.Text: In this Schedule, residual value means the estimated value of the property if the merchantable timber were removed.

Subsection.Text: Subparagraph (j.1)(i) of the definition remuneration in subsection 100(1) of the Income Tax Regulations is replaced by the following:

Subparagraph.Label: (i)
Subparagraph.Text: the particular payment is in respect of the minimum amount (determined in accordance with subsection 146.3(1), (1.6) or (1.7) of the Act, as the case may be) under the fund for a year, or

Subsection.Text: Paragraph 103(6)(d.1) of the Regulations is replaced by the following:

Paragraph.Label: (d.1)
Paragraph.Text: a payment made during the lifetime of an annuitant referred to in the definition annuitant in subsection 146.3(1) of the Act under a registered retirement income fund of that annuitant, other than a payment to the extent that it is in respect of the minimum amount (determined in accordance with subsection 146.3(1), (1.6) or (1.7) of the Act, as the case may be) under the fund for a year,
